izzyondroid:com.desarrollodroide.pagekee.name: Shiori
izzyondroid:com.desarrollodroide.pagekee.summary: Requires your own Shiori server. Save links from any app and read offline.
izzyondroid:com.desarrollodroide.pagekee.description:
Before you install: this app needs a Shiori server. It is a client for Shiori, the open source bookmark manager you host yourself (on a computer, a NAS or a VPS). It does not work on its own, and there is no account to sign up for: you log in to your own server, version 1.7 or newer. How to set one up: https://github.com/go-shiori/shiori/blob/master/docs/Installation.md
 Your whole library is kept on the device, so the list, the tags and every article you have saved are there with no connection at all. What you change while offline (adding, editing, deleting, asking for a fresh copy of a page) is queued and sent when your server can be reached again.
 Features 
 Save from any app : share a page from your browser and it lands in your library, without opening the app.
 Read offline : articles are stored as clean, readable text, without the site around them.
 Works offline, syncs later : changes made without a connection are sent once the server answers again.
 Search titles, excerpts and URLs on the device, so it also works offline.
 Tags : filter the list by tag, rename or delete tags, or hide one tag from the list.
 Batch actions : select several bookmarks to tag, re-cache or delete them in one go.
 EPUB : download the ebook your server made of a page and open it in your reader app.
 Phones, tablets and foldables : the list takes as many columns as the screen can hold, and on a large screen the article can open beside it.
 Material 3 , light and dark.
 Requirements 
 A Shiori server you can reach, version 1.7 or newer.
 Android 8.0 or newer.
 This is an independent app, not made by the Shiori project. It is open source under the Apache 2.0 license: https://github.com/DesarrolloAntonio/Shiori-Android-Client

izzyondroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.name: Oksigenia SOS
izzyondroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.summary: Smart safety and distress alerts with fall and inactivity detection.
izzyondroid:com.oksigenia.oksigenia_sos.description:
Oksigenia SOS is an offline-first personal safety app for outdoor sports and high-risk environments. No account, no cloud, no Google Services required — everything runs on your device.
 When something goes wrong, it sends an SMS alert with your GPS coordinates to your emergency contact. No internet connection needed.
 Smart Fall Detection (Smart Sentinel)
 The accelerometer monitors you continuously at high frequency. A sudden impact triggers an observation window. If sustained walking movement is detected during that window, the alarm is dismissed automatically — false positives from drops or normal jolts won't fire the SOS. If no rhythmic movement is detected, the SOS is sent.
 Activity profiles
 Pick the profile that matches what you're doing — Smart Sentinel adapts its sensitivity:
 Trekking / Hiking: balanced default for walking outdoors.
 Running (road): tuned for the sustained high-G cadence of road running, with an adaptive rhythm detector.
 Trail running / MTB: higher impact threshold for terrain with constant vibration.
 Mountaineering: longer observation window for slow recoveries on technical ground.
 Paragliding / Kayak / Watersports: automatic fall detection is disabled (the sensor cannot reliably interpret flight or water motion); inactivity monitor and manual SOS remain active.
 Professional / Rescue: extended observation window for advanced operational use.
 Inactivity Monitor (Dead Man's Switch)
 Set a check-in timer. If you don't confirm you're OK before it expires, the alert is sent automatically. Essential for solo adventures where a fall might leave you conscious but unable to call for help.
 Live Tracking
 Send your GPS position by SMS every 30, 60 or 120 minutes. Pause, resume or check in manually at any time — without stopping the monitoring session.
 Dying Gasp
 When the battery drops below 5%, a final SMS with your last GPS position is sent automatically before the phone shuts down.
 Privacy and Compatibility
 No account or registration required
 All data stays on your device — no cloud sync, no telemetry
 No trackers, no analytics, no ads
 Works on de-Googled phones (GrapheneOS, MicroG)
 Open source under GPLv3
 About the permissions
 Oksigenia SOS asks for sensitive permissions because its job is to call for help when you cannot. Each one maps to a single rescue function:
 SMS: sends the alert. SMS is the only channel that works in the mountains without internet.
 Location, including "Allow all the time" (background location): when you fall, your phone is in your pocket with the screen off and the app in the background. Without background access, Android can deny a fresh GPS fix at exactly that moment, and the SOS would leave without usable coordinates. Your position is read only when an alert or tracking update is being sent, and it travels exclusively inside the SMS to the contacts you configured — it is never uploaded anywhere. The app has no network access at all: it does not even request the INTERNET permission.
 Motion sensors / physical activity: fall and inactivity detection.
 Battery exemption: so Android doesn't kill the monitoring service mid-route.
 A safety app that prioritised permission minimalism over getting your coordinates to a rescuer would be failing at its only job. The privacy guarantee here is structural, not cosmetic: everything stays on the device.
 Available in 11 languages.
 IMPORTANT: Oksigenia SOS is a support tool and does not replace professional emergency services. Its operation depends on mobile coverage, GPS signal and battery level.

izzyondroid:de.flyingsnail.ipv6droid.description:
To actually use this app, a tunnel service is required. You can run your own tunnel service on suitable infrastructure. See IPv6DroidServer for more details.
 Notes:
 This approach towards IPv6 has subtle implications on your privacy: for IPv6 connections, you have a fixed IP and you - as a person! - are easily identifyable by all IPv6 communication partners. Also, your mobile device suddenly has an IP on which it is reachable from the outside.
 This app cannot be used when another VPN is active.
 It is not required to have a rooted device.
 About license:
 You can opt for the convenience package, and install IPv6Droid right from here. It will download, install, guide you to the setup of your account details and update from time to time as new features or bugfixes are implemented.
 But I am looking for supporters! So, I'd like to promote the approach that you set up a build environment (e.g. Android Studio), download the sources (see web site) and build it by yourself. That's it. You may use the tool, modify and even redistribute the sources under the terms of the General Public License. No obligations, but in this case you have the tools, you have the sources and you have the engagement that drives me to hope that you're going to play a more active part in bringing forward this client. E.g. by submitting detailed error reports, by submitting patches, by providing better artwork, writing better documentation, designing a better user experience, ...

fdroid:app.cleartray.name: Trayzero: GTD Task Manager
fdroid:app.cleartray.summary: GTD inbox and task manager. Capture, clarify and review offline. No account.
fdroid:app.cleartray.description:
Trayzero is a private, offline GTD task manager and to-do list built around the Getting Things Done method. Get to inbox zero by turning loose thoughts into clear next actions.
Your tasks, notes and attachments are stored on your device. No Trayzero account is required. Every feature is available without a purchase, and there are no ads.
Capture what is on your mind
Add tasks from anywhere in the app, share text and links into your inbox, or use the home-screen widget. Dictate a thought with your device's speech recognizer, and attach photos or voice memos.
Clarify your inbox
Process Inbox guides you through each item: Is it actionable? Can you do it in two minutes? Is it a next action, a project, something to delegate, or something for later? Clear your GTD inbox by deciding what each item means.
Organize your commitments
Keep Next Actions, Projects, Waiting For, Someday/Maybe, Calendar and Reference in dedicated lists. Give projects an outcome and see which ones need a next action. Use contexts, tags and Areas of Responsibility to organize work and life.
Choose the next action
Filter actions by context, available time and energy. Build a daily plan and find work that fits the moment, whether you have five minutes at home or an hour at your computer.
Keep your system current
A guided Weekly Review helps you capture loose ends, clear your inbox, and review actions, waiting items, projects, your calendar and Someday/Maybe. Save your progress and continue later.
Remember what matters
Set due dates, deferred actions, waiting-for follow-ups and repeating tasks. Reminder notifications offer actions such as Done and Snooze. You can manually publish scheduled items to your chosen system calendar. Notification delivery depends on your device permissions and settings.
Bring your tasks with you
Import supported exports from Todoist, TickTick, Nirvana, Google Tasks, Things 3 and OmniFocus, or paste a plain-text list. You can also connect to Microsoft To Do for a one-time import. Preview before importing and undo an import if needed. Export formats and supported fields vary by source.
Own your backups
Export and restore portable JSON backups, including attachments. Enable automatic backups to a folder you choose. Backups are unencrypted; if you choose a cloud-synced folder, its provider handles synchronization. Trayzero does not provide cross-device task sync.
Privacy with clear choices
Your task content is not sent to a Trayzero server. Optional Microsoft imports, system-calendar integration, speech recognition and cloud-folder backups use the services you choose. See the privacy policy for details.
Free and open source
Light and dark themes, adjustable appearance, and accessibility support are included. Explore the source at github.com/roman10/trayzero.
Trayzero is an independent app, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the David Allen Company. "Getting Things Done" and "GTD" are trademarks of the David Allen Company.

fdroid:com.flyboybyte.dragtree.name: DragTree
fdroid:com.flyboybyte.dragtree.summary: NHRA Pro Tree reaction game — sensor launch, 2 Player, fully offline
fdroid:com.flyboybyte.dragtree.description:
DragTree is a reaction-time game built on a real NHRA Christmas Tree (the drag strip starting lights). Watch the ambers, react to the green, and see how fast you were. Beat your best, or beat a friend.
Launch it however you like:
• Motion sensor — mount the phone in the car, stage, and drive off. The app detects the launch and times it from the start of acceleration. No tapping.
• Tap — a big on-screen button.
• Hold to Launch — hold the button through the tree and let go on green, like a trans-brake button.
• Volume buttons and remotes — use a volume button, a wired headphone button, or a cheap Bluetooth camera-shutter remote as your launch button (Settings, off by default).
Fully offline — no internet, no account, no ads, no tracking.
TWO PLAYER
Put the phone between two people. Each gets their own lane and light; best reaction wins, and a red light loses.
TREES
• Pro Tree (.400) — all three ambers together, green 0.400 s later
• Sportsman Tree (.500) — ambers count down one at a time, green 0.500 s after the last
GRADES
Perfect (under .050) · Pro · Great · Good · Late · Red Light, which shows how early you went.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• History of your last 30 runs, personal best, and a trend chart
• Consistency stats: average, spread, how often you land within ±.020, and your streak
• Series mode: 3, 5 or 10 runs back to back with a summary
• Time-slip comparison: enter the reaction time from a real slip and see how your phone differs
BUILT FOR PRECISION
• The motion sensor is read up to 200 times a second with the sensor's own timestamps, on phones with or without a gyroscope
• Accelerometer test: records 5 seconds of background vibration and suggests the most sensitive setting it won't trip
• Phone latency check: screen rate, sensor rate and a tap test, so you know how much of a time is the phone
• Three sensitivity presets plus a custom setting
Optional sounds: a tick on each amber, a beep at green and a chime for your result.
The reaction time shown is how quickly you responded after the green. A track time slip also includes the car's rollout and drivetrain response, so DragTree is best for practice and consistency, not for predicting your exact slip.
PERMISSIONS
• HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS — fast motion-sensor readings
• VIBRATE — touch feedback
• MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS — plays the sound effects
There is no internet permission at all, and no microphone, location or storage access.

fdroid:com.rousecontext.name: Rouse Context
fdroid:com.rousecontext.summary: Turn your phone into a secure, on-demand MCP server for AI clients
fdroid:com.rousecontext.description:
Rouse Context turns your Android phone into an on-demand MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. An AI client connects to a URL, your phone wakes up, and a direct encrypted session is established. The client asks for what it needs — health data, notifications, app usage — your phone answers, then goes back to sleep.
 Your data stays on the device. The session runs end-to-end encrypted between the AI client and your phone; the relay that connects them only forwards that encrypted traffic and can't read it.
 Wake-ups use UnifiedPush , so install a UnifiedPush distributor (for example ntfy) to be reached while the app is in the background.
 Features:
 On-demand — your phone is only reachable while a client is connected, then sleeps again. No always-on background service draining the battery.
 You stay in control — you enable each integration explicitly, and every tool call an AI client makes is recorded in an on-device audit history you can review.
 Private by design — data never leaves the device except through a live, user-approved session.
 Certificate monitoring — the app checks public transparency logs (crt.sh, or Certspotter as backup) for certificates issued to your device's address, so a forged one doesn't go unnoticed. Runs every 12 hours by default; change the interval or turn it off in Settings.
 Free and open source, with no analytics or tracking in the app.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.
Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.
But choose your order carefully:
- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!
THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.
Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.
You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.
FEATURES
- 200+ color sort puzzle levels - new images, new challenges
- Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
- Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
- No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action
EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.
Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.
A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.
WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 
Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

flathub:com.axantum.xecrets.ez.description:
Xecrets Ez is a true zero-knowledge desktop file and text encryption application that uses strong
 AES-256 encryption to password protect your files. Encrypted files use the .axx extension and remain
 protected wherever they go — cloud storage, email, USB drives or backups — because the encryption
 always follows the file. No data or passwords will ever leave your device.
 Unlike container-based or folder-based encryption solutions, Xecrets Ez encrypts files individually
 so protection is never lost when a file is moved or copied. It works entirely offline: no internet
 connection, no servers, no accounts required.
 Features include (some require Premium):
 AES-256 encryption
 Encrypt and decrypt individual files or all files in folders
 Encrypt text messages directly in the application
 Open and edit encrypted files with automatic re-encryption
 YubiKey hardware security key support
 SLIP-39 Shamir's Secret Sharing for password backup
 Available in English, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Español, Português and Svenska
 No internet connection is ever used
 100% compatible with AxCrypt
 Cross-platform: Linux, Windows and macOS
 It is entirely free for encryption and decryption of files, with full security. Premium features
 require a low-cost subscription with a 10-day free trial. A 3-day premium trial is also available
 without a credit card.

fedora-packages:boxes/boxes.name: boxes
fedora-packages:boxes/boxes.description: Boxes is a command line program which draws, removes, and repairs ASCII art boxes. It operates as a text filter. The generated boxes may even be removed and repaired again if they were badly damaged by editing of the text inside. Since boxes may be open on any side, boxes can also be used to create (regional) comments in any programming language. Boxes is useful for making the function headers in your programming language look better, for spicing up news postings and emails, or just for decorating documentation files. Since the drawn box is matched in size to your input text, you can use boxes in scripts to dynamically add boxes around stuff.

Limited support for copying content of data CD and DVD discs to image files is also provided. cdw can verify correctness of writing ISO9660 image to CD or DVD disc using md5sum or some of programs that verifies SHA hashes.

These architectural components provide general support for the enforcement of many kinds of mandatory access control policies, including those based on the concepts of Type Enforcement®, Role-based Access Control, and Multi-level Security. fedora-packages:credcheck/credcheck.name: credcheck
fedora-packages:credcheck/credcheck.description: The credcheck PostgreSQL extension provides few general credential checks, which will be evaluated during the user creation, during the password change and user renaming. By using this extension, we can define a set of rules: allow a specific set of credentials reject a certain type of credentials deny password that can be easily cracked enforce use of an expiration date with a minimum of day for a password define a password reuse policy define the number of authentication failure allowed before a user is banned This extension provides all the checks as configurable parameters. The default configuration settings, will not enforce any complex checks and will try to allow most of the credentials. By using SET credcheck.<check-name> TO <some value>; command, enforce new settings for the credential checks. The settings can only be changed by a superuser.

fedora-packages:gfs-decker-fonts/gfs-dec.description: This typeface is a product of Deckersche Schriftgießere type foundry owned by Rudolf Ludwig Decker (1804-1877) in Berlin, but it was frequently used in Greek editions by both Oxford and Cambridge University Press during the last decades of the 19th century. It was designed and cut before 1864, according to John Bowman, when a set of matrices was bought by OUP, although the type was not cast and used in England until 1882. The typeface is an uncial design containing a case of capitals, and small capitals, too. The letters lack any serifs although they retain their thick and thin strokes. It appeared as an alternate type of Byzantine tradition in mostly Patristic texts. The font was digitally designed by George D. Matthiopoulos and is freely available by GFS.

fedora-packages:ghc-fmt/ghc-fmt.name: ghc-fmt
fedora-packages:ghc-fmt/ghc-fmt.description: A new formatting library that tries to be simple to understand while still being powerful and providing more convenience features than other libraries (like functions for pretty-printing maps and lists, or a function for printing arbitrary datatypes using generics). A comparison with other libraries: * 'printf' (from 'Text.Printf') takes a formatting string and uses some type tricks to accept the rest of the arguments polyvariadically. It's very concise, but there are some drawbacks – it can't produce 'Text' (you'd have to 'T.pack' it every time) and it doesn't warn you at compile-time if you pass wrong arguments or not enough of them. * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/text-format text-format> takes a formatting string with curly braces denoting places where arguments would be substituted (the arguments themselves are provided via a tuple). If you want to apply formatting to some of the arguments, you have to use one of the provided formatters. Like 'printf', it can fail at runtime, but at least the formatters are first-class (and you can add new ones). * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/formatting formatting> takes a formatting template consisting of pieces of strings interleaved with formatters; this ensures that arguments always match their placeholders. 'formatting' provides lots of formatters and generally seems to be the most popular formatting library here. Unfortunately, at least in my experience writing new formatters can be awkward and people sometimes have troubles understanding how 'formatting' works. * <https://hackage.haskell.org/package/fmt fmt> (i.e. this library) provides formatters that are ordinary functions, and a bunch of operators for concatenating formatted strings; those operators also do automatic conversion. There are some convenience formatters which aren't present in 'formatting' (like ones for formatting maps, lists, converting to base64, etc). Some find the operator syntax annoying, while others like it.

(1) Visit a website.
(2) Click the extension icon in the top-right corner of your browser.
▣ Extension Features:
● Auto Collect
If enabled, the extension will automatically collect all newly loaded images. If disabled, you need to click the button manually. This is useful for websites that load images dynamically (e.g., Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook).
● Collect in Viewport
If enabled, only images currently visible in your browser window will be collected. If disabled, all images loaded on the page will be collected.
● Download Multiple Images
Download multiple selected images with one click. All files will be saved in your computer.
● Organize subfolders using variables
Images will be saved in the Downloads folder on your computer. You can organize them into subfolders using variables. for example: if an image collected from instagram.com , the image will be saved into the instagram.com subfolder in the Downloads folders.
● Add to Favorites
Save the image's URL for later downloader.
● Sort & Filter
Filter by size, width, height, or orientation (Landscape, Portrait, Square). Sort by size (width × height). View larger or smaller first. More filter & sorting options will be added in future updates.
● Adjust Image Display
Change image size: See more images at once or view them in detail.
● Background Color
Choose dark, light, or transparent backgrounds for non-square images.

firefox-addons:353526.name: Tab notifier
firefox-addons:353526.summary: Enables desktop notifications like in Chrome (e.g. Gmail, imo.im) and, if the site doesn't support them, it can notify new messages or updates detecting changes of the title (e.g. Hotmail, Yahoo, Facebook, Twitter). Even if the browser is minimized!
firefox-addons:353526.description:
Tab Notifier 3 was developed from scratch as a WebExtension. Screenshots and following details refer to Tab Notifier 2.x (running only on Gecko 44 or older versions for Windows and Linux), but they will be soon updated. 
Watch the demo on YouTube 
The version 2 adds a major feature: it exposes the chrome desktop notifications API to web pages and other add-ons (try it with gmail and imo!)
The extension can also show a desktop notification when the title of a tab changes while the tab is not focused.
A desktop notification it's an alert that appears outside the browser window, in a corner of your screen. Click on it to open the tab that triggered it. Besides chat, email and social networks, it works with tons of other websites, like microblogging sites and similar (e.g.: Twitter and Digg), or to show the title of a track when it starts to be played (e.g.: MySpace) .
 Also available for Chrome 
 Advanced configuration ( about:config ) 
Here are some parameters that usually don't need to be changed, so they are not showed in the preferences window:
 alerts.disableSlidingEffect can be used to disable animations (sometimes useful if you use a remote desktop over internet)
 extensions.tabnotifier.minSlideIncrementTime can be decreased to try to obtain a smoother animation, but if some notification windows hang you should increase it (new in ver. 1.3)
 extensions.tabnotifier.maxQueuedNotifications is the maximum number of notifications that are queued after the number of windows reaches maxVisibleNotifications , extra messages will be discarded (new in ver. 1.3)

bluejetty:00066395:ios.description:
Welcome to yoomee
yoomee is an engaging app that brings fun, light-hearted chat and exciting social connections to your smartphone. Whether you're looking to meet new people, have casual conversations, or simply pass the time, yoomee provides you with an enjoyable, interactive experience.
Discover Chat Partners in Your Area
With yoomee’s innovative radar system, you can easily find friendly chat partners nearby. Activate the radar to discover interesting people in your area who are also looking for conversation and friendly interaction. This feature helps you connect with others in a fun and spontaneous way.
Connect via the Match Game System
Our match game system is a playful and interactive way to get to know others. Browse profiles and swipe left or right to see who might be a good match for you. Once you match, you can start chatting and getting to know each other better. It's a fun and relaxed way to meet new people.
Moderated Chat Profiles for More Entertainment
yoomee also offers moderated chat profiles. These profiles are designed to keep you engaged with entertaining conversations when you're not yet matched with a real chat partner. These profiles are marked with a heart icon next to their username. Please note that these profiles are not real users but are managed by our moderators to provide fun, non-sexual interactions.
An Active Community of Engaging People
At yoomee, you’ll find a lively community of active individuals who, just like you, are looking for friendly conversations and social connections. Our users are friendly, open, and excited to meet new people. With high user activity, there's always someone interesting to chat with.
Share Photos and Experience Fun Chats
A highlight of yoomee is the option to share photos with others, making your conversations more personal and interactive. You can share a special moment or just a smile to make the conversation even more engaging.
Why yoomee?
• Quick and Easy Connections: The radar system lets you find chat partners nearby with ease.
• Fun, Playful Connections: The match game system makes connecting exciting.
• A Diverse Community: Our active community guarantees you'll always find someone fun to chat with.
• Photo Sharing: Share photos and bring your conversations to the next level.
• Secure and Discreet: Your privacy is important to us. yoomee ensures safe, private communication.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Service:
https://pcdn.yoomee.love/yoomee/en/tandc_en_GB.html
https://pcdn.yoomee.love/yoomee/en/privacy_en_GB.html
Important Notes:
• All photos of the models shown are for illustrative purposes only.
• Creating a profile and registering is free. You do not need to purchase a paid subscription to use the app or its features.
• This app is only for adults 18 years and older.
• Moderated profiles are for entertainment purposes only. They are managed by our team to provide fun, friendly interactions when real matches are unavailable. Real-life encounters are not possible with these profiles.

bluejetty:00060730:ios.description:

Library
- Keep your Plex and Audiobookshelf books together in one library

- Download books for offline listening

Devices
- Listen on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
- Download books to Apple Watch and listen without your phone
- Use CarPlay, Siri, Shortcuts and widgets
Prologue plays the books on your Plex or Audiobookshelf server. It doesn't sell books or come with any of its own.
Free to download, with additional features behind a one-time Premium unlock. Offline listening on Apple Watch requires the separate Prologue for Apple Watch unlock.
Transcription and following along with audio require a supported device and language.

bluejetty:00177085:ios.name: Soft Toys Claw : Claw Machine
bluejetty:00177085:ios.summary:
A realistic claw machine simulator game.
While you can’t win real prizes, we’ve recreated the authentic atmosphere and experience of a real claw machine as closely as possible.
●Features
*A realistic claw machine app powered by 3D graphics
bluejetty:00177085:ios.description:
A realistic claw machine simulator game.
While you can’t win real prizes, we’ve recreated the authentic atmosphere and experience of a real claw machine as closely as possible.
●Features
*A realistic claw machine app powered by 3D graphics and a physics engine for authentic movement.
*Plush toys feature accurate collision detection, allowing you to enjoy gameplay that feels just like a real claw machine.
*Some plush toys have movable joints that react depending on how the claw grabs them, just like in real machines.
*Beautiful graphics.
*'Normal Mode’ feature classic plush prizes and traditional claw machine gameplay.
*'Special Mode' offer technical challenges that can’t be experienced in ordinary claw machines.
*Check items you haven’t collected yet and track how many you’ve won in the Collection screen.
*A wide variety of items is available, including animal plushies such as elephants and giraffes, as well as dinosaur plushies like Tyrannosaurus and Triceratops. Enjoy many different claw machine stages.
*New items are added regularly.
●How to Play
*Main Menu
Normal Mode — Classic plush prize stages.
Special Mode — Technical stages with unique mechanics.
Collection — View collected items.
*Stage Selection
Choose a stage from the preview list and press Start to begin.
*Gameplay
Hold the horizontal button to move right.
Hold the forward button to move forward and release to drop the claw.
The crane returns automatically and releases prizes at the drop zone.
Drag the screen to move the camera.
Use Switch to change camera angles.
*Coins
Each move costs 1 coin.
Win a plush: +3 coins.
Clear a stage: +5 coins.
Out of coins:
Wait 10 minutes → +10 coins.
Watch an ad → +30 coins.
*Big Claw
Larger and stronger claw for easier grabs.
Watch an ad to receive 5 uses.
Activates from the top-left button.
Returns to normal after one play.
Costs 1 coin per move.

bluejetty:00040026:ios.name: XO - Vibe & Chat
bluejetty:00040026:ios.summary:
XO is an AI-powered vibe & chat app designed for real connections in high-pressure cities.
Connect through vibe, thoughts, and shared energy - without the pressure of traditional social or dating apps. In fast-paced places like NYC, social
bluejetty:00040026:ios.description:
XO is an AI-powered vibe & chat app designed for real connections in high-pressure cities.
Connect through vibe, thoughts, and shared energy - without the pressure of traditional social or dating apps. In fast-paced places like NYC, socializing can feel exhausting. Profiles, swipes, and forced openers often take more energy than they’re worth. XO focuses on what you share, not how you perform.
# Consent-based matching, privacy-first
With vibe-based matching, you connect through stories, late-night thoughts, and everyday moments. Users create a unique account and can browse profiles and posts. 1:1 conversations begin only after mutual interest (e.g., mutual “like” / acceptance), so you stay in control of who you interact with.
Use a pseudonymous profile and choose what you share, designed for a privacy-first experience.
# Built-in AI chat tools to lower social friction
• AI Rizz Up helps you craft smarter openers
• AI Witty Reply suggests better responses during conversations
• AI Wingman supports smoother chats
• AI Companion offers a space to talk and reflect
• AI Matchmaking recommends people who match your vibe
Explore interest-based and invite-only spaces, including LGBTQ+ friendly communities, built to help you find people who truly relate.
XO isn’t about swiping harder.
It’s about connecting smarter.
=== XO VIP Auto Subscription ===
-Payment, Users confirm their purchase and make payment through their Apple ID account.
-Cancellation: Users can manually disable the auto-subscription feature in iTunes/Apple ID settings management within 24 hours prior to the expiration of the current subscription period, and no fees will be charged within 24 hours before the expiration.
-Auto Subscription: The Apple ID account will be charged within 24 hours prior to the expiration of the subscription plan. After successful payment, the subscription period will be extended for another subscription period, allowing users to explore various themed boards and meet like-minded people!
-Terms of Use (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026984:ios.description:
FishTrack provides saltwater anglers with everything they need to find fish. The FishTrack app offers Cloud-free Sea Surface Temperature (SST) charts, high-definition global satellite imagery, including water temperature charts, water color, currents, tides, moon phase and marine weather forecasts – all in one layered tool. Users can mark ‘hot spots’ and record GPS locations of temperature breaks and color barriers. Save imagery and overlay data for offline use to identify bite zones while navigating offshore.
With FishTrack you can:
-View the Latest SST and Chlorophyll imagery
-Mark, name and save data of potential hot spots
-Save fishing chart imagery for offline use
-Plot waypoints and calculate distances
-Overlay bathymetry, ocean currents and sea surface height
-View marine weather forecasts
-View your current location while offline
Don't fish blind. Save time and fuel with the FishTrack app. Download now to get started!

bluejetty:00081965:ios.name: Neene - Where Kannadigas Date
bluejetty:00081965:ios.summary: Neene is India’s first vernacular dating app that is designed to bring Kannadigas residing in and outside India closer for one common reason — finding long-lasting relationships. The word ‘Neene’ translates to ‘only you’ in Kannada. So, the
bluejetty:00081965:ios.description:
Neene is India’s first vernacular dating app that is designed to bring Kannadigas residing in and outside India closer for one common reason — finding long-lasting relationships. The word ‘Neene’ translates to ‘only you’ in Kannada. So, the app is designed to offer a high-intent dating experience that is culturally aligned with Kannadiga's needs. Neene’s unique approach to appreciating sensitivities has made it one of the fastest-growing vernacular dating apps in the country; and as we see it, Neene is soon going to replace the need for matrimonial platforms out there for the Kannadiga community.
Features:
Setting Cultural Preferences: Neene appreciates the Kannadiga cultural nuances and choices that define the Kannadiga ways of living. We have preference features on the app that is tailor-made to make sure you find what you're looking for in a person. And to help you in breaking the ice, we host a gamut of Kannada and Sandalwood pop culture references that you can use in your profile answers — from food to TV shows and cinema.
Trivia Game: This feature is a fun way to interact with your matches. You can play an interesting game of trivia, while you are on a voice call with your match. The trivia is mostly based on the culture of Karnataka and also includes some fun random questions. So go ahead and find your trivia partner.
Send 'Notes': Neene’s ‘Notes’ serves as the best kind of conversation starter, letting users express their interest in someone they really like, by writing to them directly. For all we know, you are just an effort away from the right match.
Neene 'Premium': Neene 'Premium' is an in-app paid feature through which you can send more requests and notes, see who sent you requests, and unlock more preferences.
Neene 'Select': Neene 'Select' is our latest paid feature with everything you need to find your perfect match quickly. Get all the goodness of 'Premium', plus access profiles in the 'Select' tab with more preferences and send unlimited Notes. If you are looking to meet someone who finds the sunrise at Nandi Hills equally romantic as you do, then Neene is absolutely the dating app you should be on. 
In-app Purchases: 
Neene Notes
Neene Premium
Neene Select
---------------------------------------------
If you choose to purchase Neene Premium or Neene Select, payment will be charged to your Apple account. These subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription through the App Store settings post-purchase. Neene Premium comes in a 1-week pack for $3.99, a 1-month pack for $10.99, a 3-month pack for $17.49, and a 6-month pack for $28.99, while Neene Select comes in a 1-week pack for $9.99, a 1-month pack for $14.99, a 3-month pack for $24.99, and a 6-month pack for $34.99. Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of current subscriptions is allowed during the active subscription period.
For more information, please visit these links - 
Terms: https://www.neene.in/terms_conditions.html
Privacy: https://www.neene.in/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00073618:ios.description:
Freenotes: Freedom to write, organize, and shine
Transform your iPad into a powerful AI-driven digital notepad. Freenotes is an all-in-one workspace designed for students and professionals who want the natural feel of handwriting with the power of artificial intelligence. Whether you are annotating a complex PDF, planning your week, or recording a lecture, Freenotes helps you stay organized with seamless, free-form experience.
AI Summary
Quickly find key points and action items from long recordings or documents.
AI Chat with PDF
Ask questions directly to your imported files to get instant answers.
AI Homework Helper
Take a screenshot or upload a document (PDF or photo) to instantly get answers.
AI Study Companion
Clarify concepts, define terms, and check your handwritten notes for accuracy, turning passive review into active recall.
Organize Notes
Categorize and organize your notes by projects, courses, or topics, automating the organization of your note library.
Quick Search via OCR
Search through your handwritten scripts easily using accurate text recognition.
PDF Annotation
Highlight, underline, and add comments to documents with custom pen styles.
Infinite Canvas
Sketch ideas or mind map on a whiteboard that expands as you work.
Apple Pencil Pro Support
Experience low-latency writing that feels like real paper.
Shape Recognition
Turn rough drawings into clean, perfect geometric shapes for diagrams.
Hyperlink Support
Navigate through digital planners using clickable internal and external links.
Active Recall Tape
Hide specific parts of your notes to test your memory and study better.
Paper Templates
Access various backgrounds including grid, Cornell, and dotted paper.
Flashcards
Build study sets directly from your pages to help with exam prep.
Seamless Video Learning
Use Picture-in-Picture (PiP) to take notes while watching online videos (YouTube, lecture recordings), and instantly capture relevant screenshots directly into your notes.
iCloud & Google Drive Sync
Securely back up your digital notebook to access your data anywhere.
Who is Freenotes For?
Students: Create study guides, annotate lecture slides, and use the "Active Recall" tape tool for exam prep.
Professionals: Record meetings, organize projects into folders, and sign PDF documents on the go.
Creatives: Sketch ideas on an infinite whiteboard and export high-quality files to share with your team.
Join over 1 million happy users transitioning to a smarter, paperless future. Try Freenotes today and experience the next era of AI note-taking.
Privacy Policy: https://www.freenotetech.com/policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.freenotetech.com/terms/

bluejetty:00025752:android.name: Watcher of Realms
bluejetty:00025752:android.summary: Embark on an unparalleled Next-Gen Fantasy RPG adventure with Watcher of Realms. Journey to the continent of Tya, where heroes and monsters coexist, to collect over 250 heroes from 10 different factions. Strengthen and build out your own de
bluejetty:00025752:android.description:
Embark on an unparalleled Next-Gen Fantasy RPG adventure with Watcher of Realms. Journey to the continent of Tya, where heroes and monsters coexist, to collect over 250 heroes from 10 different factions. Strengthen and build out your own dedicated lineup, power through a vast array of levels and stages, and leave behind your own legacy along the way.
Enjoy some of your favorite RPG elements in Watcher of Realms!
1. Experience 250+ heroes to collect and upgrade! 
Unlock over 250 heroes from 10 factions and build a powerful team to stand against monsters and demons. From death knights of the abyss and noble paladins to enigmatic mages and bloodthirsty orcs—every fantasy hero you can imagine is here.
You'll also find rare Lord Heroes with exclusive Lord Skills. Collect these to buff the entire faction!
2. More exciting BOSS battles.
Epic Dragons, Mighty Golems, The Undying Bull, The Lord of Styx, The Conquerer, and many Bosses are ready to throw down the gauntlet! Take on these formidable foes in Guild Boss, Void Rift, Immortal Codex and other modes to claim your stake of Tya's finest treasure.
3. Refreshingly diverse RPG elements.
Obtain rare resources from dungeon levels where gruesome monsters await. Strengthen and improve your hero’s attributes by collecting gear, artifacts, and legendary skill dust to get the edge.
Reinforce your camp and explore multiple game modes while leading your heroes to ultimate victory on the grandest battlefield of all.
4. User friendly and deeply strategic gameplay. 
The diverse continent of Tya includes vast deserts, chilling dungeons, colossal mountains and more. With each stage posing new challenges, commanders must choose the best faction and hero combinations to survive. Charge into battle with your fearless heroes and activate their ultimate skills, AOE/magic damage, and healing spells with precision timing to defend your position!
5. High-quality audio-visual effects. Incredibly immersive.
Realistically magical 3D models of heroes fleshed with exquisite details. Top-tier motion and facial capture technologies make your heroes incredibly vivid and lifelike.
With premium CG and character designs in 360°, players will fall in love with customized animations which bring each hero to life.
6. Massive multiplayer PvP battles.
Original tower defense PvP mode will showcase your skills. With multiple PvP themes, you can climb player rankings and fight your way straight to the top!
7. Grand worldview, rich storylines.
Explore a range of chapters, maps, and levels. Epic faction and hero lore will provide you an immersive experience into the world of Tya’s magic. Each hero has a unique backstory waiting for you to discover!
Please Note:
*Watcher of Realms supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, and Russian. We understand that RPGs are always more immersive to players in their native languages, so we are working hard on adding more languages to the game!
Official Website: https://www.watcherofrealms.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WatcherofRealms/
Discord: https://discord.gg/Vn8UpGF
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@WatcherofRealmsOfficial
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/WatcherofRealmsGame/

bluejetty:00096134:ios.description:
Discover the fascinating world of rocks, minerals, crystals, and gemstones with Rock Identifier — your smart rock identification and analysis app.
Simply take a photo of any rock, mineral, crystal, or gemstone, and get instant identification using advanced image recognition. Learn the stone’s name, hardness (Mohs scale), physical properties, crystal type, and similar stones in seconds.
Beyond identification, Rock Identifier helps you understand a stone’s potential value and authenticity indicators. Explore estimated value ranges, rarity information, and visual clues that may help distinguish natural stones from imitations or treated crystals.
Whether you’re a collector checking a gemstone, a student learning geology, or someone wondering if a found stone is real or fake, Rock Identifier gives you clear, educational insights you can trust.
From common minerals like quartz and calcite to rare crystals and valuable gemstones, gain knowledge, background, and comparison data — all in one powerful rock scanner app.
Perfect for rockhounds, collectors, students, hobbyists, and nature lovers, Rock Identifier turns curiosity into confidence.
Key Features:
• Instant rock, mineral, crystal & gemstone identification
• Detailed info: name, hardness, properties, and structure
• Estimated gemstone value ranges & rarity insights
• Authenticity indicators to help spot imitations or treatments
• Compare similar stones & common look-alikes
• Discover natural vs synthetic stone characteristics
• Save favorites and build your personal collection
• Ideal for learning, collecting, and outdoor exploration
Premium Features:
• Fake vs Real analysis
• Stone value estimation
• Unlimited scans

bluejetty:00035867:ios.summary: Acorns Early (formerly GoHenry) is the smart money app and debit card for your kids that teaches them financial wellness and the value of money. Young people aged 6-18 can learn about earning, saving, and smart spending with features like a
bluejetty:00035867:ios.description:
Acorns Early (formerly GoHenry) is the smart money app and debit card for your kids that teaches them financial wellness and the value of money. Young people aged 6-18 can learn about earning, saving, and smart spending with features like automated allowance, task lists, and gamified educational quizzes and videos. Then they can practice their skills in the real world with their own debit card. All while parents watch and guide with flexible parental controls.
ACORNS EARLY FEATURES:
- AUTOMATED ALLOWANCE
Automated weekly allowance teaches budgeting skills and that once their money is gone, it's gone.
- SAVING & BUDGETING
Make saving a habit with child-led savings goals that parents can lock and unlock.
- IN-APP TASK LISTS
Teach the power of earning by sending rewards for completed chores.
- BITE-SIZED LESSONS
Boost your child's financial literacy with in-app Money Missions. On average, kids add 30% more to their savings in the first month after completing one.
- THEIR OWN PREPAID CARD
Your child can practice their new skills in the real world with their own kids' debit card — and choose from 45+ designs.
- TRAVEL ABROAD FEE-FREE
One less thing to worry about on vacation with fee-free transactions overseas.
- ATM WITHDRAWAL
Heading somewhere that only takes cash? Your child can withdraw money at ATMs.
ACORNS EARLY PARENT FEATURES:
- QUICK AND EASY TRANSFERS
Send money anytime with scheduled allowance and instant transfers.
- INCENTIVIZE CHORES
Set task lists and send rewards for completed chores.
- SPENDING VISIBILITY
Track your kid's money with real-time notifications straight to your phone.
- FLEXIBLE CONTROLS
Choose when, where, and how much your child spends — and change your preferences anytime in-app.
- FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Friends and family can send money straight to your child's card with Giftlinks and Relatives accounts.
- GIVING MADE EASY
Teach your child the value of helping others with optional charitable donations in-app.
ACORNS EARLY TEEN EXTRA FEATURES: YOU`LL NEED A PARENT OR GUARDIAN TO SIGN YOU UP
- THE ACCOUNT THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Grow your independence with a smart debit card and 13+ account with features just for teens.
- SPLIT THE BILL

bluejetty:00082849:ios.description:
WT Scan web for Web Scanner is the best tool to seamlessly manage multiple web accounts on a single device. WT Scan enhances your privacy by allowing you to hide your online last seen status, hide blue ticks, disable read receipts, and view your friend's status privately. Easily open popular dual social media apps on a single device, and initiate chats by typing the number without saving it. Explore all that WT Scan web has to offer!
► Looking for New Features?
- Struggling to manage two phones for work and personal social accounts?
- Want to hide your last seen status?
- Prefer reading messages from notifications without others knowing?
- Need to view status/stories anonymously?
- Wish to chat directly without saving numbers?
- Seeking a private browser for incognito surfing?
- Want to manage more than one web account on a single device?
WT Scan is here for You!
New Features in WT Scan App:
► Multiple Web Account Management:
Effortlessly switch between accounts on your iPhone and stay connected without frequent logins and logouts. Enjoy fast chat loading and a smooth user experience with light/dark mode options.
► Privacy Protection:
Enable privacy mode in the Web Scanner Dual Chat to hide read receipts, check marks, blue ticks, and last seen status. View status/stories without notifying others.
► Link Generator:
Create message links with ease! Enter the recipient's phone number and a pre-filled message to generate a clickable link that opens with your message ready to send.
► Dual Apps Space / Parallel App:
Clone popular social media apps and manage work and personal accounts on a single device. Enjoy independent data storage, separate notifications, and prevent interference between web accounts.
► Private Browsing:
Enjoy fast, secure, private web browsing. Features include anonymous browsing history, private search, encrypted data traffic (HTTPS Everywhere), script and cookie blocking, and incognito tabs.
► Passcode Protection:
Secure your dual social media apps, chats with a PIN to lock WT Scan and keep your private space safe from unauthorized access.
► Personal Notes:
Take notes with a simple, unlimited note-taking utility. Create, edit text notes with no length or number limits, constrained only by your phone's storage.
► Reverse Text Generator:
Easily reverse text for fun messages, secret encoding, or experimenting with text formats. Reverse words, sentences, or entire paragraphs.
► World Prefixes:
Quickly add country codes to phone numbers. Just search and tap the desired country code to add it before calling or saving a number, without manual entry.
Subscription Information:
- Monthly Subscription - $9.99
- Yearly Subscription - $29.99 
- Lifetime In-App Purchase - $49.99
- Payments will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of renewal will be determined.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and automatic updates can be disabled by going to the user account settings after purchase.
- During the active subscription period, the current subscription cannot be canceled.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to this publication, if applicable.

bluejetty:00025606:ios.description:
Blocky Quest – A real blockbuster!
► New kid on the block 
If you’re a fan of block puzzles, then welcome to a brand-new block puzzle game offering a unique and refreshing twist on the classic gameplay and format. Download Blocky Quest now and dive into an awesome, never-ending block party of a game!
The features block:
◾ A chip off the old block: Packed with features and beautifully designed, Blocky Quest takes a legend and runs with it, providing a rewarding and addictive puzzle experience for players young and old, bricks game is fanatics and all fans of challenging and dynamic brainteasers.
◾ The blocks don’t drop: Unlike in traditional building block games, in Blocky Quest you don’t have to fit the blocks on the board as they fall. In fact, you’ve got all the time in the world to try to find the best position. This makes the game more like a jigsaw puzzle, but it doesn’t make it any less fun or infuriating.
◾ The twist is… There’s no twisting! In contrast with other brick games, you can’t turn the blocks around here, you have to work out how to fit them together along the axis they appear. Unless you’re ready to use boosters, that is…
◾ Feeling blocked? Blocky Quest features a range of boosters to help you out of tough spots in puzzles. Earn up to five different types of boosters as you play, then use them to twist, blast, sweep or slam your way past whatever’s blocking your next move.
◾ Feeling adventurous? Alongside classic gameplay, where you can keep slotting the blocks into place endlessly to carry on surviving and achieve a new high score, there are also quests, where levels have specific goals and winning multiple levels brings you chests with extra rewards.
◾ On a quest: Can you match all the blocks with the right gems to reach the target? Or will you be able to puzzle out the mess on the board at the start of the level and get the necessary score? If not, you’ll just have to try again to pass the brick game levels and complete the quest. The rewards are worth it!
► On a quest for a great puzzle game?
Looking for a new take on classic games with fun new features, addictive gameplay, and stylish packaging? Blocky Quest is guaranteed to rock your block, combining tried and tested puzzle features from much-loved old games with genuinely original and engaging new mechanics that will test your puzzle brain and your spatial awareness, while also providing a relaxing and absorbing gameplay environment to soothe stress and help you relax whenever you have a spare five minutes. Install Blocky Quest now and get ready to set out on a real puzzle adventure!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00076192:ios.description:
iBoard Pro, the cutting-edge trading platform brought to you by SSI Securities Corporation, Vietnam's premier securities company. With our platform, you can experience the latest advancements in trading technology, empowering you to make informed investment decisions and seize opportunities in the financial markets.
Expand Your Investment Horizon: Buy and Sell a Variety of Securities
Your all-in-one solution for seamless and efficient trading in the financial markets. With our app, you can expand your investment horizon by buying and selling a wide range of equities, corporate bonds, and derivatives. Empower yourself to take control of your investments and capitalize on market opportunities like never before.
Real-Time Insights and In-Depth Analysis: Technical Charts and Market Information
Experience the power of real-time technical charts and insightful market information right at your fingertips. Stay informed and make informed decisions with up-to-the-minute data. Dive deep into detailed company profiles, enabling you to understand the fundamentals and potential of each investment opportunity.
Stay in Control: Personalized Watchlist and Alerts for Tailored Trading
Take personalization to the next level with our personalized watchlist and alert feature. Tailor your trading experience by curating a list of your preferred stocks, covered warrants, ETFs and derivatives. Stay updated with the latest price movements and never miss an opportunity to act on your investment strategies.
Professional Portfolio and Asset Management Made Easy
iBoard Pro goes beyond trading capabilities, offering professional portfolio and asset management tools. Easily track and manage your investments with comprehensive portfolio analysis and reporting. Gain valuable insights into your holdings, diversify your investments, and optimize your wealth management strategies.
Hassle-Free Cash Transactions
We understand the importance of convenience when it comes to managing your finances. iBoard Pro provides a seamless and secure platform for cash transactions. Whether you need to deposit funds or withdraw profits, our app ensures hassle-free financial transactions with just a few taps.
Diversify Your Investments: Explore S-Products
In addition to equity and derivatives trading, our app offers S-Products, a range of financial services related to fixed income and others. Diversify your investment portfolio and maximize your potential returns.

Magoosh has helped thousands of students ace the Law School Admission Test (LSAT), and our app is updated and ready for the 2024 LSAT changes. With Magoosh, you get a straightforward and effective way to prepare for your LSAT test, right from your phone or tablet.

Real Practice, Real Progress

Videos That Teach You Fast
=======================
• Watch over 5 hours of video lessons on every section of the LSAT. These lessons make hard topics easy.

Study Your Way, Anywhere
======================

• Read helpful articles and get support from tutors.

===============================
• Proven Success: Thousands have used our apps to prepare for the LSAT.
• Official Test Questions: Practice with questions and tests from LSAC - the makers of the LSAT.
• 80+ Practice Tests: Full-length adaptive practice tests just like what you’ll get on test day
• Score Guarantee: Increase your score by at least 5 points or your money back
• Easy to Use: Our app makes studying simple and keeps you motivated.
• Start studying with Magoosh today and take a step closer to the LSAT score you need. 
It's your time to shine!

bluejetty:00118733:ios.description:
Major new updates:
Collaborate and share your files in PDF Spaces, and turn your document summaries into podcast-style audio in Acrobat Studio.
The world’s most trusted PDF reader, PDF editor, and PDF maker with more than 635 million installs. View, share, annotate, add comments, and sign documents - all in one app. You can store your files online and read documents anywhere.
Get your 7-day free trial and try all the features of Acrobat Reader.
Paid features:
Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant
• Work across multiple files in one place with PDF Spaces. Collaborate, store, and use AI Assistant across files
• Use voice or text prompts with AI Assistant chatbot
• Ask questions and get cited answers about details in your document, including charts, graphs, and tables with Figures Q&A
• Easily share the responses you get
• Try voice support to ask queries and have answers read aloud.
• Use new Hands-free to keep the conversation flowing with voice only
• Instantly generate summaries from your PDFs with Generative AI Summaries
• Get content for emails, text, study notes, blogs, and more
[Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant is a paid feature*, free for a limited time]
Edit PDFs
• With our PDF editor, edit text and images directly in your PDF (mobile only)
• Fix typos or add paragraphs with the PDF editor
• Easily add, delete, or rotate any image
• Use this PDF signer and PDF viewer to get your docs just right
Recognize text
• Optical Character Recognition (OCR) turns scanned PDFs into searchable, editable text to use in other formats
Merge & organize PDFs with PDF Converter
• Split or combine multiple files into one PDF with PDF converter
• Use the PDF editor to insert, delete, rotate, crop & reorder pages in your PDF file
Create, convert & export PDFs
• Easily convert to PDF from any file type including Microsoft, Google Docs, and images
• Export and convert PDFs to Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or various image files
• Convert web pages to PDFs
Compress & highly secure PDFs
• Compress PDF files for easy saving and sharing
• Password Protect PDF documents
Have your PDF read aloud
• Listen to your PDFs on the go, great for reading support
• Choose free voices or upgrade for high-quality options
Subscribe now to access all these features and use Acrobat across mobile and web platforms.
Free-to-use features:
PDF signer: Fill & Sign
Adobe Fill & Sign is free & available in Acrobat Reader. A form filler and PDF signer that lets you fill, sign, and send
Liquid mode in the optimal PDF viewer
• Get the best PDF reading experience with this PDF viewer
• Search, navigate & adjust font size or spacing to fit your screen
Annotate PDFs
• Add sticky notes, comments, and highlight text
Store & manage files
• Link online storage accounts like Microsoft OneDrive, Dropbox, or Google Drive
• Star files to quickly open important documents
Connect the PDF viewer and reader to Google Drive
• A PDF creator that lets you edit, compress, and export Google Drive files with a subscription
Work with scanned documents
• Access scanned PDFs from Adobe Scan in Acrobat to fill, sign, and share
The Acrobat Reader mobile app is designed to work with customers who have Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM) enabled.
*An Adobe Acrobat AI Assistant add-on plan is available to Acrobat Individual customers. iOS 16 or above required.
Terms & Conditions: Your use of this application is governed by the Adobe General Terms of Use http://www.adobe.com/go/terms_linkfree_en and the Adobe Privacy Policy http://www.adobe.com/go/privacy_policy_linkfree_en
Do not sell or share my personal information www.adobe.com/go/ca-rights-linkfree

bluejetty:00085633:ios.description:
Client fixe, mobile, ou les deux ? Avec la nouvelle application Bouygues Telecom, vous pouvez vous identifier rapidement par reconnaissance faciale ou empreinte digitale. 
Consommation, factures, forfaits et abonnements… Toutes vos informations essentielles sont visibles en un clin d’œil, et accessibles en un clic sur votre écran d’accueil personnalisable.
Mais la nouvelle application Bouygues Telecom, c’est aussi…
- Le suivi de votre consommation 
Que vous soyez chez vous, quelque part en France, ou à l’étranger, avec la nouvelle application Bouygues Telecom vous suivez votre consommation en temps réel, où que vous soyez. Un service pratique, mobile, qui vous permet d’ajouter des recharges et des options, en fonction des variations de votre consommation.
- La gestion de vos forfaits & vos abonnements  
Vous avez besoin de savoir ce qui est inclus dans votre forfait ou celui de vos proches ? Rendez-vous dans la rubrique « Mes lignes » pour accéder au détail de vos offres.
- Votre nouvelle boutique en ligne
Vous cherchez un nouvel abonnement, un forfait mieux adapté avec de nouveaux équipements et des options sur mesure ?  Notre boutique en ligne vous propose un choix varié et personnalisé.
- Votre assistance sur mesure
Grâce à la nouvelle application Bouygues Telecom vous bénéficiez d’un accès direct à nos services d’assistance et à la messagerie instantanée. Téléphone égaré ? L’Assistance mobile est là pour vous accompagner. Besoin de piloter, d’installer ou de dépanner votre Bbox ? Mon Assistant Bbox est là pour vous guider.
- L’accès permanent à vos factures 
N’importe où, n’importe quand, elles peuvent être téléchargées ou consultées. Et si besoin, vous avez également la possibilité de régler vos dernières factures.
- La gestion de votre WiFi optimisée  
L’espace "Gérer ma Bbox" vous permet de personnaliser votre mot de passe WiFi et de le partager avec votre entourage.  Le contrôle du réseau vous permet aussi, de sécuriser et contrôler plus facilement l’accès internet de vos enfants.
- La géolocalisation de votre technicien Bouygues Telecom
Vous avez un rendez-vous prévu avec un technicien ? Avec notre service de géolocalisation, vous pouvez suivre son arrivée en temps réel, être averti en cas de retard, et noter la qualité de l’intervention directement depuis votre application.

bluejetty:00152456:ios.name: Rugby Nations 26
bluejetty:00152456:ios.summary: Rugby Nations 26 puts you at the heart of the action. Build your team and take on the best teams from around the world. Play through every ruck, maul, and bitterly contested try as you rise through the ranks and carve out your place among R
bluejetty:00152456:ios.description:
Rugby Nations 26 puts you at the heart of the action. Build your team and take on the best teams from around the world. Play through every ruck, maul, and bitterly contested try as you rise through the ranks and carve out your place among Rugby Legends.
CORE GAMEPLAY
Jackaling and bump-offs keep the momentum of the match flowing, while charge down kicks and calling mark give you greater control of the defensive side of the sport. Adaptive intercepts add more risk to those clutch plays but make it all the more rewarding to steal possession of the ball in this highly immersive rugby simulator.
CLUB MODE 2.0
Choose your team's country of origin and take on local teams all the way up to national Rugby Legends. Move up the ladder, gain promotion to challenging higher leagues, and battle it out in the playoffs to become champions. Take part in inter-season tournaments and face teams from around the world.
KIT DESIGNER
A complete overhaul to the kit designer allows you to give your team their own unique identity. Mix and match all new designs, selecting individual colours for every aspect of your kit from collar to boot. Design a kit your team can wear with pride as you score epic tries and celebrate your victories on the pitch.
MATCH PRESENTATION
Match commentary makes each game feel like a moment in Rugby Union history, highlighting all your masterful plays during gameplay. Listen as the crowd goes wild, filling the stadium with an atmosphere never felt before on mobile. Animated Scoreboards respond to your epic plays, pre-match sequences show off your team roster, and end-of-match statistics spotlight your top players. All that, along with an expanded portfolio of celebration and gameplay match cutscenes, further immerses you in the action.
IMPROVED REALISM
Varied weather and time of day add more possibilities to each match as you play from dawn through dusk during scattered showers, intense snow or foggy conditions. New stadium surroundings and a greater variety of players help breathe new life into each match, making each match feel different, with enhanced grass rendering coating the pitch with a fresh layer of detail, bringing the Rugby simulation to life like never before.
Download Rugby Nations 26 now and bring the intensity of match day anytime, anywhere!
KEY FEATURES
- New gameplay mechanics: Jackaling, Bump Offs, Charge Down Kicks, Calling Mark, Set Plays, Adaptive Intercepts
- Club Mode 2.0
- Overhauled Kit Designer
- Match Commentary ( English )
- New Animated Scorecards and various Statistic Screens
- New Celebrations and Gameplay Cutscenes 
- New Weather Conditions and added variety in Time of Day
- New Stadium Surroundings and additional Player Variety 
- Enhanced Grass Rendering
- Play in the World Cup, Four Nations and Six Nations Modes
- Build and Manage your own Rugby Team
- Play both sides of the sport with Men’s and Women’s Rugby 
…and so much more!
FREE TO PLAY
Rugby Nations 26 is free to download and play, with optional in-app purchases available to enhance your experience.

bluejetty:00016378:ios.description:
What would your life be without modern technology on the deserted island? Dive into simplicity of the primal world with the modern Stone Age family in this thrilling offline adventure game. Stranded on the remote island, a family of four - Bruce, Eva and their kids - needs your guidance and help starting a new family home from scratch and navigating through various family life situations with humour. 
After their previous city had been destroyed by a volcanic eruption, help this family build a thriving town, all while looking for a way to reconnect with their family and beloved tribe. In this farm game, their world might seem ancient and alien without modern day technology, yet their daily family life and relationships are very relatable in today’s world.
Family Island™ is a farm game full of unexpected twists and captivating adventure! 
FEATURES:
- Enjoy your adventure to the Stone Age era! Get creative and start farming, using cool ancient technologies 
- In this farm game, you can unleash your inner explorer and set on a thrilling adventure to new islands 
- Start your own family farm on the deserted island! Grow crops and craft useful goods to trade with other characters
- Customize your farm with beautiful decorations
- Get to know the family better and guide them through exciting quests and life stories in this island game

bluejetty:00177782:ios.summary:
UBS TWINT is the most widely used mobile payment app in Switzerland: send and receive money digitally with your smartphone – discover the advantages of contactless payment with UBS TWINT. 
With well over one million registrations, UBS TWIN
bluejetty:00177782:ios.description:
UBS TWINT is the most widely used mobile payment app in Switzerland: send and receive money digitally with your smartphone – discover the advantages of contactless payment with UBS TWINT. 
With well over one million registrations, UBS TWINT is the Swiss no. 1 mobile payment service and Switzerland’s digital cash. Paying digitally, sending money directly to or receiving money from friends has never been easier. Paying for parking without coins or shopping at Coop and Migros without cash is no problem via the app.
WHAT TWINT CAN DO
Pay cashless at the register: Conveniently pay cashless with your smartphone in the store, restaurant, farm shop, etc., at any card terminal with QR codes.
Send, receive and request money: Send, request and receive money quickly and securely via smartphone to and from friends, family and colleagues.
Pay in online stores: Save valuable time when shopping online, scan the QR code at checkout, or switch to the TWINT app to authorize the payment.
In-app payment: Save TWINT as a secure method of payment in other apps, such as SBB, Fairtiq, Migros and many more.
KeyClub points: Collect valuable points when paying via TWINT using the registered UBS Credit Card.
Pay parking fees: Pay parking fees at public parking lots by using location tracking in the app or QR code on the parking meter.
Vouchers & credit: Buy, send and receive digital vouchers and credit for yourself or as a gift with just a few clicks.
Donate: Donate money to Swiss aid organizations and their projects for charitable purposes.
Withdraw cash: Sometimes you can only pay with cash. That’s why TWINT has integrated “Sonect.” It allows you to get cash quickly and easily using the “Withdraw cash” feature, 
without the need for an ATM.
Benefit from Super Deals: Every week you can benefit from new discount offers in the “Super Deals” partner feature.
Order coffee: Order new coffee supplies directly in TWINT using the app or the QR code on the Nespresso machine.
. . . and much more.
SECURE IS SECURE
• Meets the security standards of Swiss banks
• All data remains in Switzerland
• Protected by 6-digit PIN or fingerprint
• The UBS TWINT account can be blocked at any time
UBS Switzerland AG has only made the UBS TWINT app (“app”) available to the following persons, for whom it was exclusively designed: For (i) existing clients of UBS Switzerland AG and existing clients of other non-US subsidiaries of UBS Group AG who are domiciled in Switzerland, and (ii) natural persons who are domiciled in Switzerland. The fact that the app can be downloaded from non-Swiss app stores does not constitute an invitation, offer or recommendation to enter into a transaction, nor should it be construed as an invitation or offer to enter into a client relationship between the person downloading the app and UBS Group AG companies. The app is not intended for and cannot be used by persons resident in Australia or the USA.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
http://www.ubs.com/twint

bluejetty:00041503:ios.summary:
Check your heart rate with your phone camera. Rest a fingertip on the camera for about 20 seconds, or look into the front camera for a face scan. Unlimited free readings, no watch or chest strap.
Heart racing, pounding or fluttering? Take
bluejetty:00041503:ios.description:
Check your heart rate with your phone camera. Rest a fingertip on the camera for about 20 seconds, or look into the front camera for a face scan. Unlimited free readings, no watch or chest strap.
Heart racing, pounding or fluttering? Take a reading the moment it happens, note how you felt, and build a history you can show your doctor.
Three ways to measure
• Fingertip: a reading in about 20 seconds, with your heart wave drawn live
• Face scan: look into the front camera and keep still
• Deep scan (Premium): a 60 second fingertip reading with a beat-to-beat steadiness score out of 100
Learn your usual range
After 5 days of resting readings, AccuRate learns your usual range. Every new reading is compared with it, so you can see when your heart rate is higher or lower than usual for you.
Note what was happening
Add how you feel, what you were doing and your position to each reading. When something feels off, look back and see how often it happens and what came before it.
Trends and history
• Week, month and year charts of resting and active heart rate
• Time spent in each heart rate zone
• Filter your history by how each reading was taken
• Export a PDF with each reading's heart wave, or a CSV file, to share with your doctor
Guided tests (Premium)
• Heart rate variability (HRV), 1 min: daily readiness from your heart
• Orthostatic heart rate, 8 min: how your heart adapts when you stand
• Heart rate recovery, 3 min: how fast your heart settles after effort
• VO₂ max, 6 min: an estimate of your aerobic fitness
Results are compared with people your age.
Works with your Apple devices
• Saves readings to the Health app
• Apple Watch app
• Home Screen widget
Heart rate zones
On every active reading, AccuRate works out your zone from your maximum heart rate: Resting, Recovery, Fat burning, Aerobic, Hard or Maximum.
Typical resting heart rate
According to the Mayo Clinic, a typical resting heart rate for adults is 60 to 100 bpm. Activity, fitness, stress, caffeine and emotion all move it. Talk to your doctor if your resting rate stays above 100 bpm, or below 60 bpm when you are not a trained athlete.
AccuRate Premium
Unlock the deep scan and all four guided tests, with no ads. Start with a 7 day free trial. Cancel any time in Settings.
Important
• AccuRate is a wellness app, not a medical device.
• It doesn't check heart rhythm or diagnose any condition.
• If you're worried about your heart, talk to your doctor. If you have chest pain, call emergency services.
Terms of Use: https://www.oxford-fitness.com/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.oxford-fitness.com/privacy.html

Our customer service team answers questions about your orders and parcels.

bluejetty:00062246:ios.description:
From the award-winning creators of Studycat for Schools, comes Learn Spanish! The #1 way for kids to learn español!
From preschool and beyond, Learn Spanish by Studycat inspires children's innate love of learning with interactive games and activities.
Our bite-sized lessons will keep your child motivated while they discover a new language and build bilingual skills for a lifetime!
WHY STUDYCAT?
• Learn Spanish, in Spanish. All our activities focus on virtual language immersion, which means your child won't be hearing any English, only Spanish! This might be confusing at first, but trust us, it's the best way to learn.
• Everyday Language. Our lessons teach words and expressions that kids can apply in their everyday lives, so they can get a head start developing their bilingual abilities.
• Get Talking Fast. With our interactive speaking challenges, kids will be encouraged to speak entire words and phrases on their own! The earlier kids start their language-learning journey, the more likely they are to reach proficiency quickly.
• Vocal Variety. Our characters' voices use different tones, expressions, and accents so that kids can pick up on the subtleties of pronunciation from different speakers.
• Designed by Experts. All our activities are designed by language and early-education experts. Thoughtfully developed lessons will build your child's confidence with every step.
• Learner Profiles. Create up to four personalized profiles for different family members, allowing tailored learning paths and individual progress tracking.
• Safe for Kids & Ad-Free. Parents can rest easy knowing that there are no pesky ads to distract children from their learning. All content is appropriate for ages 3 and up.
• Offline Learning. On a plane, at a restaurant, or in a park? No problem! Learn Spanish by Studycat is available for both online and offline use.
WHAT ARE PARENTS SAYING?
“Children can follow their natural curiosity and walk away with a basic Spanish vocabulary and not even realize it!” — Spanish Hackers
“As a parent trying to raise bilingual children at home, Learn Spanish by Studycat is a helpful app to start them off and create excitement about the language.” — Fluent in 3 Months
“Everything has been thought out carefully and the games and activities are really engaging.” — Bilingual Kidspot
--
If you like Learn Spanish by Studycat, try it out for 7 days free! Empower your child to learn like never before, and get extras like printable worksheets and animated stories.
