bluejetty:00041196:ios.description:
Achieve your goals with Australia's most trusted health and fitness 
12 Week Body Transformation Program.
Easily plan and cook healthy meals, smash a workout or reset your 
mindset anywhere, anytime!
SIGN UP TO ACCESS
- Weekly nutrition plans designed by leading dieticians 
(customisable for you and your family!)
- 100's of tailored exercises and express workouts (home + gym 
options)
- Practical mindset video lessons
- 1,300+ delicious and budget-friendly recipes
- Shopping list integration 
- 12WBT’s ”My Tracker” to stay accountable
- Calorie Lookup Index – and more!
- Signup requires in-app purchase to enrol in a 12 weeks round. After successful payment, account is created to enjoy all services and features mentioned above.
THE 12 WEEK PROGRAM
- An easy to follow program tailored to your health, weight loss or 
fitness goals. You just need to turn up and do them!
- Supports various fitness levels with 15 different programs, from 
Weight Loss to Post Baby, Running, Strength and Toning.
- Enjoy dietitian and fitness expert access
- Connect with other members through an exclusive group page
- New and seasonal content released every Round
Michelle Bridges is one of Australia’s most influential personal 
trainers, a best-selling fitness, nutrition and mindset author and a 
national commentator on health and wellness issues.
Drawing on almost four decades of experience, she knows what 
works! 
Her mission is to make it as easy as possible for people to 
incorporate healthy change into their lifestyle and to be the best 
possible version of themselves.
Join nearly half a million 12WBTers who’ve become healthier and 
fitter with ALL THE ESSENTIAL TOOLS to kick your goals!
WHAT MEMBERS SAY:
“If you look at a lifetime and look back, twelve weeks is so small. So, 
to only take twelve weeks to change your complete lifestyle... it's a 
fantastic feeling... It really has changed my life” - Josh Day
“I love it. It just works and the support by both members and the 
12WBT team make it all worth while.” - Donna Barnes
“I’m totally stoked with the program! The meal plans are amazing, 
the workouts are easy to follow and fun. For the first time in 4 years 
I’m under 70kgs” - Ree Hutchings
YOUR PLANNER - All the thinking’s been done so you’re always 
organised and ready to go with weekly Meal and Exercise Plans. 
Easily customise your program – from various dietary preferences, 
time saving plans and equipment-free exercises.
YOUR TRAINER - Enjoy step-by-step workouts at home or in the 
gym. You choose!
YOUR NUTRITIONIST - With recipes designed by leading Australian
dietitians, learn how to cook nutritionally balanced AND delicious 
meals with your health goals in mind.
YOUR TRACKER - Easily track your exercise, meals, calories, water, 
sleep and mindset to keep yourself accountable and to stay on top of
your goals.
YOUR MOTIVATOR - Michelle Bridges, Australia’s highly regarded 
health and fitness expert and former trainer on ‘The Biggest Loser’, 
with her team of leading dietitians and coaches, will be with you 
every step of the way! 
12WBT will help keep you focused and excited about healthy eating 
and regularly exercising.

The Home of All Fours - All Fours Trini Card Game by CardsClan.com
THE LARGEST ALL FOURS COMMUNITY
Join 125,000+ registered players and a community that has played millions and millions of All Fours games. With players online every day, there is always someone ready to play.
Play All Fours online with real players, challenge smart AI, play with friends, build your own clan, track your games, and become part of the growing All Fours community.
Built specifically for Caribbean players, CardsClan brings the true strategy, competition, culture, and social experience of Trinidad All Fours to your mobile device.
PLAY ALL FOURS ONLINE
Join live multiplayer games with real players from Trinidad, the Caribbean, and around the world. Meet new players, challenge your friends, and put your All Fours skills to the test.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Invite your friends and start playing together. Use Start Now to quickly get into a game, or create private games for the people you know.
CREATE OR JOIN CLANS
Create or join clans and build your own All Fours community. Invite friends, chat with clan members, track clan scores, and compete together.
AUTHENTIC TRINIDAD ALL FOURS
Experience the classic Trinidad-style All Fours you know and love, with gameplay designed around the rules, strategy, and competitive spirit of the game.
LEARN WITH OUR INTERACTIVE TUTORIAL
New to All Fours? Our interactive tutorial helps beginners learn the rules, scoring, cards, and strategy while getting familiar with the game.
PLAY AGAINST SMART AI
Practice your skills offline against intelligent computer opponents. Choose from multiple difficulty levels and improve your game before taking on real players.
GUEST PLAY
Want to try the game before creating an account? Jump into games as a guest and start playing. When you're ready, become a full player and build your profile and stats.
GAME HISTORY & GAME LOG
Review your past games and see exactly what happened during each match. Study your plays, review the game log, and learn from every hand.
CUSTOM RULES
Play All Fours your way with expanded custom rules and settings. Create the type of game you enjoy playing with your friends and family.
CHAT & SOCIAL FEATURES
Connect with the community through Global and Clan chat, while Table Chat lets you communicate with other players during your game.
BUILD YOUR PLAYER PROFILE
Create your own identity in the All Fours community. Track your stats, games, progress, and achievements as you improve.
INVITE YOUR FRIENDS
Bring your friends into the game and grow your own All Fours community.
MORE GAMES. MORE WAYS TO PLAY.
CardsClan is growing beyond All Fours. Dominos is now available, bringing more of the games you grew up playing to the platform.
Play Partners, Cut Throat, French, and Six Love — the classic games you know from playing at home, with friends and family.
Play the games you grew up with. Play with your friends. Play like you're at home.
100% MADE IN TRINIDAD & TOBAGO
All Fours Trini Card Game is proudly 100% locally made in Trinidad & Tobago by local developers.
By downloading and playing the game, you're supporting local developers and helping us continue building technology, games, and online communities right here at home and across the Caribbean.
Play. Compete. Improve. Never Give Up.
Join the largest All Fours community today.

bluejetty:00024185:ios.description:
Love Photo Frames Collage is an app to create personalized love photo collages by adding your own photos.
You can use a great variety of frames for love photos, with which you can create some beautiful designs and love collages to tell a beloved person how much you love him or her.
How to use the app “Love Photo Frames Collage ”
We have developed a complete love photo collage maker for you, with which you can decorate love photos and give them your personal touch:
1.- The first step is to choose the kind of love collage photo frame you would like to use. For your convenience, we have divided the available frames into different categories, so that you can design the best personalised photo frame collage for every occasion: frames with hearts, love frames with animals, valentine day photo frames, flower photo frames, rose photo frames, wedding photo frames, couple photo frames, anniversary photo frames, romantic photo frames, etc.
2.- Once you have chosen the frame category you would like to use, you can browse through the different love frames for photos you can find in that section.
3.- Once you have selected the frame you like, you will have to add your photo to the love collage you will design. You can use the photo gallery of your mobile device or the camera to take a photo at that moment. Remember that you can move, rotate or resize the image you would like to add so that your photos perfectly fit in into any of the love collage frames you can find in the app.
4.- In the last 2 steps you can add personalized texts to your add the text you like (and say “I love you”, “Happy anniversary” or whatever you like). Additionally, you can add love photos or stickers/badges to give your love collage a personalized finishing touch.
The last step of this process will be to download or share your personalized love photos with your partner, with your friends or the person you love. You can send it via messaging apps, social networks, SMS, email and any other app you have on your phone or tablet.
As you can see, this photo frame app for free allows you to create some love collages in a very quick and easy way.
Main characteristics of the app “Love Photo Frames Collage ”:
- Personalized love frames for pictures, organized by category. Find your perfect frame for every occasion.
- Complete photo frame editor for love photo frames with which you can make photo collages with beautiful photo frames and your own photos. Add texts, stickers, filters, decorate photos, etc.
- Share your photo collages and love pictures with your partner, the person you love or with the person you want to make fall in love with you.
We hope that you like this love frame app. If you liked it, we would appreciate if you could give this app a positive review. This will help us to keep maintaining the app and add new improvements and features.
Premium Features:
- Ad-free experience for uninterrupted editing.
- Remove watermarks and export high-quality images.
- Access exclusive photo frames for special occasions.
- Advanced text tools with multiple font styles.
- Premium stickers and decorative elements for creative designs.
Legal notice/Disclaimer:
All designs used on this app have been created by exclusive designers for Reticode, therefore the commercial use of any image included in the program is prohibited without the previous authorization of Reticode.
For some designs we have used images from public domain since they are not identified in any way that indicates the existence of exploitation rights reserved thereon.
Any natural or legal person who was the owner of any images contained herein, may accredit through reticode@gmail.com, committing to the immediate withdrawal of the image after verification, if necessary, ownership of the image or protected sentence.
Terms: https://reticode.com/terms/terms-of-service-love-photo-frames.html
Privacy Policy: https://reticode.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00161445:ios.description:
PrayerMate helps you be faithful in prayer for the people and causes you care about.
Every day, PrayerMate will select a person or topic that you've entered from each of your main categories (perhaps "My family" or "My small group at church") and show them to you as a series of index cards - then just swipe between them to pray. It brings together prayer points you've entered manually, regular updates from a whole host of Christian charities and churches, PDF prayer letters and daily prayer pointers from "Operation World".
Prayer is one of the greatest privileges for the person of faith, and yet most of us wish we were better at it. Now when you say to someone "I'll pray for you!" you can make sure you follow it up.
Features:
* Intuitive index card interface lets you swipe between the day's topics
* Set up your own personal categories and subjects to suit the way you pray
* Subjects can be entered manually or directly from your address book contacts - no typing necessary!
* Privately share prayer requests with others in a trusted small group
* Subscribe to online prayer diaries, with content from organisations such as London City Mission, Open Doors, UCCF The Christian Unions, Church Society and numerous local churches (including your own if you like!)
* Operation World "country of the day" feed
* Get the Church of England Collect for the Day automatically
* Gallery of downloadable prayers, plus "Take Words With You" scriptural prayer builder
* Attach photos and PDFs to prayer points
* Import/Export via Dropbox
* Optional daily alarm clock to remind you to pray
* Prayer points can be scheduled by date, day of the week/month, or just whenever they haven't been prayed for in a while
* PIN code feature for added privacy
* Email or message the people you're praying for from within the app, or email prayer points to a group of friends
* Built-in help system
Become a PrayerMate Patron
PrayerMate is free to use but you maybe optionally sign up for a subscription to Become a PrayerMate Patron to support the continued development of the app through the "Settings" tab. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription will automatically renew (either every month or every year, depending on the subscription type you choose) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. In return you will receive access to additional colour scheme options so long as your subscription is active. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and will identify the cost of the renewal. You may manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iOS app store settings after purchase.
Full terms and conditions at https://www.prayermate.net/pages/app_terms_conditions

bluejetty:00145274:ios.description:
Discover the addictive charm of "Match Tile Decor", a puzzle game that combines matching tiles and decoration elements. Test your skills with increasingly challenging puzzles, sharpening your thinking and problem-solving abilities. Immerse yourself in a serene and captivating environment as you create your dream room.
Embark on an adventure filled with captivating match-style puzzles. Your objective is to clear the board by matching three tiles. Whether you're a fan of match-3 puzzles or the Match genre, "Match Tile Decor" offers a captivating and relaxing challenge. Match tiles, clear boards, and personalize your cozy room to embrace a soothing experience.
Get hooked on exploring new match tile puzzles daily, nurturing indoor plants, and mastering the art of matching. Our cutting-edge match game will keep you engaged as you progress through levels and become a true master. Say goodbye to dull moments with our exceptional and engaging tile matching puzzle game.
Game Highlights:
Engage Your Brain: Solve thousands of increasingly captivating match tile puzzles, starting from easy and gradually becoming more challenging.
Unwind and Relax: Enjoy addictive and ever-evolving match tile puzzles in a unique and serene gaming experience.
Take a Break and Have Fun: Solve puzzles and clear boards at your leisure, designed solely for your entertainment and relaxation.
Ignite Your Creativity: Design and decorate your own peaceful Zen space to achieve inner harmony.
Explore and Immerse: Delight in exploring tranquil backgrounds while matching tiles.
Build Unique Collections: Gather casual rooms, stunning backgrounds, and a wide variety of Zen tile decorations.
Immerse yourself in the world of "Match Tile Decor," where satisfaction and tranquility await. Download now and embark on a soothing journey of tile matching and decoration!
Need help? Contact us by sending an email to mtd-support@gamepromoltd.com
Learn more about the game on our Facebook Fan Page! https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100091584642038

bluejetty:00142438:ios.description:
ToDesk 是一款安全、稳定、超清、流畅的远程控制软件，累计支持用户数超过 3 亿，每月提供超过 50 亿分钟的安全连接时长。支持手机、平板、Mac 和 Windows 等设备远控 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android 等系统设备。全面支持最高 4K 超清画质与 144Hz 高帧率、3D 鼠标和游戏手柄、键盘和鼠标映射、高速文件传输、远程移动设备、多屏控多屏、虚拟屏、扩展屏和镜像屏等功能。
无论是移动远程办公、IT 运维、售后/技术支持，还是专业设计或剪辑、远程游戏、远程编程等高性能场景，ToDesk 都能为您提供接近本地操作的流畅远控体验，是广大远程办公者、自由职业者、企业团队的高效协同远程软件！
为什么选择 ToDesk？
●【跨平台无缝互连】
支持手机、平板、笔记本及台式机等全终端设备，在 Windows、macOS、Linux 与 Android 等主流系统间实现高效的双向互相控制，打破设备与系统壁垒，随时随地跨端流转。
●【全流程安全闭环】
我们视您的数据安全为生命线。ToDesk 打造涵盖“事前防范、事中保护、事后追溯”的远控安全闭环，采用端到端加密，提供移动端二次验证、黑白名单拦截、可定制隐私屏、实时连接通知、连接记录及强制锁屏密码校验，将控制权始终交还给您，全面保障远控安全。
●【自研 Zerosync 协议，更快更流畅】
搭载国内自研 RTC 技术的远控协议——Zerosync，可显著提升图片、视频传输及远程操作流畅度。依托全球 200+ 高速网络节点，支持连接全球海外设备，智能匹配更优线路，进一步提升远程传输速度与画质表现。
●【适配蓝牙键鼠，移动端秒变 PC】
全面支持手机或平板适配蓝牙键鼠操作。通过自研编解码技术实时传输高清画面，连接蓝牙键鼠后，即可打破设备限制，在移动端享受如操作实体电脑般便捷、高效的生产力体验。
●【原画级视效，外设满配】
专为高性能需求打造，视觉表现最高可达 4K 144Hz。支持映射 3D 空间鼠标、数位板及各类游戏手柄，支持 4:4:4 真彩画面和HDR画面传输，操作精准跟手。
●【海量设备，分组精细管理】
单个账号最高支持绑定 300 台设备！内置分组、置顶、搜索与多维筛选功能，让海量设备的管理井然有序。
核心使用场景
【远程办公与多屏协同】
外出或居家随时访问公司电脑。支持“多显示器切换”与“被控虚拟屏”功能，高度还原多屏工作环境。配合手机/平板对蓝牙键鼠的适配，让您在出差途中也能随时开启如操作电脑般顺畅的移动办公模式。
【IT 运维与设备管家】
一键开启远程终端、任务管理器及诊断日志。支持多通道远控（并发多会话）与 WOL 远程开机，在无人值守的情况下高效实现远程作业与终端设备排障。
【专业远程设计与创作】
基于 Zerosync 协议带来的传输提升，结合 4:4:4 真彩画面传输技术，搭配数位板压感与 3D 空间鼠标映射，让远程进行 3D 建模与高码率视频剪辑更加丝滑，灵感不掉线。
【远程游戏与掌上电竞】
手机秒变高配 PC。连接自己的远端电脑后，即可随时跨端畅玩 PC 游戏。4K 蓝光画质与最高 144 帧高帧率呈现，高清还原高帧游戏画面。支持百款定制化云键盘方案，多款游戏手柄即插即用，配合专属鼠标加速通道，移动端也能畅玩 3A 大作！
【远程会议与多人协作】
打破单向共享局限，支持“多人协作访问”，允许多方同时连接并操作同一台设备。配合白板批注、多人文字聊天、多人语音聊天，让复杂代码审阅或模型评审同频共振。
【远程协助与长辈帮扶】
手把手跨屏教父母使用手机。支持实时双向语音与文字聊天，边聊边操作，亲情关怀跨越距离，且连接全程安全可控。【仅支持部分安卓手机】
【极速文件快传】
高达 40MB/s 的全平台文件传输中心，支持拖拽秒传、批量发送与共享剪贴板，文件不限大小不限时长跨端跨系统进行传输，随时随地进行手机、电脑等多设备间文件互传。
【智能投屏与大屏分享】
一键将手机或电脑屏幕高清投射至另一台电脑或智能电视（TV端）等大屏设备，支持镜像屏和扩展屏。无论是会议室的 PPT 演示、家庭影音娱乐分享，还是硬核游戏画面展示，都能轻松搞定，畅享跨屏联动与大屏带来的极致视觉体验。
【跨屏监控与远程手机】
支持电脑直接远控 Android 手机（含系统功能键）；也可在被控设备授权并有明确提示的前提下，调用闲置设备的远程摄像头，化身智能监控，帮助看护空间安全。
如何快速开始？
只需简单 3 步，即可开启极速远程控制：
1. 安装软件：在您的主控端（如手机/平板）与被控端（如异地电脑）分别安装 ToDesk。
2. 获取代码：打开被控端设备上的 ToDesk，查看界面上显示的专属“设备代码”和“安全或临时密码”。
3. 一键连接：在主控端输入对应的代码与密码，点击连接，即可快速远程被控设备。
联系我们
官网：https://www.todesk.com/
公众号：ToDesk远程控制 / ToDesk
官方微博 / 抖音 / 小红书：ToDesk远程控制

● 个人版：免费使用，满足日常远控需求
● 专业版：连续包月每月29.9元

● 设计版：连续包月每月 49.9元

购买 ToDesk 连续包月的账号，会在到期前 24 小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺延一个月会员有效期。具体价格以 App Store 购买页面显示为准。
如需取消订阅，请手动打开苹果手机“设置”-> 点击您的 Apple ID 账户 -> 进入“订阅”页面 -> 选择对应的 ToDesk 连续包月服务取消订阅即可。如未在订阅期结束的至少 24 小时前关闭，订阅将会继续。

bluejetty:00131315:ios.summary: Use the Sydney™ Health app to find care, share your digital ID card, and check your claims. You can understand your benefits, improve your health, and save money. Easily manage your benefits at your fingertips whenever you need them with yo
bluejetty:00131315:ios.description:
Use the Sydney™ Health app to find care, share your digital ID card, and check your claims. You can understand your benefits, improve your health, and save money. Easily manage your benefits at your fingertips whenever you need them with your personalized health and wellness information all in one place. Through integration with HealthKit, you have the option to enable sharing information from your fitness devices with this app. This may include tracking your steps, calories, sleep data, and weight management.
- Digital ID card – Your digital ID works like a paper ID, enabling you to always have access to your current ID and easily share it with your care team in person or by email.
- Chat – Use our 24/7 chat to find what you are looking for, or find more in-depth answers by chatting with a Member Services representative.
- Plan details – Understand your share of the costs, including your deductible and copay. Find out what’s covered and check your claims.
- Find care – Search for care when and where you need it. Locate doctors, labs, hospitals, and other healthcare professionals in your plan’s network. See your estimated costs before you receive care.
- View claims – Easily track your claims including the status and your costs.
- Virtual care – Routine care, prescription refills, and urgent care right from your app, whenever it works for you.
- Refill your prescriptions – You can set up automatic refills and reminders for your medications.
Download Sydney Health to your device today.
Sydney Health is offered through an arrangement with Carelon Digital Platforms, a separate company offering mobile application services on behalf of your health plan. ©2020-2023. The Virtual Primary Care experience is offered through an arrangement with Hydrogen Health.
Sydney Health options are based on each member’s plan, so some features may not be available to all members.

bluejetty:00166159:ios.description:
Mindful IVF: Your Ultimate IVF Meditation & Fertility Coach
Navigate your IVF journey with confidence and calm using Mindful IVF, the app specifically designed to support women through the emotional and physical challenges of IVF.
Why Mindful IVF? IVF is a journey like no other, filled with highs, lows, and moments in between. Mindful IVF is here to guide you every step of the way, helping you stay relaxed, resilient, and connected to your body and mind. Our science-backed meditations and expert-led guidance make IVF more manageable, so you can focus on what truly matters.
Top User Reviews
“Incredible” - 5 Stars.
3 days in and for this busy mind, I found myself calm and present for 12 minutes. A record! Can’t wait to keep using this for my upcoming IVF cycle.”
“Worth Every Penny” - 5 Stars. 
This app kept me sane through IVF. It helped me feel calm, in control, and connected. I’m now blessed with my son and wouldn’t do another IVF transfer without it.”
“Changed My Life” – 5 Stars
“This app helped me stay grounded and connected throughout my IVF journey. I credit our successful IVF cycle largely to Mindful IVF.”
IVF-Specific Features
● Guided Meditations: Tailored for each stage of your IVF cycle, including preparation, transfer, and beyond.
● 2-Week Wait Support: Meditations to ease the stress and help you stay positive during this critical IVF stage.
● Frozen Embryo Cycles: Specialised meditations to address unique challenges.
● Pregnancy Meditations: Support for each trimester after a successful IVF.
● Miscarriage Support: Gentle guidance to promote healing and hope.
● For Men: Meditations to involve and support your partner in the IVF journey.
Additional Benefits
● Daily Meditations: Short, 10-minute sessions designed for stress relief, anxiety management, and mental health.
● Sleep Meditations: Relax deeply and improve your rest with calming sleep practices.
● Mind-Body Connection: Build resilience and create balance between your mind and body to enhance fertility.
Why Mindful IVF is Essential for Your IVF Journey
● IVF-Specific Meditations: Unlike generic meditation apps, Mindful IVF is created exclusively for the fertility journey.
● Expert Guidance: Learn from IVF meditation expert Gordon Mullins.
● Flexible Practice: Just 10 minutes a day for 10 days can make a difference.
● Emotional Support: Stay calm and grounded through every stage of your IVF process.
How Mindful IVF Supports Your IVF Success
Meditation isn’t just about relaxation—it’s about preparing your mind and body for the challenges of IVF. By nurturing your mental fitness and reducing stress, Mindful IVF helps create the optimal environment for fertility.

Download Mindful IVF today and take the first step toward a calmer, healthier IVF experience.
Join thousands of women who’ve discovered the power of mindfulness during their fertility journey.

bluejetty:00024827:ios.summary:

Get ready to catch sneaky cheaters, break up fights, handle the pop quiz, and get your students through tricky tests, all
bluejetty:00024827:ios.description:
Ready to step into the classroom and rule your school? In this exciting teacher game, YOU are the star of the show! 
Get ready to catch sneaky cheaters, break up fights, handle the pop quiz, and get your students through tricky tests, all while you try to keep your cool under pressure. 
It’s time to see if you’ve got what it takes to be a greatest teacher, or the one evil teacher that everyone dreads!
Take charge of your class, from marking papers to crafting lessons that actually make learning fun. 
You’ll have to manage behaviour and discipline rowdy students, stop the bullies, and be a mentor who inspires, all while you take control of the chaos of school life. 
Every decision you make has a ripple effect, will you be the school teacher everyone loves, or the one they try to avoid at all costs?
Game Features:
- Catch cheaters red-handed and send them to the principal (nobody’s getting away with it!).
- Handle pop quizzes and tricky exams, your students will either shine or… not.
- Grade papers with care and precision, and watch your students’ results unfold.
- Break up fights, stop the bullies, and manage your classroom like a pro.
- Build your teaching style - make choices; Will you be the kind educator or the mean teacher who rules with an iron fist?
- Daily rewards keep you motivated as you master the art of teaching (or perhaps, surviving school chaos!).
Navigate school life in all its glory, there’s never a dull moment! Marking papers to disciplining students every day in the classroom is a new adventure. 
Will you achieve the “Best Teacher” award, or the one everyone whispers about in the corridors?
The choice is yours: conquer the classroom or tackle the chaos. Test your brain, sharpen your pencils, and prepare for a wild ride!
SUBSCRIBE TO TEACHER SIMULATOR
Subscribe to Teacher Simulator for all of the following benefits:
* New 'Arts & Crafts’’ Mini Game
* VIP Outfit
* No Ads
* x2 Earnings
SUBSCRIPTIONS INFORMATION:
Teacher Simulator VIP Membership access offers two membership options:
1) A weekly subscription costing $5.49 per week after a 3 day FREE trial period.
2) A monthly subscription costing $14.49 per month.
After buying this subscription, you will unlock an exclusive ‘Arts & Crafts’ Mini Game to play, a VIP outfit to wear, remove non-optional ads, and x2 earning from your clients. This is an auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will also be charged for renewal
The prices notes are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may change and actual charges may be converted to local currency.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
- The payment is charged to your iTunes account after a confirmation of purchase
- The subscription is renewed unless you unsubscribe 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period at the standard cost of the weekly subscription
- The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal by accessing the user's account settings after purchase in the store
- No cancellation of the current subscription is permitted during the active subscription period
- Any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited when the subscription is purchased
Cancelling a trial or subscription:
- In order to cancel a subscription during the free trial period you need to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.

bluejetty:00014279:ios.description:
Ace Your HR Certification Exams with HR Cards: The Ultimate Prep Tool for SHRM and HRCI!
Preparing for the PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP exams? HR Cards helps you master over 1300 HR-specific terms in just 5 minutes a day! Whether you’re studying for HRCI or SHRM certifications, HR Cards gives you the edge with critical vocabulary and hundreds of test questions, all designed to boost your confidence and get you exam-ready.
Why choose HR Cards?
1300+ key HR terms in 9 easy-to-navigate, color-coded categories 
Comprehensive test questions to practice and refine your knowledge 
Track your progress by category to see where you excel and what needs work 
Interactive flashcards for a personalized study experience: shuffle, restart, or focus on challenging terms 
Expert insights from Lori Kleiman, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, with 20+ years of certification prep experience
With HR Cards, you’re not just studying; you’re preparing to succeed!
---
App Features:
Guess the word or definition and reinforce your learning
Shuffle and reset for continuous practice
Progress tracker shows your improvement over time
Flashcard methodology, proven to enhance memory and retention
Start with a FREE 3-day trial! For just $4.99 for 6 months, unlock full access, including regular updates with new terms, trends, and emerging HR acronyms to stay current in your field.
HR Cards is your fast track to HR success!
Perfect for HR professionals looking to **advance their U.S.-based HR careers**, or students aiming to **ace their HR coursework**.
---
Why This App Works:
Flashcards are a time-tested method for enhancing memory and retention. With HR Cards, you’ll see terms until you know them by heart, making it easier to select the correct answers on exam day. Plus, the app’s interactive design with specific feedback for you helps you focus on areas that need more attention.
---
Created by a Leading HR Expert
Lori Kleiman, SPHR, SHRM-SCP, has been teaching HR certification prep courses for over 20 years. She’s taken all her knowledge and packed it into this app to give you the tools you need to succeed. With Lori’s proven methodology, HR Cards is your key to mastering the terms and concepts essential for passing your exam.
How does HR Cards work? 
1. You Select a category to get started; all the major HR categories are included plus acronyms
2. Tap a word to reveal its definition 
3. Indicate whether you got the word right or need to try again 
4. Track your progress with the bar chart for each knowledge area 
5. **Toggle** between viewing words first or definitions for an added challenge
---
Try HR Cards FREE for 3 days! And members of our Powerhouse Prep Course get free access for 6 months!
Full access for just $4.99 for 6 months after your 3 day free trial
Need help? 
We’re committed to responding to your inquiries within 24 hours through the HR Topics team. Reach out to hrcards@hrtopics.com

bluejetty:00175200:ios.description:
Xmind is a full-featured mind mapping and brainstorming tool, now supercharged with AI. One map takes you from inspiration to execution—turn ideas into action faster than ever, across all platforms.
Whether you're brainstorming ideas, structuring thoughts, or managing projects, Xmind gives you a seamless experience for clarity, creativity, and collaboration.
XMIND AI
• Create with AI: Generate a full mind map from any text, link, or document in seconds.
• Photo to Map: Snap a photo of your notes or a whiteboard, and AI turns it into a structured mind map.
• Draw to Map: Sketch your ideas by hand, and AI converts them into a clean mind map.
• Grow Ideas: Select any topic and let AI expand it into a full branch of related ideas.
• AI Task Breakdown: Turn any goal into actionable tasks and to-dos automatically.
VISUALIZE INFORMATION WITH MIND MAP BEING SIMPLE & EASY
• Templates: Kick-start any mind map with 30 well-designed templates.
• Skeleton & Smart Color Theme: Create one-of-a-kind maps with countless combinations of preset structures and color themes.
• Structure: Choose from 9 structures - Mind Map, Logic Chart, Brace Map, Org Chart, Tree Chart, Timeline, Fishbone, Tree Table and Matrix. Mix multiple structures in one map to handle complex projects with ease.
• Insert: Enrich a topic with image, audio note, equation, label, hyperlink, topic link, drawing, and more.
• Equation/LaTeX: Jot down mathematics and chemical equations with LaTeX.
• Audio Note: Capture information fast and never miss a word.
FOCUS ON CONTENT, AND STAY ORGANIZED & PRODUCTIVE
• Outliner: Outline thoughts hierarchically and keep it going in mind map.
• ZEN Mode: A full-screen, distraction-free mode to help you focus. (iPad only)
• Multiple Organizers: Connect topics with Relationships, group ideas with Boundary, conclude with Summary.
• Pitch Mode: Present your map as a slideshow with auto-generated transitions and layouts in one click.
• Multitasking: Open and edit 2 files side by side, e.g. GoodNotes/Notability and Xmind at once.
• Filters: Tag topics with marker & label, highlight by tags to get inspired.
ALWAYS BEING SO STYLISH, KEEP MIND MAPPING WITH FUN
• Smart Color Theme: Build an aesthetically appealing map effortlessly.
• Hand-drawn Style: Switch your map into a hand-drawn look in one click.
• Colored Branch: Stimulate creativity with more rainbow color schemes.
• Illustrations: Visualize your map with 350+ illustrations.
• Sticker: Find your favorite from 400+ brand-new collections.
SAVE & SHARE MIND MAP WITH EASE
• Real-time Collaboration: Work with your team on the same map simultaneously. Share, edit, and stay in sync—no matter where you are.
• Import: MindManager, FreeMind, Lighten, MindNode, Markdown, OPML, TextBundle, and Word (DOCX Only).
• Export: PDF, PNG, Markdown, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OPML, TextBundle.
• Set Password: Encrypt your Xmind files for security.
THE LIGHT WAY TO MANAGE PROJECTS
• Task Integration: Create and manage tasks directly in your map—set priorities, track progress, and manage duration, all in one place.
SUBSCRIBE TO XMIND
• Products: All Platforms Xmind Pro/Premium (Annually), All Platforms Xmind Pro/Premium (Monthly)
• Type: Auto-Renewable Subscriptions
• Price: $59.00/$99.00 Annually
• Cancel Subscription: Go to "Settings" > "iTunes & App Store" > Apple ID > Subscriptions, then tap your Xmind plan to cancel. If not cancelled more than 24 hours before the period ends, it renews automatically.
• Apple ID for automatic renewal subscriptions will be automatically charged for an additional year/month in iTunes account 24 hours prior to the expiration of each billing cycle.
• Terms of Service (including subscription rules): https://www.xmind.com/terms/
• Privacy Policy: https://www.xmind.com/privacy/
NEED HELP?
Let us know if you have any feedback, or if we can help in any way at support@xmind.com.

bluejetty:00027420:ios.summary:

Study hard, have fun, make friends and face the “Gaokao”, one
bluejetty:00027420:ios.description:
In this casual yet realistic life sim with a Chinese authenticity, you step into the shoes of an average kid from the first day of life towards the end of your high school days.
Study hard, have fun, make friends and face the “Gaokao”, one of the most critical examinations in your life. And perhaps this experience might also give you a special perspective to explore your relationships as a parent and as a child.
[Game Features]
- A unique slice of life simulator
You are a child born in an ordinary Chinese family. Prior to Gaokao, one of the most critical examinations, you have 18 years to enjoy your life and make choices to be yourself.
- Be a Chinese kid
As a girl or a boy, different experiences from heartfully weaved stories and distinctive characters awaits you.
- Use “Fragments” to improve yourself
Raise your stats with Fragment mini-game. Higher stats improve your character through learning new skills.
- Tiger Parent, or not?
Scheduling every detail, either ensure a happy and stress-free life, or force the kid to study as hard as possible? It’s all up to you.
- Live the life as a Chinese child with various mini-games
Expect a life full of challenges. Do you have what it takes to defeat your annoying and cocky neighbors in the Face Duel? Or can you maintain your cool while trying everything to grasp the Red Pocket against your relatives in a courtesy manner?
- Multiple friends to date with
You are not alone, after all you need a social life. Choose and date with 14 friends in total with various interaction in order to know them better. Who knows what post-graduation fairy tales will happen to these childhood sweethearts?
-Over 100 career endings
Persuade your dream career, and choose your own life. Will you settle to be an average nobody, or only after reaching the top of everything will your ambition be properly answered?
-Your family journeys on, from generation to generation
Your child in the next game will benefit from your achievements in the previous generation. Don’t forget to check back your roots to find courage and wits for the future.

bluejetty:00088436:ios.description:
The first mobile app to handle any developer task on the go.
Main features:
- REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SOAP, JSON RPC, XML, HTTP, HTTPS, etc.
- All types of HTTP requests: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS, COPY, LINK, UNLINK, PURGE, LOCK, UNLOCK, PROPFIND, VIEW.
- Powerful GraphQL editor with full-scale experience: body editor with Queries, Mutations, Subscriptions and syntax support; variables editor; documentation explorer; request settings and metadata.
- WebSocket testing tool. Handles connection and message exchange via WS or WSS.
- API calls with any kind of request data encoding and transfer type (query params, URLEncoded params, FormData, raw data, send files from device storage, cloud, remote server).
- Settings. TLS can be skipped, redirects can be disabled, timeouts are adjustable. Weak SSL verification can be enabled and replaced with self-signed certificate.
- Import request or collection by curl, link or file from your device. And naturally, there is any type of collection for you: Swagger, OpenAPI, Postman, YAML.
- Need to share request in seconds? Deep link and cURL command supported.
- Apple Watch app. Allows to send API requests directly from your wrist.
- Integrations: Shortcuts, Widgets.
Additional little things:
- Autocomplete for most common headers keys.
- Syntax highlighting; Auto formatting.
- Optimized for viewing on any device screen. 
- Cookies. Collect, edit, create.
- Request metrics. Measure request duration, response size, status code changing.
- History of all request calls.
- Request authorisation. Basic Auth with password and username. OAuth with header or query access token.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tester.io/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00065940:ios.description:
Six classic dice games in one app — play online with friends or offline anytime.
Turn-based matches mean no waiting. Take your turn whenever it fits your schedule, whether you have 2 minutes or 2 hours. Built from the ground up for VoiceOver accessibility.
DICE WORLD INCLUDES 6 CLASSICS
• Farkle — Push-your-luck showdown. Risk it all or bank your points.
• Yatzy — Roll poker-style hands and outscore your rivals.
• Balut — A tactical gem popularized by American soldiers overseas.
• Pig — Fast, simple, addictive. Just don't roll a 1.
• Threes — Strategic low-score challenge with 5 dice.
• 1-4-24 — Pick your lucky number and roll to victory.
PLAY YOUR WAY
• 100% turn-based multiplayer — take your turn anytime
• Challenge friends or get matched with opponents worldwide
• Practice offline against the computer
• Daily tournaments, leaderboards, and detailed stats
• Global chat to meet other dice fans
ACCESSIBLE TO EVERYONE
Dice World is built for all players. Fully optimized for VoiceOver with high-quality audio cues, high-contrast visuals, and thoughtful navigation. Blind and sighted players compete on equal footing.
Download Dice World and start rolling today!

bluejetty:00026654:ios.name: Watch Duty: Wildfire & Floods
bluejetty:00026654:ios.summary: Watch Duty is the only disaster mapping and alert app powered by real people giving you real-time information on wildfires and floods vetted by trained professionals, not robots or AI. While many other apps rely solely on government alerts,
bluejetty:00026654:ios.description:
Watch Duty is the only disaster mapping and alert app powered by real people giving you real-time information on wildfires and floods vetted by trained professionals, not robots or AI. While many other apps rely solely on government alerts, which can often be delayed, Watch Duty provides up-to-the-minute, life-saving information through a dedicated team of active and retired firefighters, dispatchers, first responders, and reporters who monitor radio scanners around the clock. We aim to keep you informed and safe with real-time updates and alerts.
Disaster Tracking Features:
- Push notifications about nearby safety impacting floods, wildfires, and firefighting or emergency response efforts
- Real-time updates as conditions change
- Evacuation orders & shelter information
- Active fire perimeters and progress
- Flash flood warnings and threat levels
- Current and projected river gauge flooding levels
- Infrared satellite hotspots from VIIRS and MODIS
- Wind speed and direction
- Power outage size and estimated resolution time
- Historical wildfire perimeters
- Air quality readings
- Street and satellite maps
- Air attack and air tanker flight tracker
- Save locations for quick access on the map
Watch Duty is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. Our service will always remain free of charge and free of ads. You can support our mission with a $25/year membership, which grants access to special features as a token of our appreciation.
Disclaimer: Watch Duty is not affiliated with any government agency. The information provided in this app is sourced from publicly available and trusted sources, including but not limited to government agencies, radio transmissions, and satellite data. Specific government sources include:
- National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration: https://www.noaa.gov/
- VIIRS: https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/instruments/viirs
- MODIS: https://modis.gsfc.nasa.gov
- National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC): https://www.nifc.gov
- California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE): https://www.fire.ca.gov
- California Governor's Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES): https://www.caloes.ca.gov
- National Weather Service (NWS): https://www.weather.gov/
- Environmental Protection Agency (EPA): https://www.epa.gov/
- Bureau of Land Management: https://www.blm.gov/
- Department of Defense: https://www.defense.gov/
- National Park Service: https://www.nps.gov/
- US Fish and Wildlife Service: https://www.fws.gov/
- US Forest Service: https://www.fs.usda.gov/
For more information or support, feel free to contact us at support.watchduty.org.
Privacy Policy: https://www.watchduty.org/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00171770:ios.description:
◆ IMPROVE FOCUS, REFLEXES, AND MEMORY
Speed reading, memory, reflexes.
Tap numbers—and your brain begins to react faster.
This app strengthens peripheral vision, reaction speed, and concentration—
all essential parts of what we call “visual thinking.”
◆ WHY IT WORKS 
Over 80% of external information enters through your eyes. 
How quickly and accurately you recognize and respond to visual input 
directly affects your brain’s performance.
Peripheral Vision Trainer uses the Schulte Table method, 
developed by German psychiatrist Walter Schulte. 
It’s a psychological training technique proven to improve: 
- Attention 
- Processing speed 
- Visual search skills
That’s why it’s effective for: 
- Speed reading 
- Reflex training 
- Memory improvement
◆ WHAT YOU’LL IMPROVE
＜Visual Skills＞
- Peripheral vision 
- Expanded field of view 
- Reaction time and reflexes 
- Visual processing 
- Focus and sustained concentration
＜Cognitive Skills＞ 
- Memory 
- Attention 
- Judgment 
- Cognitive control 
- Right-brain activation
◆ CORE FEATURES 
• Boost speed reading, concentration, and processing speed 
• Tap-the-numbers gameplay for reflex and reaction time 
• 4×4 to 7×7 training grids with progressive difficulty 
• Compete with global users in the leaderboard 
• Free with ads, or go ad-free with upgrade
◆ PERFECT FOR 
• Anyone looking to improve memory or cognitive focus 
• Students training speed reading or brain efficiency 
• Esports players and athletes needing sharp reflexes 
• Seniors maintaining visual and mental agility 
• People wanting a simple, effective daily brain workout
◆ REAL USER FEEDBACK 
“It’s a really simple app, but I feel like it actually makes you use your peripheral vision. And I’m not a bot lol.” 
“Completely free app. Feels like developers put their soul into it!” 
“Awesome. Helping with memory problems.” 
“The best peripheral vision training app I’ve ever tried.” 
“Very good—very supportive to train a reading speed.” 
“My brain gets tired—in a good way. Totally addictive.” 
“Perfect warm-up before studying or working.” 
“Simple, but I can really feel my field of view expanding.” 
“Best app I've found for training peripheral vision.”
◆ START NOW — SEE THE DIFFERENCE 
Just 3 minutes a day to train your focus, reflexes, and memory. 
Tap into your brain’s hidden potential — one number at a time.
◇ Terms of Use: http://thomsons.jp/sp/vw_terms.htm

bluejetty:00088761:ios.summary: Welcome to Wooden Block - Party Game, an exciting and innovative battle game that combines the strategic depth of Sudoku with the thrilling block-matching fun of classic puzzle games, infusing traditional gameplay with fresh creativity! In
bluejetty:00088761:ios.description:
Welcome to Wooden Block - Party Game, an exciting and innovative battle game that combines the strategic depth of Sudoku with the thrilling block-matching fun of classic puzzle games, infusing traditional gameplay with fresh creativity! In this game, you can challenge formidable robots, including some of history’s most brilliant minds like Einstein, Newton, Edison, and Michelangelo. Each robot brings its own set of unique abilities and strategies, offering a true test of your skills. Additionally, Wooden Block - Party Game features a player vs player mode, where you can go head-to-head with friends or family, engaging in intense battles of strategy and reflexes. Prepare for a thrilling competitive experience as you fight for the title of champion!
Whether you're in need of a mental escape or simply looking for some intellectual stimulation, this game offers the perfect solution. Immerse yourself in the satisfying sound of blocks as you dive into the addictive world of Wooden Block!
Pro Tips: Look for patterns that can trigger chain reactions in each round. Connecting multiple eliminations can lead to explosive combos and cascading blocks, dramatically increasing your score!
How to Play:
 - Place blocks on a 9x9 grid, completing lines and squares to remove them from the board.
 - Stay alert and focus as you devise strategies to keep your board clear, while adapting to ever-changing block shapes.
 - Challenge yourself or others to beat high scores and climb the leaderboard.
 - Use strategic thinking to trigger explosive chain reactions and rack up combo points. Keep the streak going for even greater rewards!
HIGHLIGHTS:
 - Stunning visuals and immersive sound effects.
 - Lightweight game that doesn’t take up much space on your device.
 - Suitable for players of all ages and backgrounds.
 - Battle robots or play against others.
 - Various game modes to explore.
 - No Wifi required—play anytime, anywhere!
Ready to dive into the world of Wooden Block - Party Game？Start your journey to endless fun! Sharpen your mind and boost your IQ with every move! Unwind, relax, and immerse yourself in the addictive gameplay that offers a unique and tailored gaming experience! Whether you're at home or on the go, challenge yourself and enjoy the ultimate puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00065391:ios.description:
TruityCU is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure, and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with TruityCU:
-Keep your transactions organized by adding tags, notes, and photos of receipts and checks
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-Freeze your debit card if you've misplaced it, and unfreeze your card if you find it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and TouchID or FaceID on supported devices. 
To use the TruityCU Mobile app, you must enroll if you currently do not use online banking. If you currently use Truity Credit Union's Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Online Banking credentials.

- Match all of the tiles to clear the board!

Step into a magical world of merging, resource management, and kingdom building! Begin your journey in a fog-shrouded land, where ancient keys unlock hidden territories, bountiful resources, and the path to an awe-inspiring medieval empire.

People who want to be more capable at 50 than they were at 30. Beginners who've been

something smarter. Anyone rebuilding after an injury.
Not just fit. Fully capable.

bluejetty:00174838:ios.name: Fabulous: Daily Habit Tracker
bluejetty:00174838:ios.summary: Welcome to the world of Fabulous. Unlock the power of habits and routines. Prioritize your mental health, build healthy habits and improve your life one step at a time. Fabulous started as a habit tracker, but it evolved into a self-improve
bluejetty:00174838:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Fabulous. Unlock the power of habits and routines. Prioritize your mental health, build healthy habits and improve your life one step at a time. Fabulous started as a habit tracker, but it evolved into a self-improvement, coaching, and mental health platform. Our goal is to make healthy routines an inseparable part of your life. 
How does Fabulous work?
1 - Add structure to your life - Improve your life with a healthy morning routine that provides a system for your everyday life.
2 - Create healthy habits - Use a daily planner to remember important tasks. Your habits sculpt the person you will become — choose them wisely.
3 - Focus on deep work - Learn how to tune out all the noise and concentrate on the task. 
4 - Join a community - Live challenges will introduce you to other Fabulous members worldwide embarking on the same journey as you. Find motivation by connecting with hundreds of members all across the globe. 
5 - Learn how to be grateful - Keep your gratitude journal and listen to positive daily affirmations. 
Fabulous is an all-in-one routine & self-care app for everyday life:
– Listen to the daily coaching series.
– Write your to-do list.
– Journal your thoughts.
– Do short workouts and breathing exercises.
– Listen to daily affirmations and meditation sessions.
– Keep your gratitude journal.
– Monitor your mental wellbeing.
– Use the goal-tracker to monitor progress.
Upgrade your planner for exciting additional features that will take the habit tracking to a new level. Achieve your health and productivity goals today with science-proven features:
– Coaching series grouped by topics: anxiety, self-love, productivity, or depression.
– Unlimited habits for your morning and evening routines.
– New Premium Journeys for better mental health, self-care, and fitness.
– Personal one-on-one coaching for better motivation and focus.
Top 4 reasons to try the Fabulous app: 
1 - Need the motivation to build an indestructible morning routine?
2 - Have an irregular sleep cycle and want to learn how to get a good sleep?
3 - Want to increase your energy level, so you focus the entire day?
4 - Want to improve your mental health through mindfulness so you can cope with anxiety?
Scientifically proven, morning routines are essential to a successful life. No excuses! Start changing your life today and save money using behavioral science. Install Fabulous to get personalized daily habits and achieve your goals.
Pricing in different countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. You can always see the exact price in the app. The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. When you feel the Premium plan is not what you need, you can cancel your subscription at any time. 
If you have any questions, visit our website at www.thefabulous.co and click "Contact Us" at the bottom.
 Build and track your habits, set goals, learn how to meditate, and build healthy routines. Your journey to self-improvement and better mental health starts today!
This day will come and go. That much is certain.
Making it count? Well, that's up to you!
-------
Read our full terms and conditions and our privacy policy at: https://www.thefabulous.co/terms.html

bluejetty:00016047:ios.name: Big Farm: Mobile Harvest
bluejetty:00016047:ios.summary:
Big Farm: Mobile Harvest is a free farm simulator game that you can play online with friends, family, and farmers around the world. Build your own community and have fun creating the farm life of your dreams.
*Farm with friends: Big Farm:
bluejetty:00016047:ios.description:
Big Farm: Mobile Harvest is a free farm simulator game that you can play online with friends, family, and farmers around the world. Build your own community and have fun creating the farm life of your dreams.
*Farm with friends: Big Farm: Mobile Harvest is a free farming simulator online game that lets you join up with your friends and create a beautiful farm village of your very own.
*Farming simulator experience: Build your farm and plant, grow and harvest your favorite fruits and vegetables.
*All done with your farm chores? Time to look after your animal friends: A good farmer keeps their four-legged friends happy. Have fun caring for cows, goats, chickens, horses, pigs, and many other cuddly companions.
*Farm, harvest, and trade: Did you harvest extra corn but need some strawberries? In the market, you can make trades to help your farming village prosper.
*More than a farming simulator game - it's a community: Meet, chat, discuss, and complete joint quests with farmers worldwide.
*Build the number one farm: Starting with nothing but raw seeds, you'll use all your farming skills to grow your crops until they're ready to be sold at the market.
*Farm your way: Grow hay on your farm. Harvest organic foods and farm-fresh goods, all from your farm village.
*Build your dream farm: Add vintage buildings, windmills, and decorations to create the farm of your dreams.
*Plenty of options: Choose what you want to grow! From tropical fruits to organic vegetables, your farm village is sure to set new trends in the market.
*Manage your farm village: Distribute your crops after each planting cycle, sow seeds, water your plants, feed your animals, make clever deals in the farm marketplace, and collect rewards.
*Farming adventures: Participate in events and farming quests to find missing items that will improve your farm.
*Relax on your farm: Escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy life on your very own farm! Take a break and enjoy some sun and relaxation.
*Farming with your family: Invite your family and enjoy farming together in the peaceful countryside.
*Learn from farmers worldwide: Join the Big Farm community and meet farmers from all over the world. Learn about their farming methods to keep your farm village prosperous.
Big Farm: Mobile Harvest game is completely free to play with optional in-app purchases. You may disable in-app purchasing using your device settings. This game requires an internet connection. Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Imprint: https://policies.altigi.de/

bluejetty:00034065:ios.description:
AirDroid Kids is the companion app of the AirDroid Parental Control App. Parents can make sure that their children are all safe while children can enjoy their latest iPhones and iPads in a safe and secure environment.
Please only install AirDroid Kids onto to a device being used by your child or teen. Using AirDroid Parental Control, children can communicate and tell their parents instantly if they get into trouble.
How to get started
1. Download the AirDroid Parental Control App onto your device 
2. Then download the AirDroid Kids App onto any of your child’s devices you want to monitor. 
3. After you finish, the two apps allow you to seamlessly manage your child’s daily on linked mobile or desktop devices.
Discover the new Family Chatting: Instantly connect with your loved ones and stay connected with a single tap.
More Features include:
• Website and app usage monitoring on the child’s device
• Website blocking and category blocking (block games, porn, gambling, and lockout unwanted content) on the child’s device
• Location tracking of the child's device
• Safe search and custom black & white list on the child’s device
• Real-time alerts sent to parents
• Check route history & geofence alert
• Daily Downtime for specific Apps & Websites
• Apps & Websites limit set by the Parent App
• Install and Uninstall Restriction & Anti-bait and Switch
If you have any questions or need help, contact us at support@airdroid.com
We take privacy and the protection of your family and children’s data extremely seriously. We do not and will not sell data to third parties. Your child’s screen time activity is for your eyes only.
Terms of Service: https://ios.airdroidkids.com/#/Terms
Important notes for users
- The AirDroid Kids App for iOS install process will ask you to install a special MDM profile and accept special permissions to control the internet traffic on the device. This profile can be removed or disabled by you whenever you want. Instructions for installing, uninstalling, and configuring are on our help page.

bluejetty:00078378:ios.summary: Stay connected to the best communities and message boards in college sports. Get notified of every important recruiting update, commitment, coaching change, and intense discussion. With Team Monitor you'll never miss out on the important st
bluejetty:00078378:ios.description:
Stay connected to the best communities and message boards in college sports. Get notified of every important recruiting update, commitment, coaching change, and intense discussion. With Team Monitor you'll never miss out on the important stuff happening in the universe of your favorite college team.
Use Pinned Threads to keep track of the most important news as it happens. Whenever breaking news happens, you'll know about it.
Trending helps you keep up with the most talked about and discussed threads on the site. Don't want to miss out on great sports discussions, but could do without the great chili debates? Just turn on the off-topic filter to keep it strictly sports.
With Buzzwords, you can create your own custom set of keyword search terms that you'd like to be notified about. Anytime a thread gets posted that matches one of your Buzzwords, you'll get notified within seconds.
Use the Favorites feature to create a list of your favorite posters. Whenever one of them starts a new thread you'll be immediately notified.
A full Safari browser lets you browse the board right from within the app. Reading a popular thread while breaking news happens? Not to worry. In-app notifications drop down from the top of the screen to let you know what's happening. Simply tap on the notification to instantly be taken straight to the thread.
Whether you're stuck in a meeting on National Signing Day, in class during a coaching search, or spending quality time with your significant other on a big recruiting weekend, you'll never miss the most important news on your favorite college football, basketball, baseball, or any of the other sport. A simple swipe to the iOS notification center will show you all the threads you've missed. Apple Watch owners will even get breaking update notifications right on their watches.
We currently support the following teams:
Texas football
Texas basketball
Texas baseball
Alabama football
Alabama basketball
Alabama baseball
Subscription Terms:
By subscribing, you acknowledge that:
·You are subscribing to Team Monitor for one month, during which time you will have full access to the app and all ads will be removed from the app
·That the price of the app is equivalent to $0.99 in your local currency and that payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
·That the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period and that your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at a cost of $0.99 or equivalent in your currency
·You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes/App Store Account Settings after purchase
·You may view our Terms of Service at http://www.bit.ly/obmonitorterms and our Privacy Policy at http://www.bit.ly/obmonitorprivacy
·That any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to Team Monitor, where applicable.

bluejetty:00151079:ios.description:
***THIS APP IS FOR Neora Edge MEMBERS***
With the Go Prospect app, you can easily share your way to success with digital tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials, videos, social assets, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.
Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you've shared and contact actions.
Media: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You'll receive a notification when contacts view a tool so you know exactly when to follow up! No data connection? No problem! Simply download content in the app beforehand for offline playback.
Samples: There’s no better way than samples to allow prospects to experience your products and the benefits they deliver. Distributors have the ability to send product samples directly to prospects. Site visitors also have the ability to request a sample. Simple and powerful.
Feed: Keep track of everything you’ve shared and see what your contacts have viewed with notifications. You can even swipe notifications to mark them as a Reminder. News also brings all of the latest announcements and social posts from corporate straight to you in one convenient place!
Business: Access helpful links to build your business.
Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your 'why' in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business. You can also configure notifications, watch QuickTips to learn about the app, and more.

bluejetty:00036989:ios.name: Daily art history and modern
bluejetty:00036989:ios.summary: Welcome to Daily Art, your personal space to learn about art every day, where creativity, history, and knowledge come together in a fun and accessible way. Think of Daily Art as your personal art gallery, where every day offers a new opport
bluejetty:00036989:ios.description:
Welcome to Daily Art, your personal space to learn about art every day, where creativity, history, and knowledge come together in a fun and accessible way. Think of Daily Art as your personal art gallery, where every day offers a new opportunity to discover masterpieces and explore art history.
In Daily Art, there are no ads.
At Daily Art, we believe that art is for everyone, and our mission is to make learning about it both enjoyable and easy. Each day, Daily Art introduces you to a new work of art, guiding you through its unique characteristics, historical context, and the fascinating stories behind it. Whether you're in a virtual art gallery or exploring the vast world of art history, we ensure that each piece is accompanied by its rich context.
Daily Art is crafted by a team of passionate experts in art, design, and history, with the goal of expanding your artistic knowledge and helping you explore the world of art one piece at a time. Each day is like a visit to a new art gallery, filled with different styles, historical periods, and interpretations. Whether you’re an avid art lover or an absolute beginner, Daily Art provides the tools to help you connect with art on a deeper level.
We understand that art and its history can feel overwhelming at times. That’s why Daily Art breaks everything down into simple, bite-sized lessons, allowing you to enjoy and absorb them at your own pace. Each lesson feels like a curated exhibit in an art gallery, focusing on the most important aspects of each artwork, from its historical significance to its hidden details.
Our mission at Daily Art is to make art more approachable, engaging, and meaningful. As part of the Daily Art community, you’ll gain access to an array of resources, lessons, and interactive challenges that will fuel your creativity and enhance your understanding of art history, all in the comfort of your personal art gallery.
Beyond individual lessons, Daily Art also offers a vibrant community of art lovers. By joining Daily Art, you’ll connect with like-minded individuals who share your passion for creativity and art. Together, you'll explore the stories behind artworks in your art gallery, exchange ideas, and inspire each other as you grow in your appreciation for the world's finest galleries and their rich histories.
We’re thrilled to welcome you to our dynamic community. With Daily Art, you’ll always have a place to learn, explore, and immerse yourself in the incredible world of art and history, as if you were wandering through the most amazing art galleries in the world. Whether you’re looking to deepen your understanding of famous masterpieces, discover the stories behind hidden gems, or simply marvel at the creativity of human expression, Daily Art is here to guide and inspire you every step of the way.

Manage your mobile lines, make secure money transfers, pay your bills, enjoy exclusive offers, make reliable merchant payments, and much more, all from a single app.
My Line: Simplify the management of your Orange Burkina Faso line and plans
● Maintain complete control over your account, quickly access essential information about your offers, and take control of your Orange Burkina Faso mobile lines, whether prepaid or postpaid.
● Activate and customize options such as unlimited calls, SMS, roaming, internet passes, or international calls for a unique experience.
● Monitor your mobile usage. Check your balance in real time, see how your call, SMS, and internet minutes have been spent, and view your recent transactions.
● Quickly and easily top up your Orange Burkina Faso prepaid mobile lines and those of your friends and family. Buy credit and stay connected at all times.
● Help your friends and family by transferring credit from your line to other Orange Burkina Faso numbers.
● Choose from our range of 4G Mobile Internet plans, whether daily, monthly, or Oflex Pass. Opt for the internet plan that best suits your needs and lifestyle.
● Select the perfect mix of call minutes, SMS, and internet data from all available offers and enjoy continuous connectivity.
● Renew your Orange Burkina Faso 4G broadband (Panga Box) and fiber optic internet subscriptions.

● Access your Orange Money Wallet and manage your finances. Check your e-wallet balance and browse your transaction history (money transfers, deposits, merchant payments, etc.).
● Securely transfer money to Orange Burkina Faso subscribers, both domestically and internationally.
● Top up your e-wallet from your bank account to access all the app's features, whether for payments, transfers, or online purchases.
● Withdraw money from your e-wallet for efficient financial management tailored to your needs.
● Purchase goods and services quickly and securely from a wide network of retailers, including grocery stores, pharmacies, bookstores, and gas stations.
● Pay your bills without leaving home, whether for electricity, water, or your Orange Burkina Faso postpaid subscriptions.
The Max it Marketplace: a diverse range of products, services, and entertainment for all your needs.

● Buy your codes and access the best online services with Netflix, PlayStation, Fortnite, and Amazon e-gift cards.
● Explore our selection of exciting games with Funcell Orange, Gameloft, and Playweez, and immerse yourself in a world of gaming at your fingertips.

产品特色：
1、时政要闻
澎湃新闻专注报道中国时政，动态跟踪政坛风云，解析经济时局变化；
2、原创匠心
澎湃原创品质保障，坚持新闻创作本心，深度调查呈现更多事件真相；
3、思想争鸣
澎湃新闻精于分析思想动态，紧扣脉搏普及新知，坦率争论碰撞思想；
4、视频专区
感受第一视角记录真实现场，实时了解最新进展，精彩专题深度剖析；
5、澎湃号
汇聚各领域专业创作者，湃客、政务、媒体，为您提供更丰富的优质内容；

聚集天下澎友精彩观点，每一次思想的碰撞，让您看世界更清一点；
7、澎湃问吧
明星专家澎湃入驻等您来问，专业问题明星八卦，问吧解答所有疑问；

澎湃质量报告平台，打假除劣，破套防坑，时刻保障您的权益；

每天早晚两次推送当天小编精选的国内外新闻大事件，与当前时事同步；
================用户评价================
@穷不穷你别怂乐正：
超好啦，没有毫无营养的娱乐稿和见缝插针的小广告，板块划分很清楚啊，很喜欢其中关于时政方面的新闻，还可以一直追踪一个专题比较不会烂尾了啊，总之是三观超正的，个人觉得比****好，很多社论有自己独特角度，不官方。很多可以用到公务员面试中去，还摆脱了培训机构的千篇一律，希望能坚持做新闻的本心，那我就会一直支持。我非常喜欢这里面的“社论”。在这个模块，可以看到大家对一件事和自己不同的看法，然后发现：“哇！原来还有这个角度！”真的很适合我这个即将参加高考的高三狗！
@EagleGorge：

bluejetty:00155628:ios.description:
Wheel with Peel, it's wheely fun!
Peel is a newly founded company that was created to provide an environmentally safe transportation alternative in various local cities. We offer a modern and eco-friendly transportation solution for riders. If you are an adventure seeker or simply want to travel to the local grocery store, Peel scooters have you covered. Do not wait to ride on buses, subways, trains, or with rideshare programs any longer! Peel Scooters allows every individual to have an opportunity to ride at any moment. Additionally, Peel Scooters reduce carbon emissions and remain more environmentally friendly compared to other transportation alternatives. As a result, Peel users can eliminate transportation wait times while also contributing to a more eco-friendly environment. It is a win-win situation! We can't wait for you to join the Peel family and begin your next journey with us. Always remember to Wheel The Peel!
HOW IT WORKS
1. Find Peel Scooter via the Peel app or find scooter alongside street 
2. Scan the scooter's QR code located on scooter handlebar
3. Follow the instructions 
4. Begin your ride 
5. Peel safely and responsibly 
6. End/Pause your ride at any moment
SAFETY TIPS
1. Obey parking, speed, and riding regulations for in-app zones
2. Be cautious for pedestrians and other peelers
3. Wear a helmet 
4. Obey all traffic laws
5. Visit http://www.peelscooters.com for more information and contact information
A CLEANER FUTURE
Peel was created with two main objectives. We strive to aid the public’s daily commute by providing more transportation options while also promoting a healthier environment. Peel scooters reduce carbon emissions and thus provide an environmentally friendly transportation method. We strive to combat climate change one Peel at a time and appreciate all of our riders for positively impacting the environment. 
Can't get enough of Peel?
We offer multiple programs for Peel customers to become a Peeler and adopt their own scooters in exchange for free rides and compensation. This allows select customers to collect and charge scooters at their residence. We also are open to partnering with entrepreneurs to expand to new markets. Visit https://www.peelscooters.com/become-a-partner to find out more!

bluejetty:00129097:ios.description:
تطبيق شرطة الاطفال المطور هو الخيار الأمثل لكل أسرة تبحث عن طريقة ذكية لتعديل سلوك أطفالها بطريقة ممتعة وآمنة. من خلال شرطة الاطفال يمكنك تحفيز طفلك على التصرفات الصحيحة بأسلوب مبتكر، حيث يتلقى الطفل مكالمة تشجيعية تزيد من ثقته بنفسه. تساعد شرطة الاطفال الآباء على بناء سلوك إيجابي لدى أطفالهم بطريقة سهلة وفعالة دون توتر أو صراخ.
ومع استمرار تجربة شرطة الاطفال سيبدأ طفلك بالتفاعل بشكل أكبر مع أسلوب التشجيع والمكافأة، حيث توفر شرطة الاطفال بيئة تربوية ممتعة تجمع بين الترفيه والتوجيه الصحيح. يعتمد تطبيق شرطة الاطفال على مكالمات مخصصة تحمل اسم الطفل، مما يجعل التجربة واقعية ومؤثرة، ويساعد على ترسيخ السلوك الإيجابي بشكل تدريجي وطبيعي داخل حياة الطفل اليومية.
تطبيق شرطة الاطفال المطور كلياً باللهجات العربية وبدون الحاجة إلى الاتصال بالإنترنت، يقدم تجربة فريدة لعلاج سلوكيات الطفل المشاغب بأسلوب مبتكر وفعال. يوفر التطبيق مكالمات تفاعلية تساعد في توجيه الطفل بطريقة ذكية، مع إمكانية إلغاء المكالمة في أي وقت، مما يمنح الأهل تحكماً كاملاً في تجربة الاستخدام ويضمن تشجيع الطفل بطريقة مناسبة ومتوازنة.
ومع تطور استخدام شرطة الاطفال في الحياة اليومية، يصبح الطفل أكثر إدراكاً لأهمية تصرفاته ونتائجها، حيث تساعد شرطة الاطفال على توجيه الطفل عند الخطأ بأسلوب تربوي هادئ وواضح. تقدم شرطة الاطفال رسائل توعوية تبين للطفل ما يجب عليه فعله بطريقة بسيطة ومحببة، مما يعزز التزامه بالقوانين ويجعله أكثر تعاوناً واستجابة لتعليمات الأهل.
ومع الاستمرار في استخدام التطبيق، يصبح وجود شرطي في حياة الطفل وسيلة محفزة تعزز لديه الالتزام بالسلوك الصحيح بشكل يومي. يساعد شرطي الطفل على ترسيخ القيم الإيجابية مثل الصدق والطاعة والنظام، ويمنحه شعوراً بالمسؤولية تجاه أفعاله. ومع دعم الأهل وتفاعلهم، يتحول دور شرطي إلى جزء أساسي في بناء شخصية الطفل بطريقة ممتعة ومتوازنة.
يقدم التطبيق مجموعة واسعة من المكالمات التفاعلية التي تغطي أهم السلوكيات اليومية للطفل، سواء لتعزيز التصرفات الإيجابية أو تصحيح السلوكيات الخاطئة بطريقة ممتعة ومؤثرة.
تشمل مكالمات شرطة الاطفال التحفيزية:
-الأكل
-النوم
-استخدام الحمام
-قول الصدق والحق
-الاستحمام
-ترتيب الألعاب
-الذهاب إلى المدرسة
-الصلاة
-طاعة الأهل
-العودة إلى المنزل في الوقت المحدد
-الشغب والصراخ والتكسير
-الكلام البذيء
-رفض النوم أو الدراسة أو الأكل
-الشجار
-الاستخدام المفرط للموبايل
-التنمر

Control a huge dragon in the new dragon life simulator! Choose which dragon you will be. Use the destructive power of fire, ice, nature or air. The biggest and most terrible predators cannot be compared in strength with a dragon. The dragon can confront a whole town of people. The bravest of humans will attack your dragon. The dragon will also be opposed by more formidable opponents like huge golems, trolls, demons and other creatures. Gradually, the dragon will become stronger and stronger. As the dragon grows up, it will have its own clan of dragons and den.

- Choose the element of your dragon.
- Dragon can destroy almost all objects on the map.
- Complete various quests.
- Large 3D world with several islands.
- Warriors will attack the dragon with a sword, bow and magic!
- Create a clan of dragons.
- The dragon and its mates are growing, increasing in size and power.
- In your lair, your dragon will collect the most valuable and rare treasures from around the world.
- Fine-tuning the appearance and skin of the dragon.
- Battles with other huge creatures.
- Day / night cycle
- Achievements.

bluejetty:00018419:ios.description:
Conheça a nova experiência do TradeMap: um app que traduz o mundo dos investimentos em algo intuitivo e acessível :)
É o TradeMap que você já conhece, mas agora com uma proposta visual mais moderna, navegação fluida, nova usabilidade e ainda mais recursos para você poder explorar o mercado financeiro.
Uma plataforma feita para todos! E que veio para facilitar o acesso e entendimento de funções do mercado, estimular a troca de conhecimentos e, principalmente, inovar na sua experiência com ferramentas para você tomar as melhores decisões de investimentos.
Baixe agora! E conte com:
- As notícias mais quentes que movimentam as bolsas do Brasil e dos EUA
- Integração e acompanhamento da sua Carteira Consolidada com gráfico em tempo real
- Envio de ordens diretamente pelo App ao conectar sua conta com uma de nossas corretoras parceiras: XP Investimentos, Guide, BTG Pactual, Warren, MyCAP, Genial, Nova Futura, Mirae, Terra, NovaDAX, Foxbit, Binance, Coinext, Mercado Bitcoin e muito mais! 
- Detalhes dos seus investimentos: Desempenho, Estatísticas e Risco
- Consultas e criação de listas (Ações, Stocks, BDRs, Criptos, Índices e muito mais)
- Detalhamento de cada ativo, incluindo os prós e contras de cada um e as recomendações de bancos e corretoras
Acha que parou por aí? Não mesmo, né? Além dos já conhecidos e consagrados módulos do TradeMap, a nova experiência vem com novas funções disruptivas para você! Se liga:
- Carteira, P&L e comparações intraday – em tempo real mesmo!
- Cardápio e sugestões de ativos
- Curadoria e humanização na análise de destaques de empresas brasileiras e Fundos Imobiliários
Além de tudo isso, contamos com um ecossistema completo de mercado. Veja só:
- EducaMap: a maior vitrine de cursos gratuitos de investimentos
- Ligas de competição em ambiente simulado: aprenda a investir com dinheiro fictício (e valendo prêmios)
- Ideias e conteúdos compartilhados por usuários: interaja com a Comunidade TradeMap
- Chat para conversas entre amigos e recebimento de notificações de empresas e investimentos!
Baixe agora e faça parte dessa experiência1

bluejetty:00122745:ios.description:
Now available for both Personal and Small Business customers! The First Horizon Mobile Banking app is free to download and offers you a convenient, secure way to manage your financial life or your business on the go. The app lets you deposit a check, view your account balances, pay bills, transfer funds, create and manage budgets, track spending, and set timely alerts and notifications to keep you in the know.
Service Features
• Enable Quick Glance℠ to check balances and see recent transactions without logging in
• Set alerts and push notifications to your iPhone®, Apple Watch®, or iPad®
• Turn your debit and credit cards on or off
• Deposit checks with Mobile Deposit
• Check your account balances and view recent transactions
• Transfer funds between eligible accounts at any time
• Pay bills, add payees, see payments made, or cancel payments
• Send, Request, and Split money with family, friends, and people you know and trust with Zelle® using your personal bank account.
• Move money between all of your personal bank accounts – even ones at other banks
• Create budgets, designate savings goals, and track progress
• Find the nearest First Horizon ATM or banking center
Service Benefits
• Convenience – Bank wherever you go and at any time of the day
• Control – It’s easy to monitor your account and quickly move money, pay bills, and turn your card on or off
• Support – A dedicated mobile specialist is just a quick call away
• Security – Enjoy the highest level of protection against account fraud
How to Get Started
Simply download the app, use your Digital Banking credentials to log in, and you’re ready to begin banking on the go.

bluejetty:00185100:ios.description:
Who let the dogs out? Let's put them all together in this awesome dog album! Get FREE packets every day and rip them open to find amazingly cute dogs! Unveil different dog breeds and have fun with your friends trading repeated stickers, just like in real life!
Collect the rare and animated stickers! Are you really a dog lover? Find herding, companion and sporting dogs, and so much more! There are the huge ones and the tiny ones, the playful dogs and also the strong ones, just to name a few! You will love it!
FUN THEMES
Discover all the puppies in fun themed pages filled with cute stickers. You will see dogs playing in the park or at the beach, working to help people and even the internet celebrity dogs! 
PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Challenge your friends in the exciting BUMP minigame!
Exchange repeated stickers!
HIGHLIGHTS
• Collect dog breeds and get to know them all! What is your favorite breed? Labrador, german shepherds, golden, bulldog, beagle, poodle, yorkshire? 
• All the sticker album fun minus the glue!
• Have fun together and complete your sticker book even faster with the help of other fellow players.
• Challenge your friends to get more stickers!
• Don’t lose your progress - create a My Dog Album account!
• COPPA compliant for Mixed Audiences
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
