bluejetty:00171239:ios.name: KanDrive
bluejetty:00171239:ios.summary:
The KanDrive app is the Kansas Department of Transportation's official traffic and traveler information app. The KanDrive app provides up-to-date traffic information for interstates, U.S. routes and state highways across Kansas.
FEATURES:
bluejetty:00171239:ios.description:
The KanDrive app is the Kansas Department of Transportation's official traffic and traveler information app. The KanDrive app provides up-to-date traffic information for interstates, U.S. routes and state highways across Kansas.
FEATURES:
• Hands-free, eyes-free audio notifications of upcoming traffic events, detours, weather alerts, and rest areas while you drive 
• A zoom-enabled map with tappable traffic event icons and surrounding camera views
• Near real-time updates on traffic incidents, construction, weather and road closures
• My KanDrive personalized accounts for quick access to favorite routes, areas, and camera views & sign up for email, text, push notifications
• View current traffic speeds and road conditions
• View traffic cameras throughout the state. Sign up for a My KanDrive account to save cameras for easy access.
• Hands-free, eyes-free public reporting feature that allows you to submit reports about concerns you encounter on the roadway
• CarPlay support for displaying upcoming high impact events like crashes, detours, and roadwork
• Access to additional traveler information resources
NOTE: Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease device battery life.
The primary responsibility of every driver is the safe operation of their vehicle. While traveling, mobile communication devices should be used only when the motor vehicle is at a complete stop, off the traveled portion of the roadway. Do not text and drive (it's against the law) or use this app while driving.
App developed by Castle Rock Associates https://www.castlerockits.com. For help with KanDrive, please visit https://kandrive.org/help/index.html.
KanDrive is a service provided by the Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT).

bluejetty:00016198:ios.description:
ClipSpeed, increase or decrease video speed easily on your device. If you are looking for an app to make your video in slow motion or to make your video in fast motion, then download our ClipSpeed app to your iOS device. In this app you can also add background audio to your video clip. This app is exclusively designed to do only two task- to slow video and to fasten your video. 
If you are researching for what is the best slow motion app? then why don’t to try this app once? with our clipspeed app you can easily adjust the speed of the video without bothering much settings.
Key Features of ClipSpeed app :
1. ClipSpeed app is exclusively designed to make slow motion video or fast motion video easily
2. Simple user interface
3. You can select the particular region of video clip to increase or decrease video speed
4. Add music to your video
4. Save to camera roll, upload to instagram, mail, upload to youtube, upload to viddy option are provided in the app itself. 
Steps to Slow down video or speed up video with ClipSpeed App:
1. Select the video clip that you want to increase or decrease video speed.
2. In the next screen you will be in “Adjust Speed” screen. Here you can increase or decrease the speed of the video. By default our clip speed app will select complete video, but you can choose only particular portion of that video by using selecting scroll bar at the bottom of Adjust speed window. Once you select the particular video position that you want to increase or decrease the video speed, next you decide whether you need to make slow motion video or fast motion video of the selected video clip. 
If you wish to make Fast Motion video, then drag the Video Speed controlling slider towards right side, if you wish to slow down the video then drag the video speed controller slider towards left side. Once you done that just click on the Right mark icon on the top right corner to generate new video clip. Once you done generating video you can save that generated video clip to your Camera roll, upload to instagram, you can mail that clip, upload to youtube or share it on viddy with our built-in social sharing option. 
3. If you wish to add music to your video then click on Music icon on Adjust speed screen and choose the audio file that you need to add to your video
If you are searching for slow motion video app or fast motion video app then download our ClipSpeed app to your device.

bluejetty:00066094:ios.name: Mission Chief Fire Fighter 911
bluejetty:00066094:ios.summary: Experience the excitement of an emergency call dispatcher at your finger tips! Create your own dispatch center and choose where in the world your fire and police stations are placed, using real life maps. You want to recreate the emergency
bluejetty:00066094:ios.description:
Experience the excitement of an emergency call dispatcher at your finger tips! Create your own dispatch center and choose where in the world your fire and police stations are placed, using real life maps. You want to recreate the emergency system of your city? Or would you prefer to build a huge fire station right on top of the Madison Square Garden? The choice is yours!
First you start with a fire station and a Type 1 or Type 2 engine. Afterwards you can expand your emergency system any way you want. Add more specialist vehicles like HazMat, Heavy Rescue vehicles, MCV (Mobile Command Vehicle), or build up your police force with SWAT and K9 units - or both and cover all emergency calls!
The game allows for vast customization, so all stations and vehicles can be named. And as some specialized vehicles need trained personnel, you can set up training courses and assign specialists to specific vehicles. Advanced players can use helicopters (HEMS) to get to the most urgent emergencies quickly!
If you enjoy teamwork then help friends by joining or creating an alliance. You can share jobs to help each other out as well as allow friends to take patients to your hospital or prison. The more units you have will boost your call amount too, increasing the challenges you face. Remember, some calls will require different types of units to be sent so ensure your fleet is up-to-date!
This game was developed by a real firefighter. So it was always important to have realistic emergency missions with realistic demands for vehicles - from small missions like a burning car to big ones like a bridge collapse - all on real life maps!
Naturally a lot of our players are also firefighters, police officers or ambulance drivers in their real lives. For fans of emergency, blue light systems this is the perfect game!
Finally, we want to let you know that we are always interested in ideas for new missions, vehicles and other content. Just give us a note in a review, contact us on Facebook or send us an email. We cannot implement everything but we strive to realize the valuable input from our players. We are working hard and very closely with our community - to expand the game with you!

bluejetty:00122264:ios.summary:
Watch any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show on your LG Smart TV with webOS and NetCast. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for LG Smart TV you can browse the web and s
bluejetty:00122264:ios.description:
Watch any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show on your LG Smart TV with webOS and NetCast. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.
With Video & TV Cast for LG Smart TV you can browse the web and stream any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show you want on your LG Smart TV. Mp4, m3u8, hls livestreams and also video-over-https are supported.
There is no time limit at all! You can watch videos of 2 minutes or 2 hours or even more. Just open Video & TV Cast, navigate to a website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported. You don't need to install a big media server like Plex or any other third party software.
>>> Important Notes
* To enable video casting, please open the LG App Store (LG Smart World / LG Content Store) on your TV, search for 'TV Cast' and install the companion app.
* Please enter the IP address of your iPhone/iPad by using the number pad and up/down/left/right buttons on your TV Remote or scroll wheel on your Magic Remote. Just enter the numbers, no need to press the enter key.
* iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported!
* Please use the Remote Playbar for video control while browsing (see more info below).
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. It may also be neccessary to start casting multiple times until it works with specific videos.
* If a specific video is not working, please check the FAQ on the app startpage. If that does not help you, please drop us an email before leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for that website as soon as possible.
>>> PRO FEATURES
* Remote Playbar: Use the Playbar for advanced video control while browsing, including video scrubbing, forward, rewind, play, pause, stop. The playbar works on all LG Smart TVs. 
* Local Videos: Cast your camera roll videos from an iPhone or iPad. Supports mp4, m4v and mov videos that were saved to the camera roll via Apples SD-Card/USB Adapter, iTunes Desktop Software or third party apps.
* Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with LG Electronics or any other trademark mentioned here.

bluejetty:00075623:ios.description:
Get ready for modern warfare FPS 3D gun shooting games with a variety of action adventure warzone maps. Commando strike is an fps shooting game commando mission where you have to strike your enemies with your sniper assassin skills as a special gorilla force commando. You can enjoy apex battle fire combat as an offline multiplayer game. Or you can choose story mode by completing fps commando missions as a gun shooter in the gun game. 
Action adventure thriller FPS 3D is presenting covet operation in a commando adventure game. Welcome to FPS 3D gun shooting games against the modern 3d ops battleground. In this commando adventure mission, your aim is to destroy a terrorist training camp that has been used for many terrorist activities in your beloved country. Fps games are usually designed for modern strike warface known as first person shooting games. In this modern combat critical cs strike game you will enjoy kill shots of gun shooter from real sniper assassin.
Crazy Dustown is located in the middle of a desert in your country. Your mission is to get rid of enemy troops that have infiltrated your country. This counter terrorist ww2 combat warfare mission is the last hope for the citizens of your modern warfare arena. Enjoy addictive gameplay with multiple weapons to attack terrorists with maximum force.
Squad Game is designed to act as a world war hero by fighting in special strike modern war zone using full force. A 3D map that needs your 3d sniper shooting skills with the ability to aim headshots from rooftops or stairs. Get advance weapons from airdrop and kill opponents in this secret fps commando mission.
City of Sin is located on top of snowy mountains where crime and sin are routine. In this snow map, you have to liberate innocent people of that town from cruel modern black ops dictator. Your epic bullets force team is here to fight terrorism in a small town located at a great height. Challenge is to survive in those snowy cold mountains with an assault mission. Fight till your last breath and give a chance of liberty to citizens of the prime battle warzone.
Game Features:
- Realistic special force control
- Addictive gun games view & gameplay
- Counter terrorist critical ops combat games story
- HD graphics war games maps
- PvE mode for offline multiplayer experience

bluejetty:00036350:ios.name: Pass4Wallet - store cards
bluejetty:00036350:ios.summary: IMPORTANT: this is not a digital wallet. It does not handle any currency or cryptocurrency. But we all usually have tons of other unneeded plastic in our wallets. Store cards, discount cards, coupons, etc. Pass4Wallet addresses that problem
bluejetty:00036350:ios.description:
IMPORTANT: this is not a digital wallet. It does not handle any currency or cryptocurrency. But we all usually have tons of other unneeded plastic in our wallets. Store cards, discount cards, coupons, etc. Pass4Wallet addresses that problem, allowing us to digitalize them.
You don't have to rely on your card merchants/providers anymore, and many of them do not provide support for the Apple Wallet. With Pass4Wallet, you are the one in charge. 
What's more, you are not bound to store cards or coupons anymore. You can easily add any info you want. Always forget tax or social id numbers? Just keep them in the Wallet.
We aim to make the process as convenient and lightweight as possible, making it only a few 'clicks' to add a new entry. At the same time, the process is flexible and configurable, with the right amount of personalization available.
Main features:
• You can add and update Wallet entries, including (but not limited to): store cards, membership cards, coupons, discount cards, tickets, gift cards, community cards, etc.
• Including a free barcode scanner
• You can add entries with a wider variety of formats than usual
• You can select colors and icon
• You can add notes on the backside
• You can specify relevant dates, to be reminded by the system
• You can add relevant locations to your entries, allowing them to be shown on the locked screen when you're near
• You can start navigation right from the back of your card
• You can share your entries if you want :)
Supported Barcode formats:
Default:
• QR - works on Apple Watch
• Aztec - works on Apple Watch
• PDF417 - works on Apple Watch
• Code-128 - not supported on Apple Watch
Additional (not supported on Apple Watch):
• EAN 8
• EAN 13
• Code-39
• data matrix
• UPC-E
• ITF
• Code 93
• Codabar

bluejetty:00152673:ios.description:
Loop Train – All Aboard the Puzzle Express!
Get ready to test your timing and logic in **Loop Train**, the ultimate puzzle game that puts you in control of a busy railway station! Your mission? Launch trains in the right order to pick up passengers and avoid turning the tracks into a traffic jam nightmare!
Think Fast, Act Smart
Every level is a cleverly designed brain teaser. You'll need to plan your moves carefully and sequence your trains with precision. Launch too soon and risk a crash; wait too long and your passengers grow impatient. Can you keep the station running like clockwork?
Features
* Strategic Gameplay: Balance train launches to optimize passenger pickups and avoid overcrowding.
* Challenging Levels: Each stage presents a new puzzle with unique track layouts and timing traps.
* Simple Controls, Deep Logic: Easy to play, tough to master. Tap to launch, but think before you do!
* Charming Graphics: Clean, colorful visuals bring your miniature railway world to life.
* Perfect for Puzzle Lovers: Ideal for fans of logic puzzles, path planning, and time management games.
Whether you're a casual player looking for a quick brain workout or a puzzle pro chasing the perfect run, Loop Train is your ticket to endless fun and mental challenge.
Hop on the Loop Train—where every second counts and every decision matters!

bluejetty:00070007:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00070007:ios.description:
Velocity Keyboard is a powerful velocity-sensitive MPE compatible MIDI controller.
FEATURES
- unique velocity sensing algorithm that tracks touch force like no other app
- Four interface layouts: Keyboard, String, Scale, and Drum Pad
- runs as an Audio Unit or as a standalone app
- 8 simultaneous sources of MIDI CC parameter control: touch area, touch force (on devices that support 3D Touch), touch Y-coordinate, velocity to CC and up to four MIDI CC control knobs
- smooth MIDI pitch bending between notes in both string and keyboard layouts
- highlight custom scales in any key
- dedicated MIDI modes for maximum flexibility when controlling non-MPE compatible synthesizers
- pitch bend correction algorithm plays more in-tune with more freedom of expression when bending between notes (compared to similar MIDI controller apps)
- can output velocity as a MIDI CC or aftertouch message to better support synths that aren't designed with velocity sensing in mind
What does this app do differently from our iFretless apps?
- It uses much less RAM because it doesn't load any audio samples
- It has MIDI aftertouch controls, so changes in touch pressure and location that occur after after the start of a note can control MIDI CC parameters
- It supports highlighting notes in custom scales
- It has piano keyboard, scale, and drum pad layout options
- It has updated velocity sensing and pitch correction algorithms
- It has better visibility, making it feel more playable on smaller screens, or with a larger number of rows and columns

bluejetty:00078005:ios.description:
Open a Burger Restaurant - Fast Food Restaurant Simulation Battle
Burger chain turns into store manager
Welcome to the world of burger shop simulation experience! Here, you will become the manager of a burger restaurant, managing all aspects of the work from recruiting employees to expanding the store. The goal of the game is to develop your burger restaurant into a prosperous and successful nationwide chain! As you progress in the game, you will have the opportunity to upgrade abilities and facilities to make your store management more efficient. You can also build a chain of burger restaurants to spread your brand wider and further. To achieve this, you must work hard to keep your customers happy and ensure your burger shop runs smoothly.
Game features:
• Simple gameplay, easy to get started!
• There are two sales channels for dine-in and take-out. You can not only take orders at the counter, but also through the take-out window!
• Improve human resource management capabilities by hiring employees and upgrading their skills.
• Expand your business by not only expanding your store, but also establishing a chain store in every state!
With fast-paced gameplay, simple controls, and endless possibilities for growth, this app is perfect for anyone who loves simulation games and wants to experience the thrill of running a successful business.

bluejetty:00178631:ios.name: Young Literal Bible -YLT Bible
bluejetty:00178631:ios.summary: YLT Bible or Young Literal Translation Bible makes reading the Bible easy especially if you are not used to reading the old version of the Bible which is KJV Bible. Download your YLT Bible for an easy Christian life when travelling. We carr
bluejetty:00178631:ios.description:
YLT Bible or Young Literal Translation Bible makes reading the Bible easy especially if you are not used to reading the old version of the Bible which is KJV Bible. Download your YLT Bible for an easy Christian life when travelling. We carry our phones with us all the time and having this app won’t take too much space on your phone.
The availability of numerous translations of the Bible is helpful for studying the Word. The Young Literal Translation, or YLT, has some unique features which make it a valuable research tool. It is known for its strict adherence to using the verb tense which was present in the original Greek and Hebrew texts. Specifically, the YLT used present tense in places where other translations used the past tense. 
The translation was made by Robert Young and originally published in 1872. A revised version was produced in 1887. After his death, a new Revised Edition was released in 1898. The same translation principles were used in each of the editions. Robert Young was compiler of the “Young's Analytical Concordance and Concise Critical Comments on the New Testament”. 
An app which offers the Bible in easy-to-understand language is useful for study, meditation and growth in knowledge. The YLT app or Young literal translation bible has some additional features which are even more helpful to a student of the Scriptures.
Daily Bible Verse
A daily verse from the Word is available to frame the day. The powerful inspirational verses are suitable for meditation. Because they are available in a shareable format for social media users, the verses can be sent to friends via Twitter, Facebook and other platforms. 
Bookmark
For those students of the Word who are following a reading plan for the Bible, a bookmark is available in the free app to allow the reader to jump quickly to the last verse or page read. A bookmark helps to mark progress through the Scriptures.
While listening to a sermon during worship services, you may want to take notes attached to a specific verse. This app feature allows for further study or to note questions you may have about wording or meaning. This feature permits a user to easily construct a Bible study or worship talk by linking verses in a linear format. Writing notes about the verses which you are reading helps to fix them firmly in your mind.
Highlight
When verses are particularly meaningful, you may wish to use the highlight feature to mark the text. There are multiple colors available. You could add colors to highlight texts on a particular topic, or add colors to show verses which indicate a favorite promise. 
The Bible app has a quick search feature which allows for finding a text or word that you need for a particular purpose. It may be to support a statement or idea when preparing a talk. The search feature also helps to correctly cite chapter and verse, in order to quote statements correctly. 
The Young's Literal Translation of the Bible app can be downloaded from the Apple store. It is available offline so that it can always be available to Bible students. It is no longer necessary to carry a hard copy of the Bible everywhere. The YLT Bible is free and easy to understand. For those who find the King James version difficult to grasp, an alternate version helps to grow enlightened understanding of the early textual documents.

Imagine unlimited possibilities in your smart home. Set scenes and fast effects to your mood.
Experience Dance Sensation in your entertainment area with Philips Hue Entertainment.
Feel more in control with schedules and automation from su
bluejetty:00039335:ios.description:
Imagine unlimited possibilities in your smart home. Set scenes and fast effects to your mood.
Experience Dance Sensation in your entertainment area with Philips Hue Entertainment.
Feel more in control with schedules and automation from sunrise to sunset.
Control multiple bridges simultaneously without switching between them.
Supported devices
• Philips Hue bridge
• Philips Hue Bluetooth lights
• deCONZ (ConBee)
• diyHue
• LIFX
Scenes & effects
Create the perfect ambiance from your photos or the included photo library. Experience special animations like lava, fireplace, fireworks, or lightning.
Wake up at sunrise and go to sleep at sunset with fading lights.
Get into the party on the beats of your music. Sync your lights for a night of disco with strobe effects (updates 25 times/sec).
Quick access
Create rooms and groups to organize your lights. You can even put a light in several groups.
Smart lights & controls
The unique ‘Touchlink’ search allows you to find new (3rd party, Zigbee) lights. Use included wizards for easy setup of your devices.
You can set scenes, actions, or even multiple scenes on a button to make your switch a real investment. Experience the right ambiance during different times of your day with your motion sensor. All of your creations are stored on the bridge. Easy for you and your family.
Advanced
Automation allows you to have greater control of your smart home. Turn on your lights when the door opens. Adjust your ventilation when the humidity gets too high. Open or close blinds and curtains based on temperature or sunshine.
Make it look like you are at home using 'Away from Home' (out of home control).
Communicate directly with your Hue bridge using the API debugger. View technical details of your Hue bridge and update its resources like lights and sensors.
You want it all?
Fast performance with ad-free experience. Purchase the premium version to unlock full content.

bluejetty:00024833:ios.description:
Physics game lovers enjoy this new puzzle game in which they draw a safe path for the zip line and avoid the dangers. The mission is to move people cabin to cabin safely. Many dangers and traps are waiting for you on this rope road but if you think strategically and connect the two homes with a safe zip line, passengers will arrive their destination alive.
To rescue the friends waiting at the starting point of this dangerous valley, draw a line with your fingers and after reaching the other home, tap on the screen to let the passengers go on the zip line. How long you hold your finger on the screen, the more passengers do zip line. To avoid the dangers, you can draw the line around the blocks, you can move the line just like a rope. The game mechanic is based on whipping a rope.
There are many hazards and traps to challenge, so this brain training physics puzzle game won't let you get bored. Minimalist and unique design and tons of free puzzle levels keep you entertained for hours. As drawing the line, take the coins and keys into consideration. To collect coins and keys bring some gifts to you.

Our mission is very simple: to bring you the most honest and trustworthy opinions on where to eat around the world. Find a restaurant that’s “Perfect For” every situation. Search restaurant recommendations in our curated guides & reviews, or via map & list views, in over 40 different cities.
Coverage in: New York, London, Los Angeles, Chicago, San Francisco, Boston, Philadelphia, Seattle, Washington DC, Atlanta, Austin, Denver, Paris, Mexico City, Melbourne, Rome, and Tokyo, and beyond with more on the way.

“Apps for finding restaurants are plentiful, but most of them leave me feeling overwhelmed. I want someone to choose for me, and I trust the authors of this app to do that. Their taste has never led me astray.” - Joshua Brustein, The New York Times
In 2021, restaurant discovery platform The Infatuation was acquired by JPMorgan Chase & Co. to accelerate the firm’s investment in dining, and further demonstrates JPMorgan Chase’s commitment to meeting customers where they are with exceptional benefits, useful content and one-of-a-kind experiences, at scale. The Infatuation’s entire business, including Zagat, is a wholly owned subsidiary of JPMorgan Chase.

bluejetty:00186356:ios.description:
**Orboot by PlayShifu: The Smart Globe **
Orboot is a one of a kind globe without any names or borders but various highlights to identify the places with. It adds fun to learning by merging a physical globe with Augmented Reality through the Orboot App on your smartphones and tablets. 
Just scan the Orboot globe with the Orboot app and explore countries and cultures in 3D with detailed information and interactive quizzes and activities. 
Ignite your child’s imagination!
Check out https://playshifu.com to get your own Orboot and other PlayShifu games.
** Features **
-- Scan every small region on your Orboot globe to see the highlights
-- Tap any highlight to get detailed information
-- Get to know some cool facts about each highlight
-- Take a fun quiz about what you’ve learnt
-- Collect the points you’ve earned on your dashboard
-- Categories available - Animals, Monuments, Inventions, Cultures, Cuisines, Inventions, Maps
-- No 3rd party advertising
-- No bluetooth required
** S.T.E.A.M. Ahead **
-- Expands knowledge about the world
-- Builds linguistic abilities
-- Develops cognitive skills
-- Inspires imagination & creativity
-- Encourages enquiry, discovery of information and self-learning
** How It Works **
-- Download the Orboot app 
-- Login to sync your data across several devices
-- Click on the link sent to your inbox to avail the free categories in the app
-- Sync the categories of your choice
-- Scan any small region of the globe
-- Tap on any highlight to learn more
** About Team PlayShifu **
We are a passionate team of parents, early learning experts, innovators and technologists that fit together like puzzle pieces. Our aim is to make every experience exciting and meaningful for kids, and we strive to give the best!
** Contact us **
Your feedback is very important to us. If you have any questions, comments, feedback or need any help, please contact us at: reachout@playshifu.com

bluejetty:00130865:ios.name: JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK
bluejetty:00130865:ios.summary: JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK powered by BMPRO is an RV control and monitoring system for easy management of RV features via an app on your own device. It is specifically designed to work with the North American RVs such as JAYCO, Highland Ridge an
bluejetty:00130865:ios.description:
JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK powered by BMPRO is an RV control and monitoring system for easy management of RV features via an app on your own device. It is specifically designed to work with the North American RVs such as JAYCO, Highland Ridge and Starcraft – check your RV specifications to ensure your vehicle is compatible with this app.
JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK powered by BMPRO brings all the important controls and monitoring functions of the RV to a mobile device via Bluetooth and via cloud.
Control and monitor an RV with confidence and ease from the palm of your hand and enjoy the following JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK powered by BMPRO features*:
• Monitor - water tanks, temperatures, propane levels, tire pressure, battery voltages and more
• Control - lighting, slide-outs, awnings, HVAC, generators and more
• Interact with RV via user-friendly, easy to understand app on your own device
• Multiple communication protocols, including Bluetooth and RVIA industry standard RV-C CAN bus.
JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK on board your RV is flexible and scalable – it is easy to add features and sensors to expand your system through the addition of SmartConnect Bluetooth sensors. Available through RV Dealerships, SmartConnect sensors enable you to monitor propane levels, tire pressure and internal temperatures. The SmartConnect sensors are a DIY installation.
JAYCOMMAND/TravelLINK powered by BMPRO system is co-designed and manufactured by BMPRO, a company with years of experience in the RV industry. BMPRO is one of the pioneers of using digital platforms in RVs with one of the world’s largest install bases of smart power management systems.
*App capabilities vary depending on your RV model.

bluejetty:00166606:ios.description:
Discover a healthier you with EatBetter, the ultimate app for anyone looking to achieve their weight loss, muscle gain, or health maintenance goals—without the hassle. Say goodbye to complex calorie counting and restrictive diets. EatBetter uses cutting-edge AI vision technology to scan your meals, analyze your nutrition, and provide personalized feedback to help you make better food choices effortlessly.
Why EatBetter App?
AI-Powered Meal Scanning: Simply snap a photo of your meal, and let our advanced AI break down the nutritional content. Get instant feedback on your meals with practical tips to improve your diet.
Tailored Nutrition Guidance: Whether you're aiming to lose weight, build muscle, or maintain a healthy lifestyle, EatBetter provides customized advice based on your goals. Our AI adapts to your needs, making it easier than ever to stay on track.
Smart Feedback & Humor: Get real-time feedback on your meals, from gentle reminders to avoid extra fries to humorous warnings about overeating. EatBetter keeps things light-hearted while helping you make smarter choices.
Daily & Meal-Wise Success Metrics: Track your progress with daily summaries of your calorie intake, macronutrient balance, and overall success. See how your meals measure up against your goals, and receive actionable advice to improve.
Motivational Insights: Enjoy personalized meal ratings, complete with haptic feedback and visual cues. Whether it’s a green light for a balanced plate or a red flag for too many treats, EatBetter helps you stay motivated.
Simple, Stress-Free Experience: No need for tedious tracking or logging. Just scan, learn, and enjoy your meals with the confidence that you’re making healthier choices.
Ideal for Everyone:
Busy Professionals: Get quick, actionable feedback on your meals, so you can eat better even on a tight schedule.
Fitness Enthusiasts: Balance your macros and ensure you're getting the right nutrients to fuel your workouts.
Casual Dieters: Learn about healthier eating habits without the stress of strict diets or complex food logs.
Transform the way you eat with EatBetter—your AI food coach that makes healthy eating simple, fun, and effective. 
Start your journey to better eating habits today!

https://www.eatbetter.app/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00016303:ios.description:
Wage war and battle for total world domination in DomiNations. Enter an age of empires as you travel through different eras of history. From the beginnings of the world to the modern age, you’ll need to fight for dominance and secure your empire’s safety. Bring your army to life in real-time strategy games that pit you against your foes across every age of history.
Empires begin as an early settlement that grows through the ages, from the dawn of history to the modern era. Develop, craft and master strategies at the University. Study under history’s greats or explore the new University Hall to enhance your approach to world domination. Build Wonders of the World and dominate battles with high-tech fighter jets from the modern era. Build your base and strengthen your defenses with the Council with new Councilors and Artifacts to give your army the edge in battle.
Build your base, grow your army, and test your strategy against other players in PvP combat. Conquer the globe in World War and take home the spoils of war in DomiNations.
REAL TIME STRATEGY GAMES INTERTWINED WITH WORLD HISTORY
• Strategy games with fun limited-time goals based on actual events from history.
• Collect rare rewards to help your Nation advance so they can conquer the world!
• Upgrade your base and your army with every age.
• Work alongside leaders like Leonardo Da Vinci, Cleopatra, King Sejong, and more.
BUILD AN EMPIRE & LEAD AN ARMY
• Build a base, starting with a small civilization and grow it into a thriving metropolis.
• Expand your kingdom and defend your nation in the age of war.
• Choose one of the great civilizations from history like the Romans, British, Chinese, French, Germans, Japanese, Koreans and Greeks.
• Build historic Wonders of the World, including landmarks like the Pyramids of Egypt and the Roman Colosseum.
• Upgrade your base as you advance through history, tackling historic battle campaigns to collect important resources.
• Resource management through the mechanics of war. Lead your army through battles for untold wealth and total world domination.
WAR SIMULATION GAMES: BATTLE THROUGH THE ERAS
• Simulation games allow you to build an army and lead a colony of early hunters and gatherers on their conquest through the ages from the dawn of civilization to the modern era.
• Conquer the world as one of 8 fearsome Nations on its journey through time.
• Battle your enemies and take over cities for huge bunches of loot!
DISCOVER NEW TECHNOLOGIES
• Research civilizations, new materials, invent advanced weaponry and develop trade to grow a bustling economy.
• Level up through scientific discovery.
• Reinforce your troops with better equipment, upgrade your buildings and town center with modern materials.
• The path to victory is your own. Collect special cosmetic weaponry, armor and color schemes to customize your own Commanders, with a brand new customization system. Showcase your style and strike fear in your enemies.
PVP BATTLES IN STRATEGIC WAR GAMES
• PVP combat awaits. Take on foes one-on-one in battles for greatness.
• Multiplayer war allows you to team up with other skilled rulers and forge an Alliance.
• Unleash your unique battle strategy to outwit and outlast your opponents in 50-on-50 Alliance warfare.
• Resource management through the mechanics of war. Battle for untold wealth and total world domination.
Application Permission Usage Notice:
We request access permissions to provide services as below
• Device ID & phone calls: Identifies the relationship between device & base
• Read, write on external storage: Capturing screenshots shared with customer service team
Privacy Policy:
https://bighugegames.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service:
https://bighugegames.com/terms-of-use/a

bluejetty:00131796:ios.description:
HomeCam is the best way to monitor multiple Apple Home cameras.
View every camera live at the same time, control nearby accessories without leaving the video, and keep an eye on your entire home from a single screen.
Unlike the built-in Home app, HomeCam is designed specifically for homes with multiple cameras, making it faster and easier to see everything that’s happening at a glance.
Featured by MacStories, 9to5Mac and iDownloadBlog.
“I can’t recommend HomeCam enough if you own multiple HomeKit cameras.” - MacStories
“HomeCam is essential if you have more than one HomeKit camera.” - 9to5Mac
• Watch Every Camera Live
View all of your Apple Home cameras simultaneously with true live video, not delayed snapshots. Monitor your entire home in real time without constantly switching between individual camera views.
• Control Your Home While You Watch
Adjust lights, thermostats and other nearby Apple Home accessories without leaving your camera feed. See something? Respond instantly.
• Camera Data at a Glance
Overlay useful information from nearby accessories, including temperature, humidity and air quality directly on top of your camera view, helping you better understand what’s happening in every room.
• Full Screen Camera View
Open any camera in full screen to use two-way audio with supported cameras, zoom in for a closer look, and focus on the areas that matter most.
• Siri Shortcuts
Launch your favourite camera views instantly with Siri or the Shortcuts app. Get to your cameras with a single voice command or automation.
• Privacy First
Protect HomeCam with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode so only you can access your camera feeds.
• Apple Watch
Check your cameras live from your wrist and use two-way audio with supported cameras.
• iPad
Monitor more cameras at once on the larger display and navigate quickly with built-in keyboard shortcuts.
• Apple TV
Turn your television into a live security dashboard and monitor every camera from the comfort of your couch.
One purchase gives you HomeCam on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV.

HomeCam is the best way to monitor multiple Apple Home cameras.

View every camera live at the same time, control nearby accessories without leaving the video, and keep an eye on your entire home from a single screen.

Unlike the built-in Home app, HomeCam is designed specifically for homes with multiple cameras, making it faster and easier to see everything that’s happening at a glance.

Featured by MacStories, 9to5Mac and iDownloadBlog.

“I can’t recommend HomeCam enough if you own multiple HomeKit cameras.” - MacStories

“HomeCam is essential if you have more than one HomeKit camera.” - 9to5Mac

• Watch Every Camera Live
View all of your Apple Home cameras simultaneously with true live video, not delayed snapshots. Monitor your entire home in real time without constantly switching between individual camera views.

• Control Your Home While You Watch

Adjust lights, thermostats and other nearby Apple Home accessories without leaving your camera feed. See something? Respond instantly.

• Camera Data at a Glance
Overlay useful information from nearby accessories, including temperature, humidity and air quality directly on top of your camera view, helping you better understand what’s happening in every room.

• Full Screen Camera View

Open any camera in full screen to use two-way audio with supported cameras, zoom in for a closer look, and focus on the areas that matter most.

• Siri Shortcuts
Launch your favourite camera views instantly with Siri or the Shortcuts app. Get to your cameras with a single voice command or automation.

• Privacy First
Protect HomeCam with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode so only you can access your camera feeds.

• Apple Watch
Check your cameras live from your wrist and use two-way audio with supported cameras.

• iPad
Monitor more cameras at once on the larger display and navigate quickly with built-in keyboard shortcuts.

• Apple TV
Turn your television into a live security dashboard and monitor every camera from the comfort of your couch.

One purchase gives you HomeCam on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV.

YOUR HEALTH, SCANNED AND SIMPLIFIED

WHAT YOU GET
bluejetty:00040734:ios.description:
YOUR HEALTH, SCANNED AND SIMPLIFIED
Vita helps you take control of your health, one scan at a time. Scan the barcode of any food or cosmetic product to instantly see its health rating, ingredient risks, and nutrition facts.
WHAT YOU GET WITH VITA
- Unlimited barcode scanning with instant health scores
- Expert summaries that break down every product in plain language
- Ingredient, additive, and nutrition risk analysis at a glance
- Instant health warnings across skin, sleep, energy, and overall health
- See who really owns each product — from parent companies to conglomerates
- Advanced search filters to find cleaner products faster
- Personalized guidance from the Vita Health Expert
- Health badges for pregnancy, children, elderly, and fertility concerns
- Save, organize, and track your product history
BACKED BY REAL LAB TESTING
Vita goes beyond labels. Our ratings are powered by a growing database that includes independent lab testing for heavy metals, glyphosate, PFAS, and other contaminants. Browse lab-tested products directly in the app and see exactly what's in your food, not just what's on the label.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Vita requires a subscription to access all features. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.
Have questions or feedback? Contact us at support@vitascan.ai
By using Vita, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
- Terms: https://vitascan.ai/terms-of-service/
- Privacy Policy: https://vitascan.ai/privacy-policy/

ebtEDGE mobile application simplifies your life when you depend on SNAP or TANF benefits allowing you to view your benefits at the touch of a finger. ebtEDGE allows you to check your balances, review your transaction history. • The most private and secure EBT application on the market.

• If your phone supports Apple Face ID, running iOS 11+ and you’ve enrolled your face, quickly access the balance of your accounts by looking at your phone. 
• Securely login with User ID and Password.
• View your deposit history.
• View your transaction history.
• View your benefit schedule.
• Select a PIN.
• Need help? We have plenty of that in the Help Center.
• Locate SNAP retailers near your location or where you are going to with the location services.
• Set your language preferences to English, Spanish or Haitian Creole.
• New features around the corner… stay tuned….
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Only certain devices are capable for either touch id or face id login.
2. For State SNAP or TANF cardholders with eligible cards.

bluejetty:00180220:ios.description:
Keep track of time without being distracted by the device! 
Simple and easy timer that repeats at your chosen interval.
FEATURES
- Many sounds to select + the ability to add custom ones.
- Up to 4 pinned and up to 5 recent Quick Start items.
- Long intervals - up to 99 hours! 
- Vibration, if the sound is off.
- Works in the background.
- 3 timer output modes: intervals, total time, countdown.
- You can cancel or pause the timer with help of a notification.
- Flexibility and minimalism.
- Shake To Start - can be enabled in settings.
- Prevent Lockscreen - another useful setting, the screen will not lock, while the timer is running.
USE CASES
Here is a list of use cases based on the real feedback:
Fitness and health:
- Stretching
- Stationary bicycle (interval training)
- On a treadmill
- For HIIT
- Jogging
- Timed medication
- Boxing
Cooking
- While frying potatoes
- Roasting steaks
- Checking an oven or a grill to prevent burning
Learning & science
- Foreign language learning
- As a lab timer
- Periodic data collection
- Speech training
- Presentation timing
Other
- Mindfulness
- Communication
- To have a sense of time flying away :)
HELP
Q: Why the timer doesn't work in the background?
A: You should allow notifications.
Q: How to turn off the sound and turn on the vibration?
A: On the device, turn the Silent Mode on. (Side Switch)
Q: How can I add a custom sound?
A: There are four ways. Choose one depending where is the sound file located.
* If the sound on your Mac or PC:
1. Connect the device.
2. Open Finder and select the device.
3. Select Files in the menu. There you'll find 'Periodic +' folder.
4. Drug and drop the sound file there.
* From Files app on iPhone:
1. Copy the required file.
2. Open Periodic + folder and paste it.
* From another app on iPhone (like Mail):
1. Open the app where the file is located.
2. Find and touch Share button (it may have different name, for example Export).
3. In the appearing Share Sheet find the list of apps. If there is no Periodic +, touch More and enable it.
4. Now select Periodic + in the Share dialog and the sound will be imported.
* And the most convenient "+" button!
1. Open Sounds tab.
2. Hit the "+" button in the "Folder" section and pick your file.
Q: Alert is limited for 5 seconds!
A: Go to Settings app, then Periodic + > Notifications > Banner Style > Persistent.
Q: How to switch the Timer Output Mode?
A: To switch the Output Mode touch the timer display at the top of the screen.
Q: What is Shake To Start for?
A: Shake To Start setting allows to start/cancel the timer by shaking the device. Thus, you don't touch the screen, what can be useful while cooking, for example. For this mode, in order to work, the app should be open.
This app has a free version with limited features.
If you still have questions or suggestions, you can visit the support page (https://goo.gl/forms/pggVBcaBxdW85EGE3), the Facebook group (http://www.facebook.com/groups/PeriodicTimer/) or you can email me (periodictimer.sup@gmail.com).
If you like the app - please, rate it!

bluejetty:00167532:ios.description:
FYI is an AI-powered productivity tool designed to serve the creative community and beyond— finally an all-encompassing tool for the ones who drive culture forward.
On FYI, you can:
• ORGANIZE your creative work into Projects and turn on “AI in Projects” to improve your workflow.
• GENERATE TEXT and IMAGES with FYI.AI, your creative co-pilot
• CUSTOMIZE YOUR FYI.AI by selecting from various AI voice personas
• LISTEN TO RAiDiO.FYI, AI-powered interactive music stations
• CHAT and SHARE FILES with collaborators and team members
• MAKE VIDEO CALLS while sharing content on the screen
• SECURE YOUR DATA with the most advanced end-to-end encryption
• PRESENT your work in beautiful, interactive layouts – ALL IN ONE APP
Use FYI to:
BUILD PROJECTS. Organize your work into Projects by adding photos, videos, documents, or any assets you want to keep track of or manage. A Project can be a design portfolio, a pitch deck, a collaborative workspace, or even your personal archives. Share Projects with your team and assign editor roles. Control access settings to make your Projects private or public. Then, use Projects as a new way of sharing content with the world. Public projects have customizable links and can be viewed on any web browser. 
TURBOCHARGE YOUR CREATIVITY with FYI.AI. Ask FYI.AI to draft stories, song lyrics, blog posts, marketing copy, or any creative content - and see the results within seconds. Use the AI Art tool to generate images. Choose from a variety of AI voice personas to customize your experience. Riff with FYI.AI naturally like a member of your own creative team. With FYI.AI, you can ideate faster than ever before and turbocharge your creative output. You can now turn on “AI in Projects” to enhance your workflows.
MAKE "CONTENT CALLS" AND STAY IN SYNC WITH YOUR TEAM. Launch audio or video calls with up to 8 participants from any piece of media content within the app. Use "SYNC MODE" to control the screen for other viewers, and have them synced with your every move as you collaborate. Use Content Calls for working sessions with your team, give interactive presentations, or even turn group calls into album listening parties.
ACCESS A DEEPER CALL HISTORY. Ever been presented with a deck on a conference call, only to lose it after the call ends? Not with FYI—your app automatically saves all files shared on a call in your private history, so you can access them again any time. Just tap on a “CALL CARD" in your chat thread, or access it from your call logs. No need to ever send a follow-up message for that missing pitch, mp3 or doc!
SECURE YOUR DATA. As a creative, your content is your livelihood, and it deserves the utmost protection. Everything on FYI including chats, projects, and calls is encrypted using ECDSA and ECDHE, the same cryptography methods used in securing blockchain transactions. ONLY YOU have access to your private key – no one else, not even FYI. 
FOCUS YOUR IDEAS. FYI empowers teams to stay focused and be more productive in a remote modern society. We build features to make every user a power user. Voice notes are transcribed, searchable and interactive. Send messages in any language, and we’ll translate it for you. Never lose track of important information.
Terms of Use: https://fyi.ai/terms.html

bluejetty:00073357:ios.description:
Come to the finish line first without breaking your car in this exciting casual game that takes you on a thrilling ride down massive ramps.
With its intuitive controls and challenging levels, this game will test your driving skills and reflexes, as you jump behind the wheel of your car and perform daring stunts. 
You play as a driver, who should race your car down dangerous slopes and reach the finish line before your opponents. 
Remember, it's not just about speed — you'll need to use strategy and precision to master the ramps and outrace your conteders. 
Become a ramp racing hero in this fun and addictive game. Put your driving skills to the test as you jump and speed down a steep track, maneuvering through tight turns and performing crazy stunts. 
The game offers a variety of race tracks, each with its own unique challenges. From massive jumps to tight turns, RR 3D will test your driving skills and reaction time. 
With its stunning 3D graphics and realistic physics, you will feel like you're actually driving down these raceways at breakneck speed.
Choose from a variety of cars, each with its own unique look and attributes, and master the ramps in this action-packed arena. Whether you prefer a fast sports car or a heavy-duty truck, you'll find the perfect vehicle for your driving style. 
Test your reaction time and push your limits to reach the finish line first, outracing your opponents without crashing your car. 
Show off your skills as you soar through the air and become the king of the road. 
Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a newcomer to the racing world, RR 3D is the ultimate test of your abilities. So forget about asphalt — there are only ramps and bridges here. Knock your opponents off the track, don't crash your own car and claim your victory.
So what are you waiting for? Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled ride through the skies and become the ultimate ramp racing hero. Prove yourself as the skilled driver and experience the thrill of this fast-paced and action-packed game. 
Join the race and let the excitement begin!
Privacy policy: https://aigames.ae/policy

bluejetty:00088130:ios.description:
Welcome to Chamberly, your ultimate community support and management app where personal growth meets mindfulness. Chamberly is not just a mental health app; it’s a comprehensive support app that offers a unique, safe space fostering connections among people facing life's diverse challenges. Whether you're dealing with anxiety, depression, PTSD, bipolar disorder, or seeking a stress relief app, Chamberly is here to support you.
Why Choose Chamberly?
Chamberly isn’t just a listening app; it's a therapy app where you can freely express yourself, share your journey, and discover a supportive community committed to mental health and wellness. Utilize our Smart Journal system, integrated with OpenAI’s ChatGPT technology, to revolutionize how you track and reflect on your mental health journey. Our AI-driven features make Chamberly an innovative counselor app that adapts to your emotional needs, providing insights and guidance personalized just for you.
Key Features of Chamberly:
- Real People, Confidential & Supportive Community: Connect with others who share similar experiences in a judgment-free zone, fostering meaningful relationships and mutual support as a safe space app.
- Personal AI Therapist: Leveraging cutting-edge AI, our therapist learns from your journal entries to offer tailored advice and uncover deep emotional insights in this management app.
- Anxiety and Depression Relief: Engage with tools designed to help manage and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression.
- Diverse Topics: From addiction recovery to school and career challenges, and MOGII/LGBTQ+ issues, our community covers it all.
- Safe Space for Venting: A safe environment where your identity remains protected, allowing you to share and vent without fear.
- Engage and Grow with Chamberly: At Chamberly, we believe in the power of community and the strength of collective support. Here, you can find group support for various challenges like grief, PTSD, and bipolar disorder in this group support app. Our platform is more than just a counselor app; it’s a holistic space for self-discovery and mental resilience.
- Gamification: Unlock badges and receive coins that you can spend around the app.
- Customize your profile and connect with others who share your interests
Download Chamberly today to start your journey towards a healthier, more balanced life. Use our Smart Journal for reflective journaling and access personalized insights that help you understand your feelings and behaviors. With Chamberly, take the first step in confronting life's challenges head-on, equipped with the best tools for mental health and personal growth.
Embark on your path to mental wellness with Chamberly, where every member finds a voice, feels heard, and grows stronger together. Download now and transform your mental health journey with Chamberly – where healing begins with sharing and support.
Find support on issues such as stress and anxiety, addiction, depression, eating disorder, trauma, personality disorder, problems in relationships or friendships, student or career life challenges, self-harm, autism, bipolar, psychosis, ADHD, schizophrenia, MOGII / LGBTQ+, encountering racism, healthy living, and so much more!

bluejetty:00016968:ios.description:
The App Store’s top Texas Hold’em odds/equity calculator.
(The *Advanced* version of PokerCruncher.)
Take your game to the next level with PokerCruncher, an advanced professional-level hand ranges and flop texture analysis Texas Hold’em odds/equity calculator that goes well beyond the standard features.
*** Pay once and enjoy forever ***
No in-app purchases/fees.
Continual improvement for many years.
*** Tutorial and videos on our website ***
***
New: Links to videos and blogs on PokerCruncher (by pros/coaches) directly inside the app.
***
"... incredibly powerful tool ... must-have application."
 -- PokerSoftware.com
"... essentially functions as an advanced version of the PC’s PokerStove application."
 -- Bluff Magazine
Great reviews from poker experts, pros, and coaches, and on our TwoPlusTwo forum thread.
(See our website.)
--> Super fast and easy to use for basic hand matchups.
--> Advanced features like hand ranges, Deal-To-Flop, flop texture analysis, and many stats for serious strategy analysis.
--> Tutorial, videos.
Most poker odds/equity calc apps are nowhere as powerful as PokerCruncher. Some don’t even support random hands (let alone hand ranges), some don’t let you enter hands for multiple players, some make an incomplete attempt at hand ranges, …
PokerCruncher is the full real deal, and has a clean and easy-to-use interface.
Start using PokerCruncher today to improve your game and your results!
***
iPhone, iPad, and Mac(Expert) versions available
***
--- Completely General ---
Up to 10 players, with specific cards, random/unknown cards, or hand ranges for each player. Dead cards, %age’s or n:1 odds, …
--- Fully General Hand Ranges ---
Poker is a game of incomplete information; we need to think in terms of *ranges of hands*. PokerCruncher surpasses the standard features, e.g. range equity breakdown heat maps and hand combo stats. Full grid of all 169 starting hands, top x% of hands slider, select hand combos (suits and weights) in hand ranges, extensive built-in hand ranges, save/load and export/import hand ranges, …
--- Deal-To-Flop and Flop Texture Analysis ---
--- Many Stats ---
Hand type stats (OnePair, TwoPair, etc.), flop hit stats, odds for flopping draws and combination draws, OnePair breakdown stats, …
---
Save/Load and Export/Import Scenarios (Hands) and Hand Ranges
---
---
Enter/Edit Scenario Notes
---
--- Tutorial and Videos ---
If thinking in terms of hand ranges and flop texture analysis (techniques advanced players and pros use) are new to you, no problem, see the PokerCruncher Tutorial and videos on our website.
***
See our website for our strong free app update history over many years.
***
GENERAL AND OTHER FEATURES:
+ Runs locally on device, internet connection not needed
+ Fast Monte Carlo simulation, complete enumeration for some common cases
+ Completely general tool, e.g. up to 10 players
+ Specific cards, random/unknown cards, fully general hand ranges, for each player
+ Generate random player and board cards to set up what-if and test scenarios
+ Dead cards
+ Fold/Un-Fold players
+ %age’s or n:1 odds
Please see the PokerCruncher Tutorial and videos on our website for more information.
App Store reviews are greatly appreciated, thank you.
***
Also please check out our companion app Tournament Cruncher (ICM).
***

bluejetty:00080639:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00080639:ios.summary:
Ya está disponible El Diccionario Teológico del Nuevo Testamento mas completo y sencillo que puedas encontrar con gran cantidad de definiciones y términos teológicos explicados y ordenados para su fácil compresión.
Una aplicación que te ay
bluejetty:00080639:ios.description:
Ya está disponible El Diccionario Teológico del Nuevo Testamento mas completo y sencillo que puedas encontrar con gran cantidad de definiciones y términos teológicos explicados y ordenados para su fácil compresión.
Una aplicación que te ayudara a responder cualquier concepto en tu estudio acerca de la teología.
Diccionario Teológico y Biblia es una herramienta muy práctica para los que deseen consultar cualquier término relacionado con ésta así como para nuevas mentes curiosas que desean iniciarse en el vocabulario de la Biblia.
Aprende nuevas palabras y términos con este práctico Diccionario Teológico y amplia tu conocimiento y tu vocabulario.
Te permite buscar con gran facilidad cualquier concepto solo haciendo clic en una letra.
La teología (del griego θεος [theos], ‘Dios’, y λογος [logos], ‘estudio’, ‘razonamiento’, por lo que significaría ‘el estudio de Dios’ y, por ende, ‘el estudio de las cosas o hechos relacionados con Dios’) es el estudio y conjunto de conocimientos acerca de la divinidad.
La teología cristiana es el conjunto de creencias del cristianismo, las cuales están basadas fundamentalmente en la Biblia. Para los cristianos, tales creencias son consideradas «verdades fundamentales».
La Teología parte del hecho de la existencia inequívoca de Dios. Es por ello que la Teología no se ocupa de la demostración empírica de su existencia, puesto que da por hecho esta afirmación.
Te lo ponemos todo a un solo click, Tan solo adéntrate en su menú ordenado por letra y entra a la que desees. Una vez allí encontrarás un interesante listado con todas sus palabras y definiciones las cuales podrás compartir a través de tus redes sociales favoritas solo con tocas la pantalla y seleccionar el texto deseado.
La aplicación incluye recursos teológicos, entre los que podrás aprender teología sistemática, teología moral, teología espiritual, teología fundamental, teología pastoral, fichas teológicas, cristología, concordancia temática, biblioteca de teología o una enciclopedia.
Algunas de las preguntas y respuestas acerca de la teología incluidas en la app Diccionario Teológico y Biblia:
¿Qué es teología práctica? 
¿Qué es teología filosófica? 
¿Qué es el nuevo pacto? 
¿Qué son los pactos en la Biblia? 
¿Qué es la Apologética Cristiana? 
¿Qué es el fundamentalismo? 
¿Qué es el arminianismo? 
¿Cuál es el punto de vista cristiano sobre el mundo?
¿Qué es la teología natural? 
¿Es bíblico el trinitarianismo? 
¿Qué es la teología histórica? 
¿Qué es teología cristiana? 
Diccionario Teológico y Biblia incluye mucha información interesante sobre la teología que te hará ver el mundo cristiano desde una perspectiva global.
Además esta herramienta dispone de una descripción de la teología para que aprendas con más exactitud qué es, y una completa Biblia offline que podrás leer cuando desees.
Disfruta de la teología sin complicaciones y de una forma amena y directa.
Descarga Diccionario Teológico y Biblia y comparte con nosotros tu experiencia.

【产品特色】

bluejetty:00093250:ios.description:
Local Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Local Bank:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Local Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Local Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

** More than 10,000,000 musicians are now using the Tuner by Piascore! **
"Tuner by Piascore" is a chromatic instrument tuner and pitch pipe that allows you to quickly and accurately tune your instrument using the built-in mic in your iPhone or iPad.
"Tuner by Piascore" supports a custom temperaments, transposition, notations such as solfège, adjustable calibration and more. By spectrum power indicator, you can understand sound more intuitively. "Tuner by Piascore" packs more power than most pro tuners, yet it is simple enough for everyone to use.
"Tuner by Piascore" can tune acoustic or electric guitar, bass, bowed strings, woodwinds, brass, piano, tympani, and any other instrument that can sustain a tone.
Free version "Tuner Lite by Piascore" is offered.
** Features **
- Needle meter display
- Ultra responsive 50 cents range fine tuning display
- LED display easy-to-understand high and low sound
- Accuracy ±0.01 semitone (±1 cent)
- Landscape view (iPhone5 or later)
- Power spectrum indicator
- Selectable Temperaments
- Selectable Notations (such as Solfège)
- Support for transposing instruments
- Pitch Pipe/Tone generator
- Automatic reference note calibration
- Changing the wallpaper
** Contact **
: http://piascore.com/service/tuner/
: contact@piascore.com

Write R code directly on your iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch! This app is ideal for learning and testing code snippets!
R is a programming language and software environment for statistical computing and graphics supported by the R Foundation for Statistical Computing. The R language is widely used among statisticians and data miners for developing statistical software and data analysis
Features:
- Compile and run your program
- Supports plotting and graphing
- View program output or detailed error
- Select and run chunk of codes
- Custom keyboard for easy input of frequently used characters
- Optimized for connecting with external physical/bluetooth keyboard
- Advanced source code editor with syntax highlighting and line numbers
- Open, save, import and share R files
- Language reference
- Access thousands of packages
- Install additional packages from CRAN and Bioconductor (BiocManager)
Limitations:
- Internet connection is required for compilation
- Maximum program running time is 20s
- One file can be run at a time
- Some file system, network and graphics functions may be limited
- This is a batch compiler; interactive programs, for instance swirl, are not supported. If your program provides an input prompt, enter the input in the Input tab prior to compilation. See the Reference tab in the app for code examples.

bluejetty:00063278:ios.summary:

A Lovely Home for Your Music
Pu
bluejetty:00063278:ios.description:
A beautiful local music file player — MP3, FLAC, WAV, and more — with an equalizer, widgets, Timed Lyrics, CarPlay support, and more. Designed for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. Free for up to 80 songs.
A Lovely Home for Your Music
Put your high-quality music file collection in one of the nicest UIs out there.
See It Shine
Clutter-free interface with big, beautiful artwork, and clean typography.
Glide Through It
Navigate with silky-smooth gestures and handy shortcuts to find things fast.
Queue It Up
Easily queue up songs to play next, and edit the upcoming list with Up Next.
Search, Fast
Pull down from anywhere in your library to invoke Search, and use the Return key to select the top result.
On Your Watch
Sync music from your iPhone and take it with you, offline on your Apple Watch.
Connect Between Devices
Besides Apple Watch, Doppi runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. You can transfer music and 'follow' another device's contents. 
Follow Remote Folders
Doppi can add any folder you can see in the Files app, including those in a cloud provider or NAS, and automatically download their new files.
Make Playlists
Create playlists and add songs with multitouch drag-and-drop.
Edit Metadata
Change information like title, artist, album, lyrics, artwork, and more on your music files.
Now Playing Widget
Large artwork and playback controls (while playing), available in 3 sizes.
Equalizer
Enjoy your way with an 8-band 6-preset (+ Custom) equalizer, available right on the player menu.
Timed Lyrics
Have a sing-along! LRC-formatted timed lyrics are shown synced to the music.
Get Lyrics
Doppi can (try to) automatically fetch lyrics for you! Just tap Get Lyrics.
Make It Your Own
Choose from 6 preset highlight colors or a custom one, 4 light and dark themes, several icon variations, pick your library sections and their order, and more.
Hello Tab
Your most loved, most played, and most recent albums and artists: all in one place.
CarPlay
Drive safely and enjoy your music from the intuitive Doppi interface for CarPlay.
Scrobble to Last.fm
Log into your Last.fm account from Settings to start sending your Doppi plays to the service.
After This Song
Choose what you want to happen when the current song ends: pause, shuffle all, play a playlist, and more.
Continue With Album
Ever shuffled your music, found a song you loved, and wished you could continue the album instead? Doppi can make it happen, from After This Song.
Ask Siri to DJ
Your assistant can play songs, albums, artists, playlists, and genres from your library — just ask it to play in Doppi.
Shortcuts
As you play your music, those actions will be suggested to you by the system and appear on the Shortcuts app.
Completely Readable
With thick fonts, support for Dynamic Type, and high contrast themes, your eyes wonʼt get in the way of your ears.
Just Much Nicer
Doppi has been carefully designed with clean typography, pleasing contrast, and elegant motion. Enjoy your music in a joyfully clean UI.
Give your music the lovely home it deserves.
————
Important notices:
Doppi does not include any music. It's designed to play your music files, that you manually transfer to your device. It does not support playing music from any streaming service, or music that is digitally protected.
In-app purchases are governed by the Apple Standard Terms of Use, available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

bluejetty:00121262:ios.description:
Bring your local, cloud and NAS music into one Hi-Res player.
Ever Play gives you control of your own library, with lossless audio, DSD playback, offline caching and detailed output options for external DACs.
Built for listeners who collect FLAC, ALAC, WAV, APE or DSD files and want to enjoy them without depending on a streaming catalog.
Everplay supports all popular formats including Hi-Res ones. 
One of the most important feature of Everplay is that it support DSD(up to 11.2MHz，aka. DSD256) playback, in term of PCM and DoP. When PCM mode is selected, DSD is converted to and output as PCM. When DoP mode is selected, DSD is outputted as DSD over PCM.(Connected device must be DoP-compatible to this mode, otherwise, DSD will be outputed as PCM even DoP mode is selected.)
Everplay support up to 384kHz/32bit music file and upsampling output Mode, you can select custom output sample rate to playback. It can automatically choose the max support format to playback, so you never need to worry about output device change.
Everplay support Wi-Fi transfer, iTunes files sharing and Airdrop. Through Wi-Fi Transfer, you can share music files between computer and Everplay app with browser.

bluejetty:00077549:ios.summary:
Created by the team behind the top-rated health and fitness apps Sleepwave and SnoreLab, Motionscape offers a truly unique experience, powered by innovative motion-sensing technology.

UNIQUE MOTION-SENSING TECHNOLOGY

bluejetty:00077549:ios.description:
Created by the team behind the top-rated health and fitness apps Sleepwave and SnoreLab, Motionscape offers a truly unique experience, powered by innovative motion-sensing technology.
Key features:
UNIQUE MOTION-SENSING TECHNOLOGY
• Motionscape features revolutionary patented technology using the speaker in your phone to vibrate the air which can sense movements near your phone by reflecting energy to the microphone.
INTERACTIVE VISUALS
• Unique immersive visualizations to help enhance your focus and avoid distractions during your breathwork practice.
GUIDED SESSIONS
• Soothing guided breathing sessions with easy-to-follow instructions that will help you make the most of your practice.
DAILY BREATHING
• A relaxation experience that is refreshed on a daily basis. Come back every day for a new mix of visuals to relax and play with.
GUIDED MEDITATIONS
• A growing collection of insightful guided meditations to help deepen your mindfulness practice and explore your consciousness.
RELAXING GAMES
• Relax and immerse yourself in calming games.
MINDFUL MINUTES APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
• Connect to Apple Health to track breathing sessions as Mindful Minutes. Your breathing sessions will appear as Mindful Minutes in Apple Health.
SOOTHING SOUNDS
• Enhance your experience with relaxing sounds alongside the stunning moving visuals.
WHAT OUR USERS SAY
“I don’t often take time to simply calm down, and using this app really showed me how much I could benefit from that practice.”
“I love that it guides me through beautiful visuals as I connect to my breath”
“Accurate and peaceful - It actually works well and makes me feel at peace and very relaxed perfect right before you sleep”
“It's a fantastic tool for relaxation and creativity”
“I am truly impressed by the technology… it felt as if I was doing some kind of magic.”
“The motion sensing is surprisingly responsive and accurate, and it's super satisfying to be able to control the visuals so precisely.”
Motionscape is free to download. For additional information, please read our Privacy policy (https://motionscape.app/privacy-policy) and our Terms & conditions (https://motionscape.app/terms-and-conditions).

bluejetty:00098153:ios.name: Draw One Puzzle: Brain Games
bluejetty:00098153:ios.summary:
Flush Rush Puzzle Drawing – The Wildest Toilet Puzzle Escape!
Welcome to Flush Rush Puzzle Drawing, a hilariously chaotic puzzle adventure that combines brain-bending draw mechanics, toilet monster mayhem, and bathroom-themed madness like y
bluejetty:00098153:ios.description:
Flush Rush Puzzle Drawing – The Wildest Toilet Puzzle Escape!
Welcome to Flush Rush Puzzle Drawing, a hilariously chaotic puzzle adventure that combines brain-bending draw mechanics, toilet monster mayhem, and bathroom-themed madness like you've never seen before! Whether you’re a fan of logic puzzles, quirky humor, or just want to master the art of peeing under pressure — this is your next addiction.
One Finger. One Line. One Mission: Don’t Mess Up.
Your goal is deceptively simple: complete each puzzle using a single continuous line. No lifting your finger. No retracing. Every level is a test of focus, planning, and perfect timing. But don’t let the simplicity fool you — things get weird fast. You'll draw through bathrooms filled with twisting paths, collapsing floors, and sneaky tricks that will keep you guessing. As you progress, the puzzles evolve into full-blown brain games where one wrong stroke means you have to start over… or worse, get caught by the Toilet Head Monster.
Meet the Toilet Head Monster... and Try to Escape It!
Deep in the pipes of Flush Rush lives your greatest enemy: the Toilet Head Monster — a creepy, cloggy creature that lurks behind every door. In many levels, you're not just solving puzzles — you're doing it under pressure, racing against time before the monster catches up. It adds an intense hide-and-seek element to traditional line puzzles. If you stop, stall, or mess up your stroke, you're flushed back to square one!
Join Forces with Teddy Rush & Pencil Man
You’re not alone on this wild ride. Meet Teddy Rush, a stuffed hero with nerves of steel, and Pencil Man, a grumpy doodler who draws danger away with style. These quirky companions help guide you through bizarre bathrooms and give you hints, jokes, and even power-ups. They’re more than comic relief — they’re part of your survival strategy.
From Easy Potty Paths to Nightmare Toilets
The level design in Flush Rush Puzzle Drawing is packed with variety. Start with basic lines and shapes, then move into complex labyrinths that combine:
Maze logic puzzles
One-line animal matching
Object-finding mini-games
Run-and-draw hybrid challenges
Obstacle escapes with moving hazards
Each environment has a unique look and feel: creepy public restrooms, jungle potty temples, space toilets, and more — all rendered in hilarious 3D visuals.
Challenge Modes & Mul

bluejetty:00163963:ios.description:
WhatisRemoved+ - Recover Deleted WhatsApp Messages and Media Easily!
WhatisRemoved+ is a smart and user-friendly app designed to help you recover deleted WhatsApp messages and media files, but with certain limitations. The app allows you to retrieve chats, photos, videos, and documents that you have already imported into the app before deletion. If content is not imported in advance, it cannot be recovered.
This transparency ensures that WhatisRemoved+ adheres to privacy standards while giving you better control over your data.
1. Key Features:
Recover Deleted Chats and Media
Retrieve deleted WhatsApp messages and media (photos, videos, documents, etc.) seamlessly. Please note: only chats and media files imported into the app before deletion can be recovered.
2. Organized Media Gallery
Access your imported and recovered media files in a structured gallery-style layout. This makes finding and managing your files faster and more convenient.
3. Direct Chat Without Saving Numbers
Need to send a WhatsApp message without adding a contact to your phonebook? WhatisRemoved+ lets you chat with any number directly, making it ideal for temporary or one-time conversations.
4. Set Message Reminders
Stay organized with the reminder feature. Set alerts for important messages to ensure you never miss sending a timely update.
5. User-Friendly Interface
With its sleek design and simple layout, WhatisRemoved+ makes navigation and feature usage intuitive and effortless.
Important Information:
WhatisRemoved+ does not access or interact with WhatsApp servers or databases. It works by monitoring notifications and media folders on your device to recover only the content that was previously imported into the app.
Data recovery is limited to imported content. If a message or media file is not imported into the app before deletion, it cannot be retrieved.
The app complies with all privacy and safety standards, ensuring your data remains secure and confidential.
Legal and Policy Information:
Privacy Policy: https://whatisremoved.blogspot.com/2025/01/privacy-policy-for-whatisremoved.html
Terms & Conditions: https://whatisremoved.blogspot.com/2025/01/terms-conditions-for-whatisremoved.html
EULA: https://whatisremoved.blogspot.com/2025/01/end-user-license-agreement-eula-of.html
Disclaimer:
WhatisRemoved+ does not promote or enable any fraudulent activity. The app is strictly for personal use and only functions within the bounds of user-provided permissions. Users are encouraged to use the app responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws.
