bluejetty:00024401:ios.description:
Manage your stress with Stress Watch: Heart Rate Monitor!
Stress affects your mental and physical health. With Stress Watch app, you can monitor your stress levels, track your heart rate variability (HRV), and gain insights to improve your well-being. With cutting-edge technology and integration with Apple Health, it provides accurate insights and personalized support to help you stay balanced in your daily life.
How does it work?
Stress Watch integrates seamlessly with Apple Health to track your HRV, sleep, and activity data. All you need to do is sync the app with your Apple Watch or mobile device. It identifies your Stress Score by analyzing HRV data, demographic details like age and gender, and other key factors such as time of day. With just a few taps, you’ll have a clear view of your stress levels.
What are the features?
- Integrates with Apple Health to sync HRV, sleep, and activity data.
- Provides a personalized Stress Score based on your unique metrics.
- Real-time notifications and alerts when your stress levels are high.
- Historical data tracking with detailed visualizations and trends.
- Personalized onboarding to tailor the app to your needs.
- Option to unlock advanced features with a premium subscription.
Why this app is right for you:
- You want to monitor your stress and emotions.
- You need real-time alerts when stress levels rise.
- You’re looking for a comprehensive tool to track HRV, sleep, and activity.
- You want to visualize your stress trends and take proactive steps toward better health.
Your Health, Your Data
Stress Watch values your privacy. All data is securely handled and stored, ensuring you have full control over what is shared.
Take control of your stress and maintain inner balance with us — a solution designed to help you stay calm and in control.
In-app Subscriptions:
• Subscribed users have unlimited access to the sleep tracking features and sounds services.
• Unsubscribed users can only use those services with limited quota per day.
• Users can subscribe one week (USD 2.99$) or one month (USD 7.99$) auto renewing subscription.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use: https://smartwidgetlabs.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://smartwidgetlabs.com/privacy-policy/
You are welcome to contact us at support@smartwidgetlabs.com

bluejetty:00129614:ios.description:

bluejetty:00161825:ios.summary:
Hypertron is a groovebox for iPhone and iPad that combines simple design with powerful tools for flexible music production on the go.
SEQUENCER
- Create patterns and store them in sequences, takes and groups
- Each pad can have an individu
bluejetty:00161825:ios.description:
Hypertron is a groovebox for iPhone and iPad that combines simple design with powerful tools for flexible music production on the go.
SEQUENCER
- Create patterns and store them in sequences, takes and groups
- Each pad can have an individual bar length of up to 64 bars
- Last Step function for each pad, enabling polyrhythms ( with Performance Mode setting )
- Duplicate takes and groups with drag & drop
- Switch between 16th and 32nd notes using Split-Step swipe gesture
- Play and record melodies with the virtual keyboard and arpeggiator
- Get creative with an innovative note repeat slider
- Set custom group lengths, measured in bars or steps
- Adjust global swing and set the swing amount for each pad
- Customize pads, takes and groups with colors and rearrange them using drag & drop
- Auto-toggle loops at bar end
- Trigger pads in LIVE mode
SAMPLER
- Record samples using your microphone or USB interface
- Generate samples with AI using multiple models to choose from (requires account registration)
- Adjust start/end positions and add fade-in and fade-out to your samples
- PRO: Slice samples with multi-slice sampling and autoslicing
- PRO: Edit samples in the Sample Editor with multiple tools (duplicate, trim, remove, silence, reverse, normalize, pitch, timestretch, volume)
- PRO: Import samples (WAV, MP3, MP4, M4A)
- PRO: Export samples (WAV)
EFFECTS
- Add multiple effects to each pad: lowpass, highpass, reverb
- PRO effects: bitcrusher, compressor, delay, distortion, phaser, tape, repeater, tremolo, pitch, timestretch, randomizer
- PRO: Access additional effect settings
- Automate effects with swipe gestures or fine-tune them in the editor
- Select and adjust effects on pads using swipe gestures in EFFECTS mode
MIXER
- Adjust levels and effects in the mixer
- PRO: Route outputs to busses and add effects to these busses
- Select channel outputs in the Mixer with support for multichannel USB interfaces
- Send MIDI OUT separately for each channel
- Save your FX selection as default in the Mixer
SYNTHESIZER
- A simple, yet effective monophonic synthesizer: two oscillators and one LFO, controlling frequency and filter separately
- Sync the synthesizer oscillators from 32 bars down to 1/32 notes
- PRO: Adjust the synthesizer’s suboscillator, delay, glide parameter and bandpass filter
CONNECTIVITY
- Sync to other devices with Ableton Link
- Connect external MIDI keyboards via USB or Bluetooth
- AUv3 with resizable interface and multichannel support (via In-App Purchase)
REALTIME EXPORT
- Export your project (WAV, M4A)
- PRO: Export every individual track of your project (WAV)
- PRO: Export individual files as ZIP
- PRO: Export masterbus as M4A
AVAILABLE RESOURCES
- All devices: 16 takes and 16 groups
- Standalone on iPhone: 6 tracks
- Standalone on iPhone X and newer: 12 tracks
- Standalone on iPad: 16 tracks
- AUv3: 12 tracks
Requires iPhone 8 or higher. Requires iPad 5th Gen or higher.
HYPERTRON is free to use with unlimited playtime and the ability to record as many samples as you want. For more amazing features, go PRO and unlock the full potential of HYPERTRON across all devices with a one-time purchase inside the app.

- Duplicate takes and groups with drag & drop
- Switch between 16th and 32nd notes using Split-Step swipe gesture
- Play and record melodies with the virtual keyboard and arpeggiator
- Get creative with an innovative note repeat slider
- Set custom group lengths, measured in bars or steps
- Adjust global swing and set the swing amount for each pad
- Customize pads, takes and groups with colors and rearrange them using drag & drop
- Auto-toggle loops at bar end
- Trigger pads in LIVE mode

SAMPLER
- Record samples using your microphone or USB interface
- Generate samples with AI using multiple models to choose from (requires account registration)
- Adjust start/end positions and add fade-in and fade-out to your samples
- PRO: Slice samples with multi-slice sampling and autoslicing
- PRO: Edit samples in the Sample Editor with multiple tools (duplicate, trim, remove, silence, reverse, normalize, pitch, timestretch, volume)

EFFECTS

- Automate effects with swipe gestures or fine-tune them in the editor
- Select and adjust effects on pads using swipe gestures in EFFECTS mode

MIXER
- Adjust levels and effects in the mixer

- Select channel outputs in the Mixer with support for multichannel USB interfaces
- Send MIDI OUT separately for each channel
- Save your FX selection as default in the Mixer

SYNTHESIZER
- A simple, yet effective monophonic synthesizer: two oscillators and one LFO, controlling frequency and filter separately
- Sync the synthesizer oscillators from 32 bars down to 1/32 notes
- PRO: Adjust the synthesizer’s suboscillator, delay, glide parameter and bandpass filter

CONNECTIVITY
- Sync to other devices with Ableton Link
- Connect external MIDI keyboards via USB or Bluetooth
- AUv3 with resizable interface and multichannel support (via In-App Purchase)

REALTIME EXPORT
- Export your project (WAV, M4A)
- PRO: Export every individual track of your project (WAV)
- PRO: Export individual files as ZIP
- PRO: Export masterbus as M4A

AVAILABLE RESOURCES
- All devices: 16 takes and 16 groups
- Standalone on iPhone: 6 tracks
- Standalone on iPhone X and newer: 12 tracks
- Standalone on iPad: 16 tracks
- AUv3: 12 tracks

bluejetty:00062387:ios.name: Learn Spanish Frase Master
bluejetty:00062387:ios.summary: Learn Spanish and grammar free by ordering the words to form correct sentences and sayings. Frase Master is a fun and educational game for kids and Spanish language students of all ages who want to learn Spanish and improve their language s
bluejetty:00062387:ios.description:
Learn Spanish and grammar free by ordering the words to form correct sentences and sayings. Frase Master is a fun and educational game for kids and Spanish language students of all ages who want to learn Spanish and improve their language skills in a more entertaining way.
How do you play?
It’s easy. The game consists of putting the scrambled words from each level in order to form a correct sentence and learn Spanish in a fun way. (Beginner, skilled, professional, expert, sayings.)
If you make a mistake and click the Spanish word in the incorrect order, there is a time penalty.
Once you have completed the sentence you will receive a score based on how fast you were and your total number of errors.
You can share your knowledge with other players worldwide thanks to online multiplayer mode or with your friends on GameCenter.
Are you a Spanish student who wants to improve your skills? Frase Master will help you learn Spanish and organize the words in your sentences correctly.
Are you a Spanish expert who wants to show off your skills? Prove it in Competition mode on GameCenter.
Frase Master is the first game of its kind designed and developed completely by educators to help students eliminate the most common mistake among Spanish language learners, correct word order. With four levels from beginner to expert, Frase Master is a challenge for everyone from the Beginner to the most seasoned Spanish language communicators. 
These are the levels:
Beginner: Ideal for children. This level contains the easiest sentences with the fewest words to unscramble.
Skilled: This is where things start to get harder. This level is great for adults who are beginning their Spanish language learning adventure.
Professional: Great for users with a solid base in Spanish who want to keep their skills up to date.
Expert: Only for those with the most proficient Spanish skills. Are you one of them?
Do you have what it takes to become the next Frase Master? Try your luck in single player mode or against friends and other players worldwide. Learn Spanish with a smile on your face.

bluejetty:00100396:ios.description:
Welcome to Color Train: Pixel Puzzle, an addictive game that perfectly blends classic brain teaser fun with modern arcade action and pixel art style! If you're looking for a satisfying way to relax your mind and beat the stress, dive into this vibrant world of pixel art and container flow!
Can You Master the Flow?
The core gameplay centers around timing and flow. This brain teaser uses deceptively simple mechanics that require a sharp mind. Your goal is to clear the pixel cube board by making perfect color matches. How do you achieve this?
- Tap with precision to control the container’s release.
- Master the flow and timing to prevent backups.
- Achieve perfect color match combinations to clear the pixel cube board!
It's easy to learn, but requires true skill to master. It's a true IQ Test disguised as a charming, cute arcade experience!
Features That Deliver Fun and Stress Relief
- Vibrant Pixel Art: Enjoy bright, cute, retro visuals that make every action pop.
- Deep Flow Gameplay: An addictive, unique mechanic combining tap control and conveyor flow management.
- Offline Game Mode: Play anytime, anywhere! This offline game is perfect for quick sessions or deep dives.
- Stress Relief: The highly satisfying visual feedback provides instant stress relief.
- Free To Play: Jump into the fun and master the challenge without any upfront cost.
We took the addictive nature of classic games and gave it a modern twist. Flow Puzzle is more than just a color match—it's a brain teaser that rewards quick thinking and strategy.
Stop the stress and start the fun! If you love games that test your skill and provide satisfying action, this is your next addiction. Download Color Train: Pixel Puzzle today and start mastering the flow!

bluejetty:00084595:ios.name: Navitime Transit Route Planner
bluejetty:00084595:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00084595:ios.description:
【Navigate the World. Master Japan.】
Simply tap on a route map to get instant transit directions anywhere in the world. Whether you are on an international vacation or a business trip, NAVITIME Transit ensures your journey is safe, smooth, and stress-free.
■ Why Choose NAVITIME Transit?
・The Japan Specialist: As a Japan-based service, we provide the most accurate route planning for the Tokyo Subway, JR Lines, and Shinkansen (bullet train). We are the essential companion for JR Pass, Suica, and Smartex users.
・Global Network: Access high-quality route maps and train data for over 300 cities worldwide, including New York (Subway), London (Tube), and Paris (Metro).
・Flight Tracking & Booking: Track international flights by flight number and date. Plus, you can even book Japanese domestic flight tickets directly within the app!
・Seamless Navigation: Instantly find the nearest station from your current location for a smooth journey in any new city.
・Offline Mode: No signal? No worries. Search routes and view transit information offline by downloading our high-quality maps.
・Street View: Visually confirm station exits and surroundings to navigate with total confidence from the moment you step outside.
■ Areas Covered
NAVITIME Transit covers major hubs across the globe, including:
・Americas: USA (New York: Subway, LA, Chicago: L, San Francisco: BART, Washington DC, Boston), Canada (Vancouver), Mexico.
・Japan (The Japan Specialist): Tokyo (JR & Subway), Kyoto, Osaka, Shinkansen (Bullet Train), JR Pass & Suica support.
・Europe: UK (London: Tube / National Rail), France (Paris: Metro / RER), Germany (Berlin, Frankfurt, Munich), Italy (Rome, Milan), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), Switzerland, Netherlands.
・Asia: South Korea (Seoul: Subway), Hong Kong (MTR), Singapore (MRT), Thailand (Bangkok: BTS/MRT), Taiwan, China.
・Oceania: Australia (Sydney).
※ Plus over 300 cities worldwide!
The list above is just a highlight. We provide high-quality route maps and transit data for nearly every major travel destination, with new areas added every month.
■ Supported Transit
Subway / Metro / Train / Railway / Bus / Ferry / Airplane (International & Japan Domestic)
■Details
By agreeing to the terms of use, the fee will be charged to your iTunes account and you will be able to use all the features.
We use the automatic recurring billing function (Auto Renewable Subscription).
Charges for automatic renewal will be made from 24 hours before the end of the validity period until the end of the validity period.
■How to cancel automatic updates
To cancel/set automatic renewal, go to "Settings" > "Tap your name" > "Subscription".
You can stop automatic renewal by selecting ""Cancel subscription"" at least 24 hours before the end of the validity period.
■Terms of use
https://static.aws.navitime.com/term-of-service/index.html
■Privacy policy
https://static.aws.navitime.com/privacy-policy/index.html

bluejetty:00021781:ios.description:
Track Meet Mobile is the must-have app for Track & Field athletes, coaches, and fans.
For free, download the app, search for your meet, and review the meet program, which shows the meet location, a scheduled order of events, and the athletes and teams who are competing.
Subscribe to unofficial meet results, including times, marks, order of finish, wind readings, field series, and more — available only at meets where meet hosts and officials support the publication of results to mobile with HY-TEK Track & Field Meet Manager 5.0.
Can’t find your meet?
Ask the meet host to update to version 5.0 of HY-TEK’s Track & Field Meet Manager, the most widely used Track & Field software in the world, and publish the meet information to Track Meet Mobile. 
HY-TEK encourages meet hosts and officials to publish meet programs and meet results for the meets you want, and in a timely and accurate way. More meets are being added every week. However, HY-TEK does not control and cannot guarantee the availability or accuracy of meet programs or meet results. Meet results availability is dependent on meet hosts publishing that data. Please check with the meet host before subscribing to make sure results are being published for your meet.
Key Features
• View results, anytime, anywhere*
• Quickly find track and field meets with robust search functions
• Track athletes and teams, even if you’re not at the meet 
• Flag your “Favorite” athletes and teams to find them easily
• View heat/flight results along with wind readings and field series*
• View overall athlete and relay rankings for each round of each event*
• Check team scores*
• View who advanced by place and who advanced by time*
• View relay member names for each relay*
• View up to the minute standings for Combined Events such as the Decathlon*
• For Veterans meets, age graded results are shown along with the actual result*
• View Cross Country finish order and team score rankings*
• View Field Event Relay rankings*
• View the complete roster of teams and athletes*
• Select an athlete and view all completed and upcoming events for the athlete*
• View improvement from round to round*
• View records and time/mark standards
• Share your event via email, messaging, Facebook or Twitter
Meet Hosts
• Offer results for all of your meets
• Push out the event schedule, performance sheet information, and team rosters prior to the meet
• Get exposure within the app when people search for criteria that match your meet
• Make fans, athletes and coaches happy by offering meet access from anywhere in the world, virtually in real time
• Let fans send your meet viral as they share their favorite athletes’ results instantly via Facebook, Twitter, email or text
*Meet Results
Meet results are available as an in-app subscription. This dynamic content is available where meet hosts and officials support the publication of results to mobile using version 5.0 of HY-TEK’s Track & Field MEET MANAGER - - the most widely-used track & field meet management software in the world.
Monthly subscriptions are offered at Apple Tier 9 pricing ($4.49 USD). Annual subscriptions are offered at Apple Tier 20 pricing ($9.99 USD).
Subscriptions are charged to your iTunes account when you confirm your purchase and will auto-renew at the end of the subscription period for the same price tier and duration as your initial enrollment, unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of your current subscription period. Cancellation or refund of the active current subscription period is not allowed per Apple’s policies. In the app, tap More to either Restore or Manage Your Subscription.
ACTIVE Network works hard to ensure your privacy and data security. Our policy can be found at:
http://www.activenetwork.com/information/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00095958:ios.name: Mafia Mobile
bluejetty:00095958:ios.summary: The Clan that once called you "brother" has now blocked your number; those "comrades" who swore to live and die with you are now popping champagne in your rivals' luxury cars; and the Megalopolis you bled for has become someone else's "idea
bluejetty:00095958:ios.description:
The Clan that once called you "brother" has now blocked your number; those "comrades" who swore to live and die with you are now popping champagne in your rivals' luxury cars; and the Megalopolis you bled for has become someone else's "ideal home". 
But it doesn't matter—you're back now, and what's owed to you will be repaid, with interest!
1. Dominate the Lot
From now on, this street belongs to me, got it?! 
Your fists are your business card, and money is your language! Take over all kinds of properties, control every resource, and make the whole city know who the real boss is!
2. Underworld Talent Market 
Here, Capos aren't judged by their origins, and "talent" comes from anywhere!
That bar isn't just full of drunks—it's where you'll find your future "executive team"! You'll have Assailans to "persuade with reason", Bikers for "delivery services", and Gunmen for "long-distance communication". Recruit these "industry elites" to your cause, and your underworld empire will truly flourish!
3. Expand Your Criminal Empire
One city? That's just the starting price!
How can a true crime boss be content being a "local thug"? Take over territories, and witness the rise of your Aureate Empire! Let everyone know—your ambition, just like your bank account, can never be filled!
4. Family Business
Mess with my people? Go ahead, I dare you!
Establish your own Clan, recruit enforcers, and lay down the rules. Make your rivals understand: crossing you isn't just about losing money! Here, you're not just a boss—you're the "Godfather"!
5. The Good Life of a Boss
After a shootout, someone's gotta patch me up, right?
Turf wars are tiring, but dates don't stop! Beautiful women are lining up, because who can resist a "bad man" who's both dangerous and rich? Mansions, luxury yachts... now that's the retirement plan a crime legend deserves!
Now, it’s time to make this Megalopolis remember—who the real king is!
===Information===
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MafiaMobileEN/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mafiamobileen/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLks0p7wTDlg5Iv8VIeFRmA
Discord: https://discord.gg/CjzpkGQucc
Customer Service: help.mafiamobile.apple@igg.com
==Subscriptions==
Darknet Priviliges
● Monthly Subscription
● Price: US$4.99/month
Subscribe to enjoy the following perks:
- Get an exclusive avatar frame (Dark Zone).
- Get 50% more Prestige Coins in Don's Path.
- The number of Tasks available is increased by 1 for each Intel Hub refresh.
- You can skip challenges and get 3 star rewards instantly in the Mini Game.
- You can receive a large number of item rewards every day, as rewards are increased by 50%.
===Important Notes===
1. A payment will be charged to your iTunes account when you confirm the purchase.
2. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it's canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription.
3. Your account will receive a renewal confirmation within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription.
4. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00014638:ios.description:
Recordeon is an easy-to-use and handy app for recording your business and private calls or voice memos. 
Try its perfect features and user-friendly interface: get your recordings in a few taps, instantly recording & sharing. Simple tools with high performance ready to be used anywhere.
With Recordeon you can:
– Record incoming calls
– Record outgoing calls
– Record your voice memos
– Manage recordings with no limits (play, organize, share, delete)
– Use unlimited cloud storage for your recordings
– Share recordings via text messages, email, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp and Dropbox, among many others.
– Easily download recordings
– Get support 
How to record an active (existing) call:
1. Open Recordeon app and press the REC button in the middle of the screen
2. Your existing call will be put on hold and your phone will dial our recording service
3. Once connected to our recording number, press the Merge button on your screen to create a conference call between your existing call and our recording line
How to record an outgoing call:
1. Open Recordeon
2. Press the REC button in the middle of the screen
3. Press the Contacts button and choose your contact from the list
or
Press the Keyboard button and dial the phone number
4. In the pop-up menu, choose the Dial button to connect to our recording service
5. After the connection has been established, a new pop-up menu with your contact number will be displayed. Press the Dial button.
6. After the new connection with your contact number has been established, press the Merge button.
A dial tone signal indicates the beginning of recording
Note: Recordeon requires your carrier to support conference calls.
Get the Recordeon PRO - Unlimited call records!

bluejetty:00084922:ios.description:
Using our smartwatch and its accompanying UtraWatch app enables you to:
● You can use all features of the app without registering and logging in, and your stored data will be cleared when you decide to leave.
● The app automatically synchronizes the phone system time, language and local weather information to the watch
● The watch automatically syncs data to the app and displays graphs by day, week, and month, including:
 ○ Daily total steps, duration, distance and calories burned
 ○ Sports records
 ○ Last measured heart rate, body temperature, blood oxygen and blood pressure
 ○ Sleep data from the previous night
● Set up the watch's time system, watch face, alarm clocks, phone book, emergency contact, do not disturb, and turning on the watch screen when raising the wrist
● Set up notifications for SMS, incoming calls and app messages
● Set up drinking reminder, sedentary reminder, daily goals (sleep duration, exercise duration, exercise distance, steps, calories burned) and goal achievement reminder
● Set up timed measurement of heart rate and body temperature
● Measure heart rate, body temperature, blood oxygen and blood pressure with one click
● Play sports involving map and positioning tracks, including walking, running, cycling, and trekking (Continued location updates in the background may reduce phone battery life)
● Supports for synchronizing a user's exercise data to the Health app. With the user's permission, UtraWatch synchronizes the generated or acquired exercise data such as steps, distance and calories to the Health app
● Other features, such as updating watch firmware, finding the watch

bluejetty:00123431:ios.description:
Coffee is more than just a way to wake up in the morning, it's a way of life. With Filtru, you'll make the perfect cup each and every time and learn as you go.
Filtru is your go-to app for learning and replicating the best way to make your favorite coffee. Gone are the days of pouring water over coffee and throwing in some milk! Filtru will tell you how much coffee to use, when and how much water to pour, how to stir, and so much more. By the time you've tasted a Filtru coffee, you'll wonder how you ever lived without it! Those just starting out will enjoy our augmented reality (AR) gear guides that put new accessories right on your kitchen counter, giving you a chance to take a look before splashing out on a new coffee gadget!
Coffee fans new and old will love our growing collection of community brew guides, products from our partnered coffee roasters, and more. We live for coffee and we know you do too – let's live for it together via a curated feed of new coffee ideas while learning new brewing methods.
With Filtru, a specialized Espresso guide will offer tips on the grinding of beans and more to ensure the next cup is even better than the last. You'll learn by tasting, rating the flavor as you go, and Filtru will show you which variables to change for an even better taste.
Already living your best coffee life? Filtru integrates with a wide range of the world's best Bluetooth digital scales – perfect for weighing an exact amount of coffee for your morning cup. We'll even show you a timer alongside an illustration of the correct water flow speed to ensure you get the best possible flavor. No more guessing measurements and techniques and then hoping for the best!
Filtru ships with coffee recipes for the most popular brewing methods on the planet and distils everything into an easy-to-use app that won't get in the way of what's important – taste. Looking for some inspiration? Filtru helps you discover new brewing guides submitted by the community as well as the pros including Scott Rao and James Hoffmann, alongside other Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) certified baristas. Have a particularly killer coffee recipe of your own? Share it via Filtru so everyone can enjoy it!
▶ Filtru includes the following recipes:
- Espresso (Dial-in, Short recording and more)
- Chemex
- AeroPress
- Hario V60 (Pour over)
- Bonmac Dripper
- Beehouse Dripper
- Kalita Wave
- Clever Dripper
- Moka Pot (Espresso)
- French Press (Cafetiere)

Se você qu
bluejetty:00045763:ios.description:
Você ainda perde muito tempo gerenciando os pedidos de sua loja? Faz grande parte de suas vendas por Instagram, WhatsApp ou telefone? Precisa lidar de forma manual com recebimento de valores, agendamento de entregas e retiradas?
Se você quiser mudar isso, e tornar seu negócio mais eficiente e escalável, você está no lugar certo!
O WebCatálogo é uma ferramenta simples e eficaz para fazer a gestão dos seus pedidos!
Como funciona?
1) Você cadastra sua loja e produtos, de forma rápida e fácil.
2) Automaticamente você receberá um link de acesso ao seu catálogo, para divulgar a clientes por redes sociais, WhatsApp, etc.
3) Através deste link, seus clientes montarão seus carrinhos, e farão seus pedidos (sem precisar baixar aplicativo).
4) A cada novo pedido, você receberá:
- Uma notificação de novo pedido em seu aplicativo
- Detalhes de cada item solicitado
- Forma de pagamento escolhida pelo cliente (pagamento pelo app, ou diretamente a seu estabelecimento)
- Dados do cliente para entrega ou retirada na loja
- Impressão automática do pedido em sua impressora térmica (opcional)
E não é só isso...
Confira outros benefícios:
1) Escolha se você trabalha com entrega, frete e/ou retirada na loja.
2) Defina as formas de pagamento de sua preferência (dinheiro, cartão na sua maquininha, pix e e/ou cartão online.
3) Receba avaliação dos seus clientes para cada pedido.
4) Acesse diversos relatórios sobre sua performance de vendas:
- Veja a evolução de vendas de cada produto
- Acesso ao histórico de pedidos de cada cliente
- Receba sugestão de pedidos baseado no comportamento de seus clientes (ex. Maria faz o mesmo pedido toda a Quinta-feira)
5) Crie cupons de descontos para seus clientes, atendendo diversas regras a sua escolha.
E muito mais...
WebCatálogo. Escale o seu negócio.

bluejetty:00073884:ios.summary:

Little Bean helps you quickly check whether your beauty, skincare, and personal care products are safe to use during
bluejetty:00073884:ios.description:
Join thousands of mothers and soon-to-be moms who use Little Bean to feel confident about the products they use every day.
Little Bean helps you quickly check whether your beauty, skincare, and personal care products are safe to use during pregnancy, breastfeeding, and other sensitive hormonal stages.
There’s no barcode required. Simply scan the ingredient list on any product using your phone’s camera and get clear, easy-to-understand safety guidance instantly.
Designed specifically for pregnancy and hormonal health, Little Bean focuses on ingredients that matter most during conception, pregnancy, and postpartum, so you can make confident choices without stress or guesswork.
DESIGNED FOR EVERY STAGE
Little Bean supports people navigating:
- IVF and fertility treatments
- Menstrual cycle and ovulation
- Pregnancy and postpartum recovery
- Breastfeeding and pumping
Whether you’re checking a daily moisturizer or a new makeup product, Little Bean helps you understand what’s safe for you and your baby.
CAMERA-FIRST INGREDIENT SCANNING
- Scan ingredient lists directly from product packaging—no barcode
needed.
- Get instant feedback on potential pregnancy-related risks.
- Upload ingredient lists when shopping online.
- Look up individual ingredients anytime for a deeper understanding.
PREGNANCY-FOCUSED SAFETY GUIDANCE
- Ingredients are assessed using pregnancy- and nursing-specific criteria.
- Clear risk levels help translate complex ingredient names into simple
guidance.
- Built to inform—not alarm—so you can make calm, confident decisions.
SAFE ALTERNATIVES, INSTANTLY
- If an ingredient raises concerns, Little Bean suggests pregnancy-friendly
alternatives.
- Compare options in seconds and find products that better align with your
needs.
BACKED BY RESEARCH, BUILT WITH CARE
- Our curated database prioritizes ingredients most relevant to pregnancy and hormonal health.
- Developed with guidance from medical and scientific research.
- Focused on transparency, clarity, and trust.
USE WHAT YOU ALREADY OWN
Little Bean works with the products you already use and love, from skincare and makeup to personal care, without requiring special integrations or brand partnerships.
IMPORTANT NOTE
Little Bean is an educational tool and does not replace advice from healthcare professionals. Always consult your provider for personalized medical guidance.
Download Little Bean and feel confident about the products you use, every step of the way.
Questions or feedback? Contact us at info@littlebeanapp.com.

Main Features:

Join or form a team, chat and trade hearts or coins with other food game lovers, and enjoy the pleasure of socializing
Collect and sort various items, unlock recipes and decorate cakes to complete the adventure experience

bluejetty:00119684:ios.name: TouchTax
bluejetty:00119684:ios.summary: TouchTax provides easy and affordable offline access on your Apple iPad and iPhone to all sections of the latest edition of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (the Code), the Treasury Regulations from the Electronic Code of Federal Regulatio
bluejetty:00119684:ios.description:
TouchTax provides easy and affordable offline access on your Apple iPad and iPhone to all sections of the latest edition of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (the Code), the Treasury Regulations from the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (the Regulations) and Circular 230 and to the Internal Revenue Bulletins, Proposed Regulations, Temporary Regulations, Revenue Procedures, Revenue Rulings, Notices, Actions on Decisions and Announcements since 2003. One application purchase includes both the iPad tablet version and the iPhone customized phone version. The iPad tablet version includes an easy-to-use split view setup. 
TouchTax supplements your physical copies of the Code, Regulations, IRBs, Rev. Rul., Rev. Proc., T.D., Temporary Regulations, Circular 230, etc. with electronic versions that are up-to-date while giving you advanced features making it easy to read and manage the law.
TouchTax includes a useful keyword search feature enabling keyword and phrase searching of the entire Code, Regulations, IRBs, Rev. Procs., Rev. Ruls., Notices, Announcements and more. Use exact keyword searches or use natural language searches to smartly search and find relevant content. Cross linking within Code sections provides for easy referencing. TouchTax also contains the complete current official version of Circular 230.
The Code and Regulations incorporated in TouchTax are electronic adaptations of the official law published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel of the United States House of Representatives, the Treasury Department and the U.S. Government Printing Office. TouchTax contains the latest publications of the Preliminary USC Internal Revenue Code (current through May 19, 2025 - Pub. L. 119-12) and Regulations (current as of June 8, 2025) from the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations. The Internal Revenue Bulletins (with Rev. Procs., Rev. Ruls., Notices, Announcements, Temporary and Proposed Regulations) are updated weekly from the official Internal Revenue Service sources. (Newest Regulations are also included in the Internal Revenue Bulletins until integrated by the Government Printing Office in the official, annual versions of the Code of Federal Regulations.) 
TouchTax is expected to be updated as soon as new versions of the Code and Regulations are made available. Internal Revenue Bulletins are updated approximately monthly and appear automatically on your device (as soon as it's connected to the Internet). 
TouchTax includes: 
* Offline access to all sections of the Code and Regulations 
* Offline access to the complete Circular 230
* Cross links between Code and Regulations 
* Cross links within the Code
* Keyword search of Code, Regulations, Internal Revenue Bulletins, Rev. Procs., Rev. Ruls., Notices, Announcements 
* Bookbrowse feature 
* Table of contents and easy chapter, subchapter, etc. browsing 
* Increase and reduce font size 
* Email sections 
* Take notes 
* Open Code, Regulations, Internal Revenue Bulletins, Circular 230, Rev. Procs., Rev. Ruls., Notices, Announcements, Actions on Decisions as PDF version 
* Bookmark Code and Regulation sections 
* Fullscreen view
* Split view and slide over view (use TouchTax side by side with other compatible apps) 
If you enjoy using TouchTax, please consider leaving positive feedback in the application market. Read "Getting Started" on the support site for more information on how to get started with your Code and Regulation reading using TouchTax.

bluejetty:00066450:ios.name: Twerk Race 3D — Fun Run Game
bluejetty:00066450:ios.summary: Twerking is a lot of fun. And a running game with twerking is even more fun! Meet Twerk Race 3D—an exciting runner featuring a fun race where your goal is to build your muscles to become a twerking legend! Run, overcome various obstacles, a
bluejetty:00066450:ios.description:
Twerking is a lot of fun. And a running game with twerking is even more fun! Meet Twerk Race 3D—an exciting runner featuring a fun race where your goal is to build your muscles to become a twerking legend! Run, overcome various obstacles, and fight for the title of the best twerk dancer in history in this super exciting runner. 
FUN BODY RACE 
On your marks. Ready. Get set. Go! The fun race has begun! Run through the challenging obstacle course and transform your body. In this running game, you can get fit in the blink of an eye. Pick up the right objects on your way to get stronger and finish the run with the biggest body imaginable!
CRAZY OBSTACLES
Watch out, though: it takes a little strategy to get to the end. The race is packed with crazy obstacles: fragile glass platforms, barriers with different size holes, slides, and more. Sometimes your big body can be your weakness. Learn when to burn calories and make an effort to get fit. Prove you have the brains to match your big muscles!
EPIC TWERKING BATTLE
A fun race isn't all this running game is about—there’s a twerking battle waiting for you when you get to the finish line. Each level ends with a grand finale—an exciting battle that will put your twerking skills to the test. Save all your strength for the mighty bump and bounce the opponent off the dance ring. Only the strongest body has a chance of winning the final shake-off! 
Ready for the challenge? You have nothing to lose … except maybe a couple of pounds. Join the fun run, overcome all obstacles, and get prepared to win the final battle. 
BEST FEATURES
● A one-of-a-kind running game. It’s a runner with a twerk battle at the end. There’s nothing like it!
● An exciting final battle. Make your body stronger and crush your opponent with your thick muscles!
● Real dynamic tension. A fast and fun race with an endless variety of obstacles to blast your way through. Watch your body change as you tackle every hurdle!
● A new fun run—a fresh and cute look. There are plenty of opportunities to beautify your character. Choose the best outfit to accentuate your muscles!
A body race has never been this much fun! Join Twerk Race 3D to revel in an endlessly entertaining 3D runner that’s guaranteed to dispel your boredom and get you dancing all day!

bluejetty:00157537:ios.name: BlueStar Diabetes
bluejetty:00157537:ios.summary: We know that living with diabetes can be tough. That’s why we’re making diabetes self-care easier. BlueStar® provides daily digital coaching unique to you; to help you learn about your condition, build better habits, and live your best life
bluejetty:00157537:ios.description:
We know that living with diabetes can be tough. That’s why we’re making diabetes self-care easier. BlueStar® provides daily digital coaching unique to you; to help you learn about your condition, build better habits, and live your best life.
Our diabetes app is award-winning**, FDA-cleared* and fits easily into your everyday life — while giving you useful tips and advice along the way. It’s easy-to-use, hassle-free, and secure.
Note: BlueStar is only available via your health plan, health system or employer.
BlueStar can help make living with diabetes easier with:
DIGITAL COACHING: 
Get the right guidance at the right time — all in one easy-to-use app.
TOTAL HEALTH APPROACH TO DIABETES: 
Help build and maintain better habits by connecting your medications, nutrition, activity, devices and health data, including data from Apple Health®. 
THE SUPPORT YOU NEED TO MANAGE YOUR BLOOD GLUCOSE: 
Learn what you need - at your own pace - with easy-to-use tools and easy-to-follow guidance within the app.
SHARE YOUR PROGRESS: 
Celebrate your successes and share your challenges with your doctor and care team — easily and quickly.
*BlueStar® Rx/OTC is an FDA-cleared medical device, intended for use by healthcare providers and their adult patients with type 1 or type 2 diabetes. For full labeling information, visit www.welldoc.com. 
**Named Best Diabetes Apps for Sugar-Conscious Peeps 2021, by Tech Times 
BlueStar® is a Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) intended to be used by healthcare providers (HCPs) and their patients – aged 18 years and older - who have type 1 or type 2 diabetes. BlueStar is intended to assist patients in managing their diabetes with guidance from their providers. BlueStar has two versions – BlueStar and BlueStar Rx. BlueStar is not intended to replace the care provided by a licensed healthcare professional. BlueStar should not be used by patients with gestational diabetes or patients using an insulin pump. Visit www.welldoc.com for full labeling information.
The privacy and security of your personal information is very important to us. We protect it in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act.
ABOUT WELLDOC
Welldoc is committed to improving the health of individuals living with a chronic disease.

bluejetty:00069714:ios.description:
Do you like watching short videos, scrolling through thematic collections and finding clips to fit the mood or discovering new talents in the recommendations? Then VK Clips was created for you.
VK Clips is an app where you can watch and create short videos on different topics, from entertainment to education. Clips is also a place that brings talents together. Here, everyone can find cool content creators and interesting content to relax, have fun or learn something new.
VK Clips was designed so that every viewer finds something for themselves:
1. Smart recommendation algorithms instantly adjust to the user's interests, reacting to views, likes, clicks on ""Not interesting"" and other interactions.
2. Users can binge-watch clips on a specific topic in the thematic collections.
3. To change which topics appear in the feed, users can customize their interests and select different ones when looking for something new.
4. Clips can even be viewed anonymously without signing in to the app.
To make all of this possible, algorithms constantly analyze clips on the platform, separate them by genre and category, filter out copies and recommend only original content. The app itself is stable and fast thanks to having no excess features, only the recommendations feed and tools for creating content.
Download the app, watch clips that interest you, get inspired and have fun!

Kegel is an easy system of exercises aimed at training the perineum muscles. It's like fitness, but focused on male performance:
– Improves male function performance;
– Improves ejaculation control;
– Restores the initial "youthful" angle;
– Prevents from male diseases;
– Increases self-confidence.

– Based on scientifically proven method;
– Ready-to-use 365-day daily training program;
– Variety of exercises are opened during progress.
WORKOUT FEATURES:
– Beginner friendly workouts that are easy to perform
– Simple and understandable exercises with visual, text and vibro instructions
– Unnoticeable to the others – do the exercises anywhere while standing, sitting or lying. It’s invisible to the people around you.
PROGRESS TRACKER FEATURE:
– Weekly statistics overview
– PF muscle strength meter
Disclaimer:
Kegel for men is not a medical app, this is a set of pelvic floor exercises. Please consult with a qualified physician if you want to use it for medical purposes.

bluejetty:00178903:ios.name: Barometer Plus - Altimeter
bluejetty:00178903:ios.summary:
Barometer Plus app measures air pressure and altitude using your device's built-in barometric pressure sensor.
Because air pressure changes usually indicate a weather change, you can use this app to monitor and predict short-term weather va
bluejetty:00178903:ios.description:
Barometer Plus app measures air pressure and altitude using your device's built-in barometric pressure sensor.
Because air pressure changes usually indicate a weather change, you can use this app to monitor and predict short-term weather variations.
People suffering from migraine, headaches, or joint pain can monitor how barometric pressure impacts their mood.
Fishermen can monitor the atmospheric pressure for right-time fishing.
FEATURES:
• The app contains a barometer and altimeter with a personalization graphic in classic analog style. It also displays the current temperature and humidity.
• Display barometric pressure (sensor value) or mean sea level pressure (MSLP - value used in weather forecast services or stations).
• Units support for pressure: mb, inHg, kPa, atm, Torr, psi, hPa, mmHg. Units for altitude: meter, feet.
• Calibrate the barometer using altitude/location from the GPS. Calibrate the altimeter using the nearest airport information/METAR, or manually enter the QNH of the nearest airport. Offset sensor output value.
• Measure the height (building/mountain/hiked/climbed) using the "Relative Altitude" feature (can be enabled in the app's Settings).
• Notification about pressure change. "Notification custom rule" for you to define how and when the app sends notifications.
Notify when air pressure changes indicate that extreme or worse weather may occur.
• "Pressure Tracking" and "History Graph" require "Background App Refresh" or "Always Location Service" with "Exact update interval" (paid feature) enabled.
• "My Area" allows you to define your frequent stay places, and the app tracks air pressure with location data.
• Export history to CSV format and Today widget (paid features).
• This app is the digital version compared with an aneroid or mercury barometer and can be adjusted to MSLP with additional features.
CUSTOMIZABLE:
You can change your barometer/altimeter appearance with:
• Seven different housing colors.
• Black, white or blue disk background.
• Four different app backgrounds.
• Three different types of needles.
• Marker needle for easily monitor.
• Dark or light Today widget theme.
NOTES:
• App only works on devices with a barometer sensor, such as iPhone 6/6s/7/8/X/11/12/13 (including Plus models), iPad Mini 4/Air 2/Pro, or later.
• Weather icons on the dial: This only shows the air pressure trend like in an analog barometer.
• Each time your device reboots, open the app for tracking with the "Exact update interval" feature work.
• You may take the phone/tablet far away from computers, cables, and other magnetic sources to get accurate results.
If you like this app, please support us - you can remove ads or unlock paid features from the menu: Shop.
We welcome your ideas and suggestions - please email us at: support+barometer@pvdapps.com.
Follow our official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/barometerplus/ or Twitter account: https://twitter.com/pvdapps.

bluejetty:00132109:ios.description:
NFC - Reader & Writer provides a simple and easy-to-use solution to Read, Write, and Lock an NFC Tag.
Read:
- Tap the Read button to read a compatible NFC Tag.
- Opens URL's if allows in settings
- Manufacturer & model (NTAG213, NTAG215, Ultralight, Mifare, etc.)
- Serial number & tech details
- Memory size, tag type & available technologies
- iCloud-Synced Tag Read History
Write:
- Type in text then press the write button to write to an NFC Tag.
- Write in text or URL (using https:// format).
- Save any template or stack you create
Create useful NFC tags in seconds with prebuilt templates:
- Wi-Fi Login
- Contact Card
- Bluetooth
- Location / Maps
- Website Link
- Email
- SMS
- Custom Text or NDEF Records
Lock:
- Press the lock button to make an NFC Tag "read only" meaning you will no longer be able to write to that same NFC Tag (This is permanent)
Tools:
- Set or remove NFC passwords
- Erase tags

bluejetty:00171681:ios.description:
Whether you’re looking for a last minute beach vacay, discounts on train tickets, rental cars, or cheap flights with a budget airline, TravelPirates has you covered! 
 ***Winner of World Travel Awards 2018***
How does the TravelPirates App work?
STEP 1 – We find the best trips by identifying combinations of flights, hotels or vacation packages with the best price value
STEP 2 – We post these travel deals on our TravelPirates App, including customization options such as departure airports, destinations, and travel dates
STEP 3 – You book – the faster the better as the best deals expire quickly!
What can you do on the TravelPirates App?
HOTTEST TRAVEL DEALS
Check out our latest deals to find the trip that best suits you! We always provide you with extensive information on destinations, prices, and accommodations. As we’ve done all the hard work for you, you won’t have to research further. Simply click and book your dream vacation. The abundance of customization options regarding travel dates, departure airports, and destinations allows you to select the ones that suit your travel needs best.
TRAVEL DEAL CATEGORIES – FLIGHTS, HOTELS, AND PACKAGES
Browse our travel categories to find the type of trip that you’re looking for. We have flight deals, hotel deals, vacation packages, and more! You can either have a look at our best deals across all categories or select the category that you’re interested in.
USE OUR SEARCH ENGINE TO FIND YOUR PERFECT TRIP
Haven’t found any travel deals for the destination you had in mind? Struggling to find a flight from your nearest departure airport? No worries! You can search for customized deals in the Booking section of the TravelPirates App. Search in our categories of Vacations, Flight + Hotel combinations, Flights only, Hotels only, and Rental Cars to find a trip that suits your needs.
TRAVEL ALERTS – DON’T MISS OUT ON YOUR DREAM VACATION
With our amazing travel alerts you'll never miss out on a deal again! This feature allows you to set up alerts based on your travel preferences. Simply choose your preferred destinations, departure airports, and budget. As soon as we find a deal that matches your requirements, we'll send you a notification.
USE THE FILTERS TO SEE TAILORED VACATION DEALS
If you have a clear idea of the trip you want, our filters will help you find the perfect vacation. For example, if you want to look at beach vacays in the Bahamas during July or low budget flights to New York City, then simply click on the filters and enter your requirements. You can filter by deal category, departure airport, destination and travel period.
THE TRAVELPIRATES APP CATERS TO ALL YOUR NEEDS
TravelPirates provides you with the best deals for cheap flights from well-known airlines including Delta, United, and Southwest.
We’ll keep you updated on the latest travel deals, packages & last minute offers from renowned vendors, such as Expedia, Kayak or Skyscanner.

bluejetty:00000571:ios.summary:
Join over 170,000 avid players on the most loved bridge app in the world! Play online bridge, learn the game and progress at your own pace. With Funbridge, enjoy playing duplicate or multiplayer bridge anywhere, anytime!
Bridge is an excit
bluejetty:00000571:ios.description:
Join over 170,000 avid players on the most loved bridge app in the world! Play online bridge, learn the game and progress at your own pace. With Funbridge, enjoy playing duplicate or multiplayer bridge anywhere, anytime!
Bridge is an exciting card game played by four players in two teams of two called “partnerships”. The bridge partners sit opposite each other at a table. The game of bridge consists of a number of “deals” (also “boards” or “hands”) and involves two stages: there is an “auction” (also called “bidding”) to determine the contract to be made, and then the “card play” where you must reach the goal set.
On Funbridge, you play in South, whereas North, East and West are played by a specialized artificial intelligence, the same for all players. So, you don’t need to wait for other players to play bridge. The AI is available 24/7 to allow you to play bridge whenever you want.
You can also play multiplayer bridge with your bridge friends or players from all over the world.
Funbridge offers a unique game experience by enabling all players to play the same bridge deals. The objective is simple: score the highest and compare yourself to other bridge players in dedicated rankings.

bluejetty:00135997:ios.description:
In a world filled with idle games, "Idle Zombie Mining Tycoon" is a fresh addition to tycoon games and simulator games. This isn't just about being an idle miner; it's an epic journey across realms of adventure games, where every tap brings fortune.
Features:
- Discover uncharted territories, expanding your domain in this unique blend of mine games and adventure games. Whether it's trying to find diamonds or unearthing glistening gold, the thrill never ends.
- Not just another tap game. As the ultimate hero, dictate the pace of your zombie miners. Combine clicker strategies and managerial prowess, dig deep in exciting digging games.
- Idle hero are waiting for the challenges. Whether it's idle construction 3d tasks or battling competitors in miner games, the adventure never stops.
- Every tycoon needs their castle. Design an opulent mansion to reflect the success of your mining empire. Dive into economy games mechanisms and enjoy the experience of building and showcasing your achievements.
- Offline idle games mechanics ensure you're always in the money. Your empire earns even when you're away, truly the epitome of idle money.
- Dive into the realm of idle zombie games. Lead your zombie crew, optimize digs, and watch as your coffers overflow in this immersive tycoon simulator.
Gold mines, bustling zombies, and endless riches beckon. From clicking games to intense simulation games, "Idle Zombie Mining Tycoon" offers a smorgasbord of features. With the spirit of an adventure capitalist, the strategy of a seasoned manager, and the thrill of finding treasure, this game has it all.
Whether you're a fan of idle building games, on the hunt to find diamonds, or seeking to build a mining empire. Join the ranks of elite miners, tap into your potential, and ascend the tycoon throne!
Got any issues or suggestions?

Stop Self-Criticism, a gentle session on no
bluejetty:00021287:ios.description:
End Self-Sabotage Hypnosis offers 98 guided hypnosis programs by Joel Thielke, C.Ht., for procrastination, self-doubt, confidence and the habits that hold you back.
START WITH STOP SELF-CRITICISM
Stop Self-Criticism, a gentle session on noticing the critical voice in your head and answering it with forgiveness, is included with the app: play it in full, with no purchase and no subscription. It is built into the app, so it plays without a connection. Then continue with End Sabotage, Joel's core program on noticing where you get in your own way, which also plays offline.
BREAK FREE FIRST
The library opens on Break Free: fifteen programs including End Sabotage, Get Out Of Your Way, Stop Procrastinating, Stop Being A Victim, Let Go Of The Past and The Power of Saying No. Six more shelves cover confidence and esteem, motivation and focus, calm and relief, relationships, health and habits, and inner growth. Search by everyday words, such as "putting things off" or "self-doubt".
SHAPE EACH SESSION
Choose a program, then one of six inductions, classic and new: the original Short, Long and Sleep, plus Beach (a calm walk along the shore), Speed (a fast way in) and Staircase (counting down step by step). Then pick an ending: Wake, Sleep, None or Delay. Line programs up in a playlist, repeat them for as long as you like, and set a sleep timer. Playback continues with the screen locked, with lock-screen controls. On iPhone Duo the app fits both the outer and the inner display, and Nightstand mode turns the player into a calm bedside view when you stand the phone half-open. Other programs stream the first time and are kept on your device after that.
A SOUND BENEATH THE VOICE
One background sound is included with every session. The separately purchased Sound Mixer layers up to four of 15 sounds, such as rain, ocean, campfire and wind, with your own levels and saved mixes.
ONE-TIME PURCHASES
Buy single programs, including End Sabotage, or unlock every program with one payment. Unlock All covers the program library and is available through Family Sharing; the Sound Mixer is sold separately. Every purchase is one-time and restorable. There is no subscription. If you had the app before version 4.1, End Sabotage stays yours. Programs you bought before are still yours: tap Restore Purchases in Settings.
ABOUT JOEL THIELKE
Joel Thielke is a Certified Clinical Hypnotherapist who has created guided hypnosis programs for more than two decades. Questions? Write to support@motivationalhypnotherapy.com from Settings.

bluejetty:00041636:ios.description:
Are you ready for a hidden object adventure unlike any other? Immerse yourself in a thrilling adventure full of mystery and intrigue! In this exciting free detective hidden object game search for hidden objects, solve puzzles, and complete quests to unravel the city's secrets! 
Ravenhill is no ordinary city—its streets are cloaked in shadow, and its past is buried under layers of mystery. People have vanished without a trace, whispers of secrets linger in the air, and danger seems to watch from every corner. As a detective, it's up to you to uncover cryptic clues, solve intricate puzzles, and piece together the truth hidden deep within the city's history. Along the way, you'll meet captivating characters, each holding a thread to the unraveling story. Will you uncover the secrets of Ravenhill and bring light to its darkness? The adventure of a lifetime awaits!
Your journey to the heart of mystery starts here—are you ready to seek, discover, and solve?
— Search for hidden objects, Detective! Uncover clues and solve quests to lift the shadowy secrets of Ravenhill's past.
— Test your wits with puzzles! From tricky riddles to logic challenges, train your brain while uncovering the city's mysteries.
— Don't miss a clue! Collect evidence and connect the dots to reveal the truth.
— Meet fascinating characters! Encounter Ravenhill's enigmatic residents, each with a story to tell and secrets to share.
— Explore stunning locations! Wander through eerie alleys, historic landmarks, and hidden chambers, all beautifully illustrated and filled with mysteries.
— Unravel a gripping storyline! Dive into a twisting tale of suspense, family secrets, and dark discoveries waiting to be uncovered.
— Navigate through an episodic plot structure. Discover yourself as the main character in intriguing scenes and unpredictable events.
— Build collections and earn rewards! Assemble unique artifacts and uncover their significance in Ravenhill's shadowy history.
Stay informed, be the first to know, and connect with players worldwide on our social media:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/RavenhillGameMYTONA
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ravenhill_official/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Ravenhill_official
Are you ready for a big adventure? Then let's go!

bluejetty:00060713:ios.summary:
READ ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
On the bus, on your break, in your bed—never be without a book. Kindle books you have purchased on Amazon will automatically appear in your app. Kindle Unlimited and Amazon Prime members can select and download Kindle
bluejetty:00060713:ios.description:
READ ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
On the bus, on your break, in your bed—never be without a book. Kindle books you have purchased on Amazon will automatically appear in your app. Kindle Unlimited and Amazon Prime members can select and download Kindle books directly in the app.
FIND YOUR NEXT GREAT READ
• Read the books you buy on Amazon in the Kindle app. Choose from over six million Kindle books (including those with Audible narration), magazines, and comics and start reading in seconds. Explore Amazon Charts best sellers and titles across genres like romance, science fiction, children’s books, self-help, religion, nonfiction, and more—and try any book with a free sample straight from the Kindle app.
• Kindle Unlimited members can enjoy unlimited reading and listening, with the freedom to explore over 1 million titles, thousands of audiobooks, and current magazines. 
• Over 1,000 books, magazines, comics, and more included with Amazon Prime.
GO BEYOND PAPER
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a book with the free Kindle app—so you can read anytime, anywhere. Explore these reading features in the Kindle app:
• Read your way. Customize your text size, font type, margins, text alignment, and orientation (portrait or landscape)—and choose whether to turn pages from left to right or continuously scroll. Read comfortably day and night with adjustable brightness and background colors. Go to the Aa menu in your book to get started.
• Look up words, people, and places while you read. Breeze through words you don’t know and characters you can’t remember with the built-in dictionary, X-Ray, Wikipedia lookup, instant translations, and search within your book. Simply tap and hold a word to view its definition, or use the Google and Wikipedia links to get more information.
• Track your reading progress. See what percent of the book you’ve read, real page numbers (for most top titles), and how much time you have left in the chapter or book based on your actual reading speed. 
• Bookmark places you want to revisit, and make highlights and take notes throughout your book. Open My Notebook to see all your notes in the same place.
• Hop, skim, and jump with Page Flip. Flip between pages or get a bird’s-eye view of your book with Page Flip—don’t worry, we’ll save your place.
• Zoom in on high-definition color images in Kindle books, magazines, comics, and manga.
• Sync your books across devices. When you’re reading a book, the Kindle app will automatically sync where you left off—along with any bookmarks, highlights, or notes—so you can start reading on one device and pick up where you left off on another.
• When you can’t read, listen. Switch seamlessly from reading your Kindle book to listening to the Audible book, all within the Kindle app.
• Get notified when authors you love have new releases.
By using this app, you agree to Amazon’s Conditions of Use (www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (www.amazon.com/privacy).

In Gogo Mini World’s Beauty Salon, girls can be makeup artists, hair salon stylists, s
bluejetty:00133576:ios.description:
Welcome to Gogo Mini World’s Beauty Salon, a super fun game for kids that is loved by girls! Jump in to start exploring the world of beauty and fashion.
In Gogo Mini World’s Beauty Salon, girls can be makeup artists, hair salon stylists, spa assistants, and fashion creators all in one! The app is carefully designed to give your little one age-appropriate screen time while letting their creativity flourish. Whether they love doing makeup, styling in the hair salon, working at the spa, or playing dress up, there’s something for every style. Get started in the Beauty Salon and let your inner fashionista show! 
MAKEUP MAGIC IN THE BEAUTY SALON
In Beauty Salon's makeup area, girls can create endless styles. Choose from a wide range of makeup items, including eyeshadows and lipsticks, to let the characters sparkle! Try different makeup styles, learn about applying makeup, and have fun being creative!
HAIR SALON CREATIVITY
The hair salon is full of choices! Experiment with long hair, bobs, braids, and many more unique styles. Girls can select their favorite hair colors and add cute accessories to complete the look. Learn about hair care and styling while creating iconic new fashion-forward hairstyles.
RELAXING AT THE SPA
The Beauty Salon is also home to the blissful spa zone where you can pamper and care for your characters. Apply face masks and get massages in the peaceful calm of the spa. Learn about self-care and choosing treatments while making characters feel like a million dollars!
DRESS UP FOR STYLE
Now it’s time to play dress up in Beauty Salon’s fashion wonderland. There are stylish dresses, tops, skirts, and more. Mix and match clothing items then add shoes and jewelry for the perfect outfit! Learn about fashion trends and create unique looks while showcasing your creative genius!
 KEY FEATURES OF BEAUTY SALON:
- No winning or losing, just lots of fun activities 
- Bright, colorful, and easy for kids to use
- Simple controls that kids can manage on their own 
- Play offline, no internet needed — perfect for any time!
ABOUT US
We make fun games like Beauty Salon that kids and parents enjoy! Our games help kids learn, grow, and have fun. Visit our Developer Page to find more games like Beauty Salon!
Contact us: hello@bekids.com
SUBSCRIPTION:
1. Once subscribed you can access all content and features of Gogo Mini World.
2. We offer 2 subscription methods.
3. Subscription automatically renews unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
4. Manage your subscriptions and turn off automatic renewal in your Apple account settings.
5. Privacy Policy: https://www.bekids.com/privacy/en/privacy.html
6. Terms of Service: https://www.bekids.com/terms/en/terms.html

Thank you for
bluejetty:00177964:ios.description:
Find Your Lost Fitbit Fast. Need Help Finding Your Fitbit? Find Your Fitbit In Minutes. Try The App Now!
Over 500,000 lost Fitbits have been found in minutes with Find My Fitbit. 
Thousands of five star ratings world wide!
Thank you for making Find My Fitbit the 25th most popular Health & Fitness App on the App Store!
Find My Fitbit works with your Fitbit Ace, Ace 2/3, Alta, Alta HR, Blaze, Charge, Charge HR/2/3/4/5/6, Flex, Flex 2, Ionic, Inspire 1/2/3/HR, Luxe, One, Ultra, Sense, Sense 2, Surge, Versa, Versa Lite, and Versa 2/3/4. Google Pixel Watches are supported
The app can also find other Bluetooth devices like AirPods, Apple Pencil, Apple Watch, and other fitness trackers!
FIND MY FITBIT REALLY WORKS
5/5 "Worked amazing. My 6y/o lost my fitbit one. I downloaded this and she used the app to find it, in literally 5 minutes. Great app!!" - Crystal
5/5 "I totally doubted this app would work. Proved me wrong!! Love this app!!" - Riakaz
5/5 "Found After 5 min just like some of the past reviews. Should be mandatory when setting up the Fitbit." -Wtot
We are so confident that you'll find your Fitbit we offer a full refund for the cost of the app if your Fitbit isn't found. You have nothing to lose except your Fitbit
BENEFITS OF FIND MY FITBIT
• Find your Fitbit in minutes. Not days or hours. Even finds Fitbits with a low battery
• Save hundreds of dollars to replace your lost Fitbit
• Use the app anytime you or a family member loses a Fitbit
• Make finding your Fitbit fun. Not stressful. Use the Cold, Warm, Hot game to find your Fitbit
• Extremely easy to use. Anyone, any age, can navigate the app
• Responsive App support. Contact us if you need help
Downloading Find My Fitbit before losing your Fitbit is not required, but will help you find it faster. Every minute counts before the battery runs out!
Taking your time and walking slowly is key to finding your lost Fitbit fast
Bluetooth signals can travel through walls, floors, and ceilings. Your Fitbit could be in a room directly above, below or next to you
HOW IT WORKS
Find My Fitbit gamifies finding your lost Fitbit by playing the Cold, Warmer, Hot game
• See your Fitbit in the App
• Walk around slowly. As you move closer to your lost Fitbit the indicator will change from Cold to Warmer
• When you are about 3-5 feet away from your Fitbit the indicator will display Hot. Simple as that. You found your Fitbit!
Cannot find a Fitbit that
- Has a dead battery 
- Is more than 75-100 feet from a iPhone/iPad 
For email support go to findmyfitnessband.com/support - Please email us before posting a negative review or asking a question in a review. We cannot respond to questions posted in a review
FEATURES
• Finds any Fitbit that is actively broadcasting a Bluetooth Low Energy signal
• Smart Finder technology that has been technically optimized for Fitbit devices to find your Fitbit faster
• Displays the last time your Fitbit was seen
• Works with all iPhone 4s and above
• Works with all iPad 3 and above
Subscriptions
- Subscribers pay the fixed price for your country, which is displayed in the app
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the current period
Privacy Policy: findmyfitnessband.com/privacy
Terms of Use: findmyfitnessband.com/terms
Fitbit is a registered trademark and service mark of Fitbit, Inc. Find My Fitbit - Finder App For Your Lost Fitbit is designed for use with the Fitbit platform. This product is not put out by Fitbit, and Fitbit does not service or warrant the functionality of this product

bluejetty:00120612:ios.description:
How to Get Strong Legs in Only 30 Days? 
How to Tone Your Legs at Home?
For 30 days, the most experienced trainers will help you get strong legs, improve leg muscles, and lose leg fat with this app. It is very useful for those with chicken legs, fat legs, or weak legs. You will become more confident with your perfect legs and fit body without the need for a gym or equipment. All you need to do is complete the leg workout exercises from Day 1 to Day 30.
This app is integrated with HealthKit, so you can find your calorie burn data in the Health app. You can turn on the 'Apple Health' option in the app’s Setting to sync your calorie burn with Apple Health.
Features:
- Only 10 to 20 minutes are needed for each leg workout, with a 30-day training plan filled with amazing and effective leg workouts and a 3D personal trainer.
- Sync your calories burned to Apple Health.
- Leg workout exercises are grouped by muscle group and difficulty level (easy, medium, hard) and include videos showing how to do each exercise, voice instructions, and a timer for each exercise.
- Developed by a certified personal trainer, all workout exercises are designed with 3D modeling in Full HD resolution.
- Absolutely no gym equipment is required for your leg workout training. The leg workout exercises can be used anytime, anywhere, for both men and women.
- The Fitness Guide includes over 50 tutorials on body workout, how to breathe, how to lose weight, and more.
- No internet connection is required.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Strong Legs in 30 Days is free to download and use. Should you choose to upgrade to Pro version, we offer auto-renewing subscription option: $4.99/month and $19.99/year. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Read our full privacy policy at https://takalogy.com/privacy-policy/
For our full terms of use, please visit: https://takalogy.com/terms-and-conditions-of-use/

bluejetty:00184774:ios.description:
Solitaire by Easybrain brings you one of the world's most famous classic card games. Designed for both beginners and seasoned players, Solitaire is the perfect game to keep your mind active and have hours of fun anytime, anywhere!
Solitaire has been popular all around the globe for decades for a reason: playing this timeless classic is a brilliant solution to sharpen your mind or simply unwind during a break. Our version of Solitaire is enhanced with smooth graphics and animations, background and card design options, various features to upgrade your gameplay experience, and many more things for you to explore and have a good time with!
Improve your strategy skills and train your brain while taking on Daily Challenges or reaching higher levels with every consecutive win in the main gameplay mode! Expand your winning streaks, earn more points with every game, and beat your high score. Adjust the difficulty by playing Draw 1 or Draw 3 mode, choose your theme, and enjoy countless hours of fun!
You’ll love playing this Solitaire:

bluejetty:00043550:ios.description:
PaidViewpoint is a lively community of critics and influencers alike—eager to share opinions and make a little extra money while they’re at it. 
TAKE SURVEYS AND MAKE MONEY
Join the top-rated survey site and get paid to share your viewpoint. PaidViewpoint is a lively community of critics and influencers alike—eager to share opinions and make a little extra money while they’re at it. Want to put your amazing ideas to work, but curious how it all goes down? No sweat, it’s really simple:
STEP 1: JOIN THE PV COMMUNITY
Create an account with PaidViewpoint and tell us about yourself. It’s fun, fast, and easy—and we show you the utmost respect. That means we prioritize your privacy and never sell your personally identifiable information to anyone.
STEP 2: SHARE YOUR VIEWPOINT
Get matched with a survey and speak your peace. We strive to make sure that when you log in to take a survey, you know exactly what to expect. And while the surveys can be about almost anything, the experience should largely remain the same. Here’s what we mean:
Same length—we’re talking 15-minutes at the most
Same software—just the PV app or the desktop experience
Same format—our surveys all follow the same rules
STEP 3: GET PAID FOR YOUR TIME
Connect to PayPal and transfer your money. Our panelists get paid for their time—yes, even if you get cut off halfway through a survey. We do pay actual money—not points you can redeem for yoyos and friendship bracelets. 
THAT’S IT. 
We can tell you’ve already got something to say… quick, make an account!

bluejetty:00061723:ios.description:
NOTE: This app is exclusively for active, paid employees of existing SurePayroll customers.
SurePayroll for Employees lets you securely access your paycheck information from your iPhone, iPad or iPod touch mobile device. Now, employees can view their paycheck anytime, anywhere.
EASY, SECURE and FREE! Get convenient, 24/7 access to your wages, deductions and even benefits information whether you’re paid by direct deposit or paper check. Say goodbye to waiting for a copy of your paystub or contacting your employer for your available vacation time—it’s all available anytime, anywhere!

FEATURES
•View paycheck details, including earnings, taxes, deductions and YTD totals
•Keep on top of your used, available and earned vacation, sick and personal time
•View multiple paychecks distributed in a single pay period
•Check your wage rate and retirement deduction contribution rates
•Verify the accuracy of your contact information on file with your employer
•Access past paycheck stubs
•Available to hourly, salary and 1099 employees
•Uses the same username and password as your existing MyPayday online payroll account
•Information available 24/7
SECURITY
•All communications are protected by industry-leading encryption
•Your login session securely ends from inactivity

Instantly view any job posted to the web directly on your iPhone or iPad.

•National and local job boards

•National recruiters and all major employers 
•Military branches 
•Major hospitals nonprofits and newspapers 
•Green job boards 
•Volunteer sites 
•Chambers of commerce 
Search by keyword and location (state/city/zip code). See the results in both a list format and as pins on a map. Focus on specific industries you’re interested in.
Save and share your favorite jobs via email, Facebook or Twitter.

LA Hire Mobile lets you instantly return to previous searches, recently viewed jobs and your favorite jobs. 
Visit Louisiana Hire Online Services at https://www.louisianaworks.net

bluejetty:00022572:ios.description:
Word Scenery Master is an app designed to train your brain and learn new words all while having a great time. Share the fun with your family & friends and enjoy Word Scenery together!
Enjoy modern word puzzles with the best of word searching, anagrams, and crosswords! Immerse yourself into the beautiful scenery backgrounds to relax and ease your mind.
It’s simple, beautiful, and marvelously fun to play.Be warned, it’s absolutely addicting.
Playing Word Scenery 10 mins a day sharpens your mind and prepares you for your daily life and challenges!
Challenge yourself to connect letters and find as many hidden words as you can! Unlock stunning landscape backgrounds to escape from home and relax your brain.
Exercise your brain and with thousands of challenging word puzzles,Test your word smarts, unlock new levels and climb the vocabulary ladder.
• Relax your brain by visiting the beautiful destinations of Word Scenery!
• Show your vocabulary power by connecting letters and finding all the hidden words.
• Get your word hunt on with over 6,000 crossword puzzles!
• Challenge your brain and vocabulary – this crossword puzzle starts easy and progressively become more challenging!
• Think you can beat these anagram word puzzles? They start simply but ramp up fast!
• Take each level at your own pace with unlimited tries. Simply fun and relaxation!
• If you find yourself stuck, use letter hints and the word shuffle to guide your way!
• Offline Mode! No wifi? Don’t worry, you can play Word Scenery anytime, anywhere even without a network connection!
• Multiple Choices! Supported on iPhone, iPad.
It's a perfect fit for fans of crossword, word connect and word anagram games, combining best of word find games and crossword puzzles. Not to mention all the gorgeous landscapes you can visit to relax yourself!
