bluejetty:00131747:ios.description:
Know more about North Texas with the app. Stay informed with trusted journalism wherever you are. 
- Get news alerts and notifications, customized by preferred topics 
- Catch high school football, college sports, and Cowboys, Mavericks, Rangers, Stars, Wings coverage from SportsDay and SportsDayHS 
- Stay on top of Texas news, politics, business, food and development stories
- Tune in to the to the food podcast ‘Eat Drink D-FW’ and sports podcast ‘SportsDay Insider’ for expert analysis 
- Page through the e-Edition, a digital replica of the newspaper
- Stay sharp with Puzzmo’s reimagined favorites and brand-new puzzles
- Listen to stories with Everlit, a text-to-audio tool 
- Check out exclusive guides and compelling columns and commentary 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
Subscribe for unlimited digital access to the app, dallasnews.com, e-Edition and newsletters. Get 1 month free, then $14.99 per month. Cancel anytime.
Current digital and print subscribers have unlimited access to the app.
- Digital subscribers: Sign in to the app to access your benefit.
- Print subscribers: If you haven’t activated your digital access yet, look for “Activate Access” at the bottom of the app welcome screen.
PAYMENT: Payment will be charged to your account with the confirmation of your purchase and will automatically renew each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of your monthly period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.dallasnews.com/help/privacy-policy/
TERMS OF SERVICE: https://www.dallasnews.com/help/terms-of-service/
FEEDBACK: We want to hear from you! Let us know if you have questions or suggestions: CustomerCare@dallasnews.com

bluejetty:00162137:ios.description:
Greetings from My Period– a simple but stylish period and ovulation tracker for women.
With the support of this accurate period tracker, you can easily track menstrual cycles, and get notified before periods arrive. Pinpointing your ovulation day and fertile windows can never be easier. Learning about PMS symptoms, or monitoring hormonal health – this all-in-one period calendar app can satisfy all your needs.
Your Data, Your Choice. Our app allows you to use it without the need for registration or login. All your data is stored locally. Your data security is always our top priority.
Here's how we protect your data:
• You can use our app without creating an account.
• You remain COMPLETELY ANONYMOUS while using our app.
• You can DELETE ALL DATA in 1 click whenever you want.
Key Features:
Period and Ovulation Prediction and Reminders
- Use the menstrual tracker to record past cycles to understand your own patterns.
- Spot the timing of ovulation and your most fertile days for better family planning.
- Plan your life, work, and social activities accordingly for a more carefree lifestyle.
PMS Symptoms and Daily Wellness Metrics
- Log and track different symptoms and moods in the menstrual calendar.
- Gain insights into your body and emotional states and focus more on overall health.
- Keep a menstrual diary as a health record that can be shared with healthcare providers.
- Cultivate healthy lifestyle habits like regular weigh-ins and adequate water intake.
Data Security & Privacy
- Start using the application instantly without requiring account registration.
- Store all the data on your local device.
My Calendar is your trusted companion to guide you through each phase of life with confidence and convenience.
Subscription Options: Weekly/ Monthly/ Yearly

2. Post-purchase, you can handle subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
3. Failure to disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period concludes will result in automatic subscription renewal.
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00139623:ios.name: FitWoody Health Sleep Coach
bluejetty:00139623:ios.summary:
FitWoody turns your Apple Watch into a recovery coach. Every morning: HRV, sleep score, training load, VO2 max and a readiness score that tells you when to push or rest.
► YOUR WOODY FOR A HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE
FitWoody goes beyond activity
bluejetty:00139623:ios.description:
FitWoody turns your Apple Watch into a recovery coach. Every morning: HRV, sleep score, training load, VO2 max and a readiness score that tells you when to push or rest.
► YOUR WOODY FOR A HEALTHIER LIFESTYLE
FitWoody goes beyond activity tracking. It listens to your body and adapts your daily goals based on your recovery, energy, and sleep. Woody, your companion, reflects your wellbeing and keeps you motivated through every step of your journey, turning health tracking into something warm, personal, and alive.
► METABOLIC AND HEALTH INSIGHTS
Every night, while you sleep, your Apple Watch quietly measures key health signals like HRV, resting heart rate, VO₂ max, blood oxygen, breathing rate, and body temperature. FitWoody translates those metrics into a simple readiness score that helps you decide whether to push or rest. You’ll wake up with clear insights about your recovery, energy, and how your lifestyle impacts your wellbeing.
► ADAPTIVE DAILY GOALS
Your daily movement goal automatically adjusts based on your body’s state. If you’ve had poor sleep or a stressful day, your targets lower so you can recover guilt-free. If you’re feeling great, FitWoody gently challenges you to go further. It’s a dynamic system that helps you stay consistent without burnout.
► SLEEP ANALYSIS
FitWoody doesn’t just count hours in bed, it helps you understand the quality of your rest. See your time in deep, core, and REM sleep, your recovery trends, and how they influence your energy levels, performance, and mood. Each morning, you’ll know what your body needs next.
► TRAINING ANALYSIS
Every workout is placed in context. FitWoody helps you see how your training affects endurance, cardiovascular load, and overall progress. Whether you’re running, cycling, or doing yoga, the app explains what each session contributed, and when your body needs a break.
► GOALS
We all start with good intentions: “I’ll get fitter,” “I’ll feel better.” FitWoody helps you turn those ideas into actionable, long-term goals. You can create goals around distance, time, frequency, or total elevation, and FitWoody will guide you along the way with reminders, encouragement, and progress updates.
► FITPASSPORT
FitPassport is your long-term view of health, a digital health card that transforms your Apple Watch data into a clear visual narrative. It shows your evolution across cardiovascular, exercise, sleep, and metabolic health, so you can see where you stand and how you’ve improved over time. Not just numbers, meaning.
► APPLE WATCH APP
FitWoody now lives on your wrist. Check your readiness, movement, sleep, and recent workouts directly from your Apple Watch. Built natively for watchOS 11, it’s fast, fluid, and designed to keep you connected to your health in seconds.
► AI-POWERED EXPLANATIONS
With Apple Foundation Models, FitWoody explains your data in plain language: why your HRV dropped, what your sleep says about recovery, and how your body is adapting. Clear insights, always in context.
► PRIVACY FIRST
Your body stays yours. FitWoody processes data locally with Apple Intelligence when available, or anonymizes it before analysis. No ads. No tracking. Ever.
► FITWOODY PLUS
While most of FitWoody’s core features are free, advanced analytics and long-term insights are part of FitWoody Plus. Payments are charged to your Apple ID account at the time of purchase or after any free trial period if offered. To avoid renewal charges, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your App Store settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://fitwoody.camp/legal-notice-information-and-terms-of-use
App Privacy Policy: https://fitwoody.camp/app-privacy-policy

Welcome to TRIO – Open-Minded Dating for Singles & Couples!
Meet, match & connect with people who are open to something different. TRIO is a dating app created for open-minded singles & couples looking for casual dating, meaningful connections & new experiences.
Whether you’re straight, bisexual, lesbian, gay, poly or simply open to exploring new connections, TRIO gives you an inclusive space to meet like-minded people & find connections that match your vibe.
EXPLORE, MATCH & CONNECT
• Discover – Explore a diverse community of open-minded singles & couples. Find people who share your interests, preferences & lifestyle.

• Authentic Profiles – Accounts are reviewed to help maintain a more authentic & welcoming dating community.
• Safe & Private – Your privacy matters. TRIO gives you tools to stay in control of your dating experience.
• Open & Inclusive – Whatever your gender, sexuality or relationship preference, TRIO welcomes people looking for genuine, open-minded connections.
• Made for Singles & Couples – Whether you’re dating solo or together, TRIO makes it easier to discover people who match your interests & vibe.
JOIN TRIO TODAY!
Whether you’re looking for casual dating, meaningful connections or simply something new, TRIO gives you a place to meet, explore & connect your way.

bluejetty:00023905:ios.description:
Reimagination and a remake of the immortal classic. Arrange the falling pieces to fill up and clear the lines. Clear as many lines as possible to advance through levels or complete various objectives. This game is inspired by the four brick falling blocks games. But instead of easy four brick pieces, where the name Tetra comes from, this game uses five bricks pieces, thus the name Penta. Of course, you are not limited to either set of pieces. Play any combination you would like and consider more fun.
Fun question: Do you see the black dots when you are looking at the game title screen? Do you think they are there?
Features:
- Play an endless game or complete objectives.
- Play individual levels or progress through the campaign.
- Smooth and customizable controls.
- Various difficulty levels.
Controls:
The controls were designed to make the gameplay smooth and enjoyable. Below are the few highlights that make this game stand out.
- Tap with the second finger or swipe down to drop the piece. Of course, you can use the "Drop" buttons too.
- Swipe up to stash the piece and use it later in the game. This allows for more strategic play.

Cosmostation has been developing and operating a non-custodial, multi-chain wallet since 2018. Built on years of expertise as one of the world's leading validators, we deliver security, transparency, and reliability you can trust.

All transactions are signed locally on your device, and private keys or sensitive information are never transmitted externally. You always maintain full control over your assets.

Cosmostation Wallet supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Sui, Cosmos (ATOM), and over 100+ networks, with continuous expansion.Every integration follows either the BIP44 HD path standard or the official specification of each chain.

- Sui: Wallet Standard compatible, with full SUI token management and transfers.

Since Cosmostation Wallet does not collect any user data, we may not be able to identify every issue directly.

BePrime: Football Predictions, Betting Tips & Match Analysis
Discover expert football predictions, premium betting tips, advanced match analysis, team statistics, and data-driven insights — all in one place.
BePrime combines carefully selected football predictions with detailed match intelligence to help you evaluate every game from multiple perspectives. Explore expert analysis, team form, head-to-head comparisons, community expectations, and premium insights designed for users who want more than just a prediction.
WHY BEPRIME?
• Expert football predictions prepared using statistical and analytical evaluation
• Carefully selected VIP, HT/FT, Correct Score, BeFixed, Over/Under and BTTS predictions
• Detailed match analysis powered by team form, historical performance, injuries and key statistics
• Premium predictions focused on quality rather than quantity
• Community expectations and prediction trends before every match
• Instant notifications for new predictions, premium updates and important match events
• Transparent approach with no guaranteed-result claims
MORE THAN JUST PREDICTIONS
Most prediction apps stop at showing a single pick.
BePrime goes further by helping you understand why a prediction was selected.
Explore every match with powerful tools including:
• Team form and recent performance
• Head-to-head comparisons
• Match statistics
• Community voting and expectations
• Historical results
• Match insights
• Season-based football content
Everything is designed to provide a deeper understanding of every match before kickoff.
PREMIUM EXPERIENCE
BePrime Premium provides access to carefully selected football predictions across multiple premium categories, including:
• VIP Predictions
• HT/FT Predictions
• Correct Score Predictions
• BeFixed Predictions
• Additional premium match insights
Rather than publishing a fixed number of predictions every day, our focus is on sharing opportunities that meet our internal analysis standards.
Eligible no-pick days are automatically tracked through the in-app compensation system available in your profile.
FOOTBALL INTELLIGENCE IN ONE PLACE
BePrime brings together football predictions, match analysis, statistical insights and community expectations in one modern experience.
Whether you're reviewing team form, comparing head-to-head records, exploring premium predictions or following community trends, every feature is designed to help you evaluate matches with greater confidence.
KEY FEATURES
• Football predictions

• VIP predictions

• BeFixed predictions
• Over/Under predictions
• BTTS predictions
• Match analysis
• Team form

• Instant notifications
• Modern and intuitive interface
DISCOVER A SMARTER WAY TO ANALYZE FOOTBALL
Whether you're looking for football predictions, premium betting tips, advanced match analysis or detailed team statistics, BePrime gives you everything you need in one place.
Explore every match with deeper insights, smarter analysis and carefully selected predictions.

BePrime is a sports analytics and prediction platform.
It does not provide, operate, facilitate or promote gambling or betting services.
All predictions are generated through analytical evaluation using available statistics, historical performance, current match information and other relevant data.

bluejetty:00070910:ios.name: Slow Down Music | Transcribe+
bluejetty:00070910:ios.summary: Transcribe+ combines high quality tempo and pitch-shifting with on-device AI that splits a song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other instruments, so you can isolate and hear EXACTLY what you are transcribing by ear. Now on iPh
bluejetty:00070910:ios.description:
Transcribe+ combines high quality tempo and pitch-shifting with on-device AI that splits a song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other instruments, so you can isolate and hear EXACTLY what you are transcribing by ear. Now on iPhone, iPad, and Mac!
Adjust speed and pitch effortlessly with simple swipe gestures. Tap the waveform to pause the track, then drag to listen at your chosen pace, even one note at a time! Attach chord charts that follow the form of the song, mark song structures or add personal notes using customizable flags on the waveform, and practice specific sections repeatedly by defining looped areas.
Key Features:
• Speed adjustable from 0.25x to 2x without affecting pitch.
• Split tracks into 2, 4, or 6 stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other).
• Easy pitch modification by +/-12 semitones.
• Fine-tune pitch adjustment slider with 1 cent increments.
• Interactive waveform interface for real-time scrubbing and listening note by note.
• Chord charts from MusicXML, ABC, iReal Pro, or pasted text.
• Beats, bars, tempo, and key detected automatically.
• Consolidate and practice loops in a single location with Loop View.
• Smart Loops can automatically increase speed or shift pitch with each loop.
• Load videos for enhanced visual understanding.
• Intuitive 10-band EQ toolbar for refined frequency adjustment and additional isolation possibilities.
• Mark and annotate waveforms for efficient review.
• Easily export loops or entire tracks in eight formats.
• Multiple windows and split-screen multitasking for efficient iPad use.
• 11 attractive themes with elegant icons.
• Keyboard shortcuts compatible with foot pedals for easier control during practice.
• Integration with popular cloud storage services.
AI Vocal Removal & Stems Separation:
Remove or isolate vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, or other instruments on ANY track (without DRM). Use this feature to focus on the instruments you're interested in, or create a play-along track. Stems are split entirely on your device, with no uploading and no limits. If an instrument isn't in the song, its stem is hidden instead of filled with leftover noise. Export any combinations of stems and remix them as you like!
Chord Charts:
Import common chord chart formats you find online. The chord changes run under the waveform, following the actual form of the song. Transcribe+ listens to the whole song on your device and suggests the exact beat where the form starts. If a bar is stretched or squeezed, or the song is heard at double or half tempo, it offers a one-tap fix.
Loop View with "Smart Loops":
View all your loops in the loop view. Simply tap the loop icon to start or stop a loop. You can set parameters for a metronome count-in before each loop or auto-increase speed or shift pitch with each repetition. Link loops as you learn, starting with small chunks and joining them together with a tap.
EQ ToolBar, Channel Mixer, and Fine Tuning Slider:
Further isolate or enhance the part you're listening to with the EQ toolbar or the Stereo Channel mixer. You can also finely adjust the overall pitch of the track in increments of 1 cent.
Transcribe+ for Mac:
Transcribe+ now runs on the Mac, with a full menu bar, keyboard shortcuts, and all of the same features.
Apple Music Support:
Transcribe+ integrates with Apple Music, letting you adjust the tempo and add flags and loops to any song in your Apple Music library. Please note, due to DRM music streaming limitations, some features are unavailable on Apple Music tracks.
iCloud Sync:
All of your flags, loops, chord charts, and settings for each track you load are automatically saved to iCloud. These settings also sync automatically across all your devices.
Six stems require a device with 8 GB of memory or more; other devices split 4 stems. Beat detection and chord charts require iOS 27 or macOS 27.
Terms of Use: https://dynamicappdesign.com/tos.html

bluejetty:00080201:ios.description:
Welcome to the Blood Pressure: Healthy Life！
Blood Pressure: Healthy Life is a comprehensive health app designed to help you record your vital health parameters conveniently. With a wide range of features, Blood Pressure: Healthy Life aims to empower you to take control of your well-being and lead a healthier lifestyle.
FEATURES:
- Record Blood Pressure Readings:
Easily record your blood pressure data, including high and low pressure. No paper or pen required, easy to operate.
- Heart Rate:
Use a highlight (LED flash beside the camera, or other bright enough light source can also) to illuminate the capillaries under the fingertip, when the hearpresses fresh blood into the capillaries, the brightness (red depth) will change slightly, through the camera to monitor this regular change of interval, you can calculate the hearttpeat. (According to the source: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28288955/)
- Blood Glucose record:
For those who want to keep an eye on their blood sugar levels, Blood Pressure: Healthy Life offers a convenient blood glucose record feature. Easily log your readings and track your glucose levels over time.
- Personalized Reminders:
Personalized settings for medication management, blood pressure measurement, heart rate measurement, and exercise reminders. Never miss important health tasks again!
- Health Information and Tips:
Stay updated with the latest health-related information through APP's knowledge point push feature. Receive regular notifications and articles on various health topics, including nutrition, exercise, mental well-being, and more.
- Health Status Tracking:
Track your overall health progress with APP's comprehensive health tracking feature. Monitor your daily activities and exercise routines. Set goals, receive reminders, and visualize your progress through intuitive charts and graphs. Stay motivated and make positive changes to your lifestyle.
Apple Health: The APP is integrated with HealthKit to synchronize Apple Health's blood pressure and heart rate data.
WeatherKit: Supported by the new "Apple Weather" service, the application integrates WeatherKit, allowing you to see the current weather conditions and temperatures, as well as forecast the weather for the next 15 days, and take safety measures before rain.
Disclaimer：The Blood Pressure: Healthy Life application information, data and estimates are for informational purposes only and are not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Functions such as heart rate measurement are based on algorithms, and their accuracy is affected by equipment, environment, body state, etc., and the data cannot be used as a medical basis. If you have health problems, please consult a professional, the developer is not responsible for the consequences of using this app.
We provide a membership function, and the specific prices and benefits are subject to in app display. Please refer to the subscription notice for details: http://bloodpressure-pro.com/subscription
Privacy Policy: https://bloodpressure-pro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00021480:ios.description:
Experience next-generation digital banking with Global Smart Plus, the all-in-one banking platform from Global IME Bank. Designed with a seamless omni-channel experience and single sign-on access, Global Smart Plus allows you to use the same login credentials across platforms for secure and convenient banking anytime, anywhere.
From opening a bank account instantly to making QR payments, paying utility bills, managing cards, investing in shares, and tracking your expenses, Global Smart Plus brings all your everyday banking and financial needs into one secure and smart platform. With built-in personal financial management tools, digital services, and real-time access to your finances, banking has never been easier, faster, or smarter.
Why Choose Global Smart Plus?
Quick Account Opening:
Experience seamless onboarding. You can open a bank account from the app using highly secure AI powered 3D facial authentication and start transacting within few minutes.
Personal Financial Management:
See where your money goes with Budget360°. Track daily expenses, set savings goals, use round up savings, set budget and split bills when needed.
Share Market:
Stay ahead in the market. Access real-time NEPSE data, apply for IPOs instantly, manage your portfolio, and find investment opportunities. Global Smart Plus includes live market tracking, share calculator, stock screeners, and fundamental/technical analysis tools to help make informed decisions.
Global Junior Account Open
Introduce children to smart banking from an early age with the Global Junior App, a companion app of Global Smart Plus. Parents can manage and monitor their child’s financial activities, encourage saving habits, and help them learn responsible money management in a safe and guided way.
QR Payment:
Scan ANY payment QR with Global Smart Plus. Payments can be made effortlessly across FonePay, NepalPay and SCT network.
Complete Card Management:
Manage your debit, credit cards, travel card, ecom card and more with Global Smart Plus. Link your cards, make real-time credit card payments, view CVV and detailed card information, and access transaction history anytime. The app also lets you block/unblock cards, request Green PIN, download credit card statements, view card limits, reset PIN count, and enjoy many more secure self-service features. Experience convenient and secure card management directly from your mobile.
Digital Loan:
Apply for Remit Karja or a loan against your fixed deposit straight from the app. No paperwork.
Utility & Bills Payment:
Pay for your internet, airlines, electricity, and water bills, or manage EMIs and Top-ups. Everything is simplified in one app.
Government Payments:
Skip the queues! Easily pay SSF, Traffic Fines, EPS, Health Insurance Board, NOC, OCR, and over 28+ other government payments.
Merchant Payments:
Make seamless payments to merchants, schools, vendors, and manage your EMIs effortlessly.
Cable Car Ticket Booking Made Easy:
Book cable car tickets easily with Global Smart Plus app. You can purchase tickets for popular cable cars like Chandragiri, Manakamana, Maulakalika, Lumbini, Annapurna, and more in just a few taps. The app offers a secure and hassle-free digital payment experience, helping you avoid long queues at ticket counters. Plan your travel conveniently and enjoy a smooth journey to your favorite destinations.
International Airlines
Book international airline tickets directly from the app. Whether you are travelling for business, study, or leisure, Global Smart Plus helps you manage your flight booking and payment in one secure platform.
Download Global Smart Plus and start your banking journey.

bluejetty:00187853:ios.description:

DealMachine brings mobile Driving for Dollars and nationwide property intelligence together in one app. Explore properties on the map, track your drives, save opportunities as you find them, and keep everything organized for follow-up.

- Start a Free Drive with live route and mileage tracking. Background location helps preserve your active drive when your screen locks or the app moves to the background.

Built for real estate investors and property-focused teams across roofing, solar, and other industries, DealMachine helps turn what you see in the field into organized, actionable opportunities.

bluejetty:00061217:ios.description:
The Gurukula App provides a unique method to learn Indian Culture - through the ancient art of storytelling. 
The app connects children to like-minded characters and helps them develop a deep righteous attitude for life.
We have taken original epics in Samskritam and abridged/translated them to maintain purity and avoid distortions. 
Learn the Mahabharata, Ramayana, Panchatantra, Vedas, and Slokas through Audiobooks Comic books and Storybooks.
Audio Books
Narrated as short 10-minute chapters in an easy to understand style. Pop open the app and let us narrate a chapter for you - whether you are driving, cooking or simply retiring for the night.
Comic Books
Specially produced comic books catered to the 21st-century child. Over 40 colorful images per chapter carefully designed to engage the child in Indian Culture. Thousands of children have learned Indian Epics through the Gurukula Comics.
Story Books
Translated directly from original texts. Written in simple English. Moral Values from every story are identified and explained to help the child get grounded in values. Learn life by reading one story a day. 
The Gurukula app is specially designed for kids and adults alike. 
One new chapter will be published every week

bluejetty:00080722:ios.description:
Thera – your personal mental health tracker and your diary with a fingerprint lock. One of the most helpful anxiety relief apps. Use Thera as your mood diary, daily emotion tracker, and gratitude app. Try the mood board and other writing practices to become mentally strong and self-confident.
Be aware of your wishes. Fight against your anxiety. Don’t give up your life to fears. Learn to be happy!
Journaling is a great tool to promote self-development and look after your mental health. Thera is a diary with a fingerprint lock, which guarantees complete confidentiality. Your records are stored only on your phone.
Wishes Journal & Diary
Having goals and wishes is essential for your mental health and well-being:
- Create your own list of goals and wishes.
- See how many points it takes to reach the set goal.
- Archive of fulfilled desires.
- Wish-spiration List - 700+ simple wishes to help bring zest back into your life.
Gratitude Journal & Diary
Practice gratitude to restore and strengthen your mental health and balance. Gratitude app has three sections:
- Thanking yourself, the world, and others.
Start noticing the beauty in small things by focusing on the positive moments. Stop obsessing over your failures. When you get used to saying thanks for the good things in life, thank the world for the challenges that make you stronger.
Fears Journal & Diary
Fear is detrimental to your mental health. But such obstacles are inevitable on the way to achieving your dreams and completing plans.
- Write down your anxious thoughts and concerns
- Analyze your fears
- Think about the confidence boost you’ll get when you overcome your fears
- Think about the possibility of moving towards set goals
You will clearly see how your fears slow you down and prevent you from becoming happier. Understand what steps you need to take. Transform your fears into action!
Mood journal & diary
Feeling emotions means living. Controlling emotions means controlling your life. This daily emotion tracker will help you analyze your mood and emotional well-being:
- Express your mood.
- Choose the emotions you are feeling from a mood board and develop your emotional intelligence.
- Analyze your emotions - leading questions will help you analyze your mental state and emotions in detail.
Your personal mental health tracker will help you:
- understand your mood and understand what exactly affects it
- develop your emotional intelligence: learn how to recognize your emotions, control them, and focus on the positive
- lower your anxiety level
- increase self-awareness and strengthen your mental health
Here is one of the feedbacks our support regularly receives:
Jessica
I tried many anxiety relief apps. This one is great help for me, with its mental health tracker, its highly confidential diary with fingerprint lock, its mood diary, and daily emotion tracker with a wide range of emojis on the mood board. And with its gratitude app diary!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Thera offers a subscription plan that gives you a more personalized experience and unlimited access to the entire app.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
For more information, please visit: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://theraapp.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-c048fb2d4b234c549e929e0f973c7345
Terms of Use: https://theraapp.notion.site/Terms-of-Use-886676905e4f44ea86b404126fbfbded

bluejetty:00180352:ios.summary:
More than a parking meter.
Who said that trains and cars can’t be friends? With P+Rail, these two modes of transport can be combined with ease.
With the SBB P+Rail app, you can pay for your parking quickly and cashfree. The P+Rail app unifi
bluejetty:00180352:ios.description:
More than a parking meter.
Who said that trains and cars can’t be friends? With P+Rail, these two modes of transport can be combined with ease.
With the SBB P+Rail app, you can pay for your parking quickly and cashfree. The P+Rail app unifies SBB P+Rail parking spaces with those of ten partner railways (BLS, RhB, RBS, TPF, SOB, MGB, OeBB, AB, AVA and Zentralbahn). 
And here’s why the SBB P+Rail app is so simple and fast:
The app always knows exactly where your nearest parking space is, so you don’t need to go to the information board.
Extra information about the parking spaces is displayed for each location, such as the number of electric car charging stations or important restrictions.
If you make a mistake while booking, you can easily cancel your parking payment independently within the first few minutes.
You can access an overview of your active, expired and refunded parking tickets.
You can store several number plates and save your personal favourite locations in the quick selection view.
Already using the SBB Mobile app for searching the timetable or purchasing tickets? You can use your SwissPass login for the SBB P+Rail app too. In future, you will be able to use your stored payment methods in both apps – wherever and whenever you are on the move.
Make sure you have a spot: there is a binding reservation option for 30 busy locations – find it easily in the app menu.
Find out for yourself!

Extra information about the parking spaces is displayed for each location, such as the number of electric car charging stations or important restrictions.
If you make a mistake while booking, you can easily cancel your parking payment independently within the first few minutes.
You can access an overview of your active, expired and refunded parking tickets.
You can store several number plates and save your personal favourite locations in the quick selection view.
Already using the SBB Mobile app for searching the timetable or purchasing tickets? You can use your SwissPass login for the SBB P+Rail app too. In future, you will be able to use your stored payment methods in both apps – wherever and whenever you are on the move.
Make sure you have a spot: there is a binding reservation option for 30 busy locations – find it easily in the app menu.
Find out for yourself!

bluejetty:00132053:ios.description:
The London Review of Books is Europe’s leading magazine of books and ideas.
Published twice a month, the LRB is home to the most exciting writing on literature, history, politics, philosophy, art, poetry and more.
Already a subscriber? Simply install the app and sign in with your LRB website login details.
App features
- Read the LRB anywhere, even offline
- Get the latest issue on Wednesday, before it hits the newsstand
- Save articles for later reference
- Resize text for easy reading
- Dark mode option
- Access ten years of the LRB dating back to 2014
Subscribing via the app
- The app is free to download and comes with a free preview issue
- Subscribers to the LRB magazine can access the app with their LRB website login and do not require a separate app subscription
- Subscriptions made via the app, however, do not include access to the LRB website and online archive
- In the app, you can purchase individual issues of the magazine or an annual subscription
- Subscriptions are charged to your Apple account and managed in App Store account settings
- All subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period
- If your subscription lapses, you will still be able to read the issues published while you were an active subscriber

bluejetty:00016135:ios.name: Car Crash Simulator Royale
bluejetty:00016135:ios.summary: Crash and wreck all the cars! Drive fast to survive! Do maximum crash damage possible, earn cash and unlock crazy stuff like monster trucks and tanks. Sounds fun? Try the Car Crash & Demolition Derby Simulator and see how you like making ex
bluejetty:00016135:ios.description:
Crash and wreck all the cars! Drive fast to survive! Do maximum crash damage possible, earn cash and unlock crazy stuff like monster trucks and tanks. Sounds fun? Try the Car Crash & Demolition Derby Simulator and see how you like making extreme destruction in exciting little car derby wars. It's a game that is a mix of crash simulator style engine, fast paced action, demolition derby and car war games - yet quite unique by itself. 
Don't EVER even think about doing this in real life. Download this simulator game instead :)
Some of the awesome features of this game:
- Explore many crash simulator modes, including tank and mech
- Intense high speed crashing action
- Real-time car destruction and damage deformation + crash physics engine
- Choose between many high end cars
- Customize and improve your car by upgrades and tuning
- Incredible visuals and great performance on a wide range of devices
- Realistic car wreckage and debris simulation
Have fun smashing and destroying your adversaries, but keep in mind please that the game is a very fun simulation of the real thing. However, in this derby simulator limiting car damage is key to becoming victorious and how you smash into other cars makes a big difference. Always try to smash rivals when you have enough health or they are already damaged. A reckless head-on collisions with powerful cars should be avoided to prevent your engine to die or other extreme damage to occur. To boost the damage you inflict on an rival you can get your motor rev up and drive & crash faster by using the nitro boost. 
The game allows you to choose from various cars (including monster truck and other big vehicles). These all have the pros and cons. Be sure to buy upgrades wisely as the various type of modes require different cars. Use armor upgrades to strengthen your endurance; or engine upgrades to boost your speed, push and pulling power. Good results let you earn more money (cash) during races!
Car physics is realistic enough to ensure that simulation of crashes and destruction is done really nice - you can damage car slightly or a lot, and make its part fall off and fly around if you bump the car hard enough. 
You have 20+ cars to play with and 10+ maps to battle on, so enjoy demolition wars and good luck!

bluejetty:00074439:ios.description:
Dive into the magic of Applaydu & Friends, a Kinder racing game that combines the thrill of action, fun challenges, and the creative power of coding. Play on this playground and collect 14 fresh Funko Pop! Magical characters to run, dash, dodge obstacles, fall, get the magic spells & special potions, and stumble to the victory. Kids can embark on a magical journey where the joy of running and racing meets a safe and immersive playground experience.
**** RUN AND RACE TOGETHER WITH FRIENDS *****
It’s time for teens to rally up to 12 of their guys for a fun race in Applaydu & Friends' action-packed running game. Amplify the excitement by taking the fun online and throwing down challenges for epic races. Engage in the races, dash through obstacles, and discover the magic of running in a fun-filled knockout simulation. An experience to rank on the racing leaderboard or enjoy the fun loop where teens fall or stumble and then get back up again.
**** IMMERSIVE ACTION AND STUMBLING FUN *****
Immerse in a fun action game where teens don't just run - they stumble, fall and race in the thrilling battle royale of running obstacles. The 7+ exciting knockout running maps are designed for your teens’ non-stop fun, keeping the excitement alive with every dash and stumble, leap over obstacles and grab infinite power-ups. And wait for it – the new camera lets teens witness the immersive action from every angle of the infinite fun run!
**** CRAFT CREATIVE RACING MAGIC *****
Unleash your teens creativity with the game's upgraded creative mode, where kids can create mind-blowing racing maps. Teens can craft funky obstacles, discover advanced coding skills, and create a whole new immersive experience battle for their friends. The game is not just about racing; it's about crafting teens own adventure for endless creativity.
**** DISCOVER THE POWER OF FUNKO & CREATIVE UNIQUENESS *****
Explore the Funko universe with 14 new magical characters, each with their own special powers. They can also create & discover their own racing heroes with 18 cool outfits ready to mix & match and participate in the ultimate battle royale with obstacles. There's no limit to the creative looks kids can run on.
**** A KINDER GAMING PLAYGROUND ****
Applaydu & Friends is not just a game; it's a Kinder gaming playground community. The platform ensures a safe and private environment, protecting kids' identities with anonymous profiles and predefined names. It's a world of discovery and joy for kids aged 8+.
Join the Kinder gaming experience at Applaydu & Friends, where kids can run, race, play, and create in an immersive and safe environment. It's playable offline, ad-free, without in-app purchases, and supports 15 languages.
Contact us at applayduFriends@kinder.com. For privacy-related questions, reach out to privacy@ferrero.com or visit http://applayduFriends.kinder.com/legal. Unleash the joy with Applaydu & Friends, where infinite fun awaits!
To remove your account, please go to https://applaydufriends.kinder.com/legal#remove-account

bluejetty:00178502:ios.name: Dinosaur Games for Kids: Sea
bluejetty:00178502:ios.summary: Unleash your child's wild side with the most exciting adventure game from Yateland - Dinosaur Aqua Adventure! The animals have made a daring escape from the aquarium, and it's your job to guide them back home. This unique combination of ani
bluejetty:00178502:ios.description:
Unleash your child's wild side with the most exciting adventure game from Yateland - Dinosaur Aqua Adventure! The animals have made a daring escape from the aquarium, and it's your job to guide them back home. This unique combination of animal games for kids and ocean games makes learning fun and engaging.
Journey Under the Sea!
Embark on an incredible underwater adventure game and step into the shoes - or fins - of a baby turtle, shark, jellyfish, and penguin. Experience the wonders of marine life from an animal's perspective and guide them back to their aquatic home.
Explore Diverse Animal Habitats!
From deep sea dives to dancing with dolphins in tropical oceans, Dinosaur Aqua Adventure offers endless exploration in our ocean games for kids. Each adventure game task helps kids discover the perfect habitat for each animal, showcasing stunning scenes from all corners of the globe.
Discover Animal Behaviors
Watch as a toothpick bird courageously cleans a crocodile's teeth, help a hungry shark find delicious treats on the seafloor, or learn about penguin growth patterns through molting. This animal game for kids not only entertains but educates.
Interactive Building Game
Construct the ideal home for your marine friends! With a sandbox-like environment, position coral, shells, and even treasure chests to perfect each home. In this part of our adventure game, there are no boundaries! Feed and take care of marine life, including whales, dolphins, and manta rays. You'll encounter up to 35 species of marine animals and learn about their diets and their roles as predators or prey.
Key Features
• Immerse in the behaviors and characteristics of 5 different animals, exploring their habitats and gaining valuable biological knowledge
• Discover polar regions, tropical oceans, the deep sea, green algae forests, wetlands
• Rich interaction features for a fun and educational natural science experience
• Interact with 60 types of corals, 35 marine animals, and build custom marine life homes
• Learn about animals' feeding habits by feeding them 16 different types of food
• Delicate and vivid animation provides a lifelike marine world
About Yateland
Yateland develops educational apps that inspire preschoolers across the globe to learn through play. Every app we create is guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Learn more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
At Yateland, user privacy protection is our top priority. To understand more about how we handle these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00185402:ios.description:
Hill Climb Racing is back, bigger, better and it's even funner?!
Hill Climb Racing 2 is the ultimate multiplayer car racing game packed with real-time online racing, custom cars, and endless driving action! From the creators of the original hit comes a fast-paced 2D car racing game featuring competitive PvP battles, custom track creation, and non-stop driving challenges.
Race against friends in the premier multiplayer car game! Drive across treacherous hills, deserts, and snowfields while unlocking powerful racing cars, monster trucks, and bikes. Upgrade your engine, tune performance systems, and master realistic physics in one of the world's top online car racing games.
Multiplayer Car Racing & Online PvP
Challenge players globally in real-time multiplayer car races. Climb Trophy Road, compete in ranked cups, join a racing team, and dominate global leaderboards in high-speed multiplayer racing events.
Unlock, Upgrade & Customize Racing Cars
Build your garage with top-tier racing cars, off-road 4x4s, and sports cars:
* Race Cars & Supercars: Boost top speeds for total track domination.
* Car Customization & Tuning: Upgrade engines, tires, suspension, and grip.
* Mythic Tuning Parts: Maximize speed and vehicle handling for car battles.
Create & Share Custom Racing Tracks
Design custom tracks using the built-in Track Editor. Build extreme obstacles, crazy stunt jumps, and unique car racing challenges, then share your tracks with a global multiplayer car game community of millions.
Classic Offroad Car Driving & Adventure Mode
Experience the legendary endless car driving mode that made the original Hill Climb Racing famous! Navigate extreme offroad terrain, perform gravity-defying stunts, collect coins, and master physics-based car driving.
Live Racing Events & Weekly Car Challenges
Participate in competitive multiplayer racing events, seasonal activities, and weekly car racing challenges. Win exclusive rewards, rare vehicle blueprints, and custom car customization parts.
Core Game Features
* Physics-Based Car Racing — Master realistic, chaotic, and hilarious car driving physics.
* Online Multiplayer Racing — Battle players worldwide in multiplayer car races.
* Car Upgrades & Customization — Deep performance tuning, cosmetic skins, Vehicle Mastery, and Mythic Tuning Parts for all racing cars.
* Track Editor & Community Content — Build, share, and play community-created car racing tracks.
* Team Events & Leaderboards — Team up with friends and climb competitive online racing leaderboards.
* Regular Game Updates — New racing cars, maps, cups, and online car game events added regularly.
Download Hill Climb Racing 2 today to join millions of players in the ultimate multiplayer car racing game!

bluejetty:00187389:ios.name: Avigilon Alta Open
bluejetty:00187389:ios.summary: With Avigilon Alta Open, your phone is your key. Avigilon Alta Open allows users to quickly and securely unlock a door connected to the Avigilon Alta Access Control system with their smartphone. The easy-to-use mobile app finds nearby Avigi
bluejetty:00187389:ios.description:
With Avigilon Alta Open, your phone is your key. Avigilon Alta Open allows users to quickly and securely unlock a door connected to the Avigilon Alta Access Control system with their smartphone. The easy-to-use mobile app finds nearby Avigilon Alta-connected readers, and lets you unlock the door with a single wave or tap.
ACCESS FEATURES
Avigilon Alta makes it easy to unlock the door, your way.
- Touchless Wave to Unlock: wave your hand or phone in front of the reader to unlock the door
- Mobile Badge: use your ID badge to sign in for all Avigilon Alta-connected organizations
- Favorites: save your frequently used entries for quick access
- Activity Log: view your access history right in the app
- Single Login: Easily switch between Avigilon Alta-connected organizations without logging out
- Remote Unlock: authorized users can unlock any door, from anywhere
- Flexible access methods: unlock via Apple Watch, tablet app, or mobile app
DIGITAL GUEST PASS
Create and customize guest passes for visitors right in the app. Send the digital Cloud Key credentials via email or SMS, and guests can unlock the door right from their phone.
REMOTE FEATURES
Advanced security, accessed from anywhere. Authorized users can remotely unlock any door, create and send digital Guest Passes, and activate pre-configured system Lockdown plans in the event of an emergency, all from the app. Authorized users are determined by the system administrator.
HOW IT WORKS
- The application works only with the Avigilon Alta Access Control system.
- Certain features, such as Mobile Badge and Lockdown, are enabled at the discretion of the organization administrator.
- We leverage Bluetooth low energy, Wi-Fi and LTE capabilities, as well as location services to ensure the best door opening experience possible.
- To ensure you are authorized as a user of your company’s Avigilon Alta Access Control system, please contact your administrator, who will check to see that your email address has been added and will send you links to enable your application to be authorized and credentialed.
If you would like to start using Avigilon Alta Open in your organization visit www.avigilon.com/alta to learn more about the service and how to get started.

The easy-to-use mobile app finds nearby Avigilon Alta-connected readers, and lets you unlock the door with a single wave or tap.

ACCESS FEATURES
Avigilon Alta makes it easy to unlock the door, your way.
- Touchless Wave to Unlock: wave your hand or phone in front of the reader to unlock the door
- Mobile Badge: use your ID badge to sign in for all Avigilon Alta-connected organizations
- Favorites: save your frequently used entries for quick access
- Activity Log: view your access history right in the app
- Single Login: Easily switch between Avigilon Alta-connected organizations without logging out
- Remote Unlock: authorized users can unlock any door, from anywhere
- Flexible access methods: unlock via Apple Watch, tablet app, or mobile app

DIGITAL GUEST PASS
Create and customize guest passes for visitors right in the app. Send the digital Cloud Key credentials via email or SMS, and guests can unlock the door right from their phone.

REMOTE FEATURES
Advanced security, accessed from anywhere. Authorized users can remotely unlock any door, create and send digital Guest Passes, and activate pre-configured system Lockdown plans in the event of an emergency, all from the app. Authorized users are determined by the system administrator.

HOW IT WORKS
- The application works only with the Avigilon Alta Access Control system.
- Certain features, such as Mobile Badge and Lockdown, are enabled at the discretion of the organization administrator.
- We leverage Bluetooth low energy, Wi-Fi and LTE capabilities, as well as location services to ensure the best door opening experience possible.
- To ensure you are authorized as a user of your company’s Avigilon Alta Access Control system, please contact your administrator, who will check to see that your email address has been added and will send you links to enable your application to be authorized and credentialed.

If you would like to start using Avigilon Alta Open in your organization visit www.avigilon.com/alta to learn more about the service and how to get started.

DEALS & SAVINGS

Whether it's a weekend getaway, a family trip, or a longer break, Vrbo helps you find the right place for everyone. Download the Vrbo app and plan your next trip today.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

apple-macos:6757088514.name: Away Message: Status Sharing
apple-macos:6757088514.description:
Away Message is a status app that lets you tell friends where you are, what you’re doing, or when you’ll be back. It’s meant for quick, low-effort updates that keep people in the loop without turning into full conversations.
If you’re stepping out for coffee, going out for the night, or focusing on work, you can post a short note so your friends have context. You can attach a location, a photo, or a song you’re listening to. There are no likes, comments, or feeds to manage. The point is simply to share what’s going on.
Each status lasts from 30 minutes to 24 hours and then disappears. You can change the look of your updates with different fonts, colors, themes, and layouts. You can also add photos, drop a pin, or share music from Apple Music. Friends can drop an emoji on your status cards.
People connect through simple 6-character codes. You approve who joins your circle and control who can see your updates.
Features:
• Statuses that expire after 30 minutes to 24 hours
• Custom fonts, colors, themes, and layouts
• Photos, locations, and Apple Music sharing
• Scrapbook-style design for your notes
• Private connections using shareable codes
• No ads or algorithmic feeds
Away Message is for friends, coworkers, and small groups who want to stay aware of each other’s day without constantly messaging. You leave a note, and people see it when they check. Sometimes a quick “brb” really is all that’s needed.

apple-macos:6759520295.name: Election Explorer: 2026 Map
apple-macos:6759520295.description:
Call the 2026 midterms yourself. Pick a winner in every Senate and Governor race, flip House seats state by state, then tap your way to 270.
UNOFFICIAL APP. Election Explorer is an independent educational app. It does not represent any government entity, and it is not affiliated with any government, election authority, political party or campaign. Official sources are listed at the end of this description and inside the app under Settings > Sources & Disclaimer.
2026 MIDTERM MAPS
The midterms are November 3, 2026.
• Senate: all 100 seats, two per state, with the 35 on the ballot marked and their candidates listed.
• House: every state's delegation, with Republican, Democrat and Independent seat steppers, vacant seats and the districts to watch.
• Governors: all 36 races, with open seats marked and the candidates on the ballot.
• Running totals: the Senate, House and Road to 270 bars update with every pick.
• Your picks get a white outline on the map, and each map resets on its own.
RACES TO WATCH
The closest Senate, Governor and House contests in one list, toss-ups first. Each one shows its candidates and a rating from Solid to Toss-Up.
Race ratings and candidate lists are compiled by the developer from public reporting. They are editorial estimates, not government data and not predictions.
ROAD TO 270
Build any presidential map, state by state. Tap a state once for blue, twice for red, three times for orange and a fourth time to clear it, or pick from the state panel if you prefer. Maine and Nebraska split their electoral votes by congressional district, and so does the app. Name your own candidates, reach 270 for a fireworks finale, and share your map.
COUNTDOWN
Count down to November 3, 2026. After Election Day, the countdown moves on to the 2028 presidential election.
THE ELECTION TIME MACHINE
Browse every presidential election from 1789 to 2024 with the electoral vote count of its time, and put the results from 1960 onward on the map.
LEARN AS YOU GO
• How the Electoral College works and how seats are assigned.
• Fun facts: tied elections, faithless electors and the candidates who defied the odds.
• A hands-on way to teach how U.S. government and elections work.
ONE PURCHASE, EVERY SCREEN
Election Explorer runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac with a single purchase. No account, no ads and no tracking. It works offline, and your picks stay on your device.
OFFICIAL SOURCES
Voting and election information: USA.gov, https://www.usa.gov/voting-and-elections

FrameNova is a multi-track video editor for your phone or tablet. Arrange video, photos, text and sound on a flexible timeline, edit right on the preview, and keep your projects and media on your device.
TIMELINE
• Combine a main track with video layers, text and audio tracks
• Split, trim, move, duplicate, replace and freeze clips
• Zoom and snap to the playhead or clip edges
• Trimming or moving a clip leaves a gap instead of shifting everything else
LAYERS AND LAYOUTS
• Move, scale and rotate layers directly on the preview
• Arrange clips side by side, in grids or as picture-in-picture
• Animate position, scale, rotation and opacity with keyframes
• Choose a preset aspect ratio or enter your own, such as 16:10 or 2.39:1
COLOR AND STYLE
• 16 filters with adjustable intensity
• Brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, tint, hue, sharpening and vignette
• Solid or blurred canvas background
• Transitions: fades, dips to black or white, pushes, slides and zooms
TEXT AND SUBTITLES
• Titles with outlines, shadows, backgrounds, spacing and in/out animations
• Emoji stickers
• Import subtitles and lyrics from SRT and LRC files
SOUND AND SPEED
• Add music, extract audio from video and record voiceovers
• Adjust volume and see fades in the waveform
• Change speed from 0.25x to 4x while preserving pitch
BATCH TOOLS
• Compress and convert videos
• Resize and convert images
EXPORT
• 720p up to 4K, 24 to 60 fps
• H.264 or HEVC, with three quality levels
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no analytics. Your projects and media stay on your device.
